article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Papua Selatan: 40.511 warga terjangkit kasus malaria - ANTARA News Papua Tengah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Papua Health Office: 40,511 residents contracted malaria - ANTARA News Central Papua
article.articleSummary: South Papua Health Office reports 40,511 residents contracted malaria from January to June 2026 across four districts: Boven Digoel 18,099; Asmat 10,646; Mappi 10,346; Merauke 1,420. Benedicta Rahangiar, head of the South Papua Dinas Kesehatan Pengendalian Penduduk dan Keluarga Berencana (P2KB), attributes the transmission to ongoing vector-borne spread. To combat malaria, the health office distributed bed nets to residents, with replacements issued if nets are damaged, as nets are distributed on a three-year cycle. Residents were urged to maintain environmental cleanliness to prevent Anopheles mosquito breeding. Health workers at community health centers (puskesmas) continue to educate residents and promote healthy living and environmental hygiene. The government aims to reduce incidence through ongoing surveillance and preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: 南パプア保健局：住民40,511人がマラリアに感染 - アンタラ通信中部パプア
triage.triage_reason: 南パプアにおけるマラリアは風土病であり、本記事は2026年1月~6月の定期的な症例集計と既存の予防対策（蚊帳配布等）を報告する通常のサーベイランス情報であり、異常な増加や新規発生を示す記述はない。
triage.notes: マラリアはパプア地域の風土病であり、本記事は保健当局による定例報告（蚊帳配布・衛生啓発等の既存対策の継続）であり、突発的なアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。死亡数や重症度に関する記述もなく、国際的な拡大・渡航貿易制限のリスクも認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 30-40 Students Fall Ill After Suspected Food Poisoning On Mangala Express During School Trip, Railway Teams Provide Medical Aid
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-30, a group of 80 students and 10 teachers traveling on Mangala Express 12618 from Mumbai reported 30-40 students with gastrointestinal symptoms after lunch on a school trip. Symptoms included vomiting, loose stools and stomach discomfort among passengers in S2 and S3. Railway medical teams treated them at Khandwa with medicines and oral rehydration solution (ORS). On arrival at Bhusawal, all students were examined and found stable; a Saturday morning check showed no deterioration, and the group remained under observation. The source of suspected food poisoning has not yet been confirmed. No severe outcomes reported to date, reflecting prompt on-train response and ongoing monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 修学旅行中の列車マンガラ・エクスプレス内で学生30~40人が食中毒疑いで体調不良、鉄道医療チームが対応
triage.triage_reason: 単一の食中毒疑い事案で、全員安定・重篤例なく、感染症としての国際的拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 食中毒疑いであり感染症アウトブレイクではない可能性が高い。原因未確定だが重症例なし。

article.articleHeadline: Kashmir's Rs 5.63-crore H1N1 lab shut since 2022
article.articleSummary: Kashmir’s high-end H1N1 testing laboratory at Chest Diseases Hospital, Srinagar, built after successive H1N1 waves and reportedly costing about Rs 9.88 crore, has remained non-functional since 2022. No microbiology staff has been allocated to operate it, and officials cite it as under “necessary repairs,” with four years elapsing without action. The idle facility raises concerns over Jammu and Kashmir’s outbreak preparedness and wasted public funds on infrastruture that cannot be used during rising influenza and respiratory infections. Tendering for repairs is expected to commence, but the lab’s utility remains in question. By contrast, an influenza lab at SKIMS (established 2010 with CDC-ICMR collaboration) has evolved into a surveillance and outbreak-investigation hub, underscoring the need for sustained capacity to identify circulating strains and unusual patterns.

triage.headline_ja: カシミールの5.63億ルピーのH1N1検査室、2022年から閉鎖中
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はH1N1検査施設が2022年から未稼働という行政・インフラ上の問題を報じたものであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや症例報告ではないため、シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は検査ラボの運用停止という公衆衛生インフラ・準備体制の問題を扱っており、実際のH1N1感染症例やアウトブレイクの発生を報じるものではない。地域として言及されているインドは対象国リストに含まれるが、実際の感染症イベントではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo leva Saúde a reforçar vacinação em três cidades de SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles prompts Health to reinforce vaccination in three cities in São Paulo state
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak prompts expanded vaccination in three cities in São Paulo state. As of 2026-08-30, 27 measles cases have been confirmed in 2026, with 24 linked to the active transmission chain started in June in São Paulo state: 21 in São Paulo city, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos. The National Multivaccination Campaign runs through September 1, offering free MMR vaccine via SUS. In the three cities, vaccination is extended to people 6 months–59 years, regardless of vaccination history; for 6–11 months, dose zero is advised in high-risk areas and does not replace routine doses at 12 and 15 months. Public health actions include epidemiological investigation, contact tracing, active case finding, ring vaccination, and expanded vaccination by territory. Brazil remains non-endemic for measles; 2025 had 38 imported cases, all controlled. Over 13 million MMR doses distributed in 2026, with 5.4 million administered.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹発生を受け、サンパウロ州の3都市で保健当局がワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹排除認定国であるブラジルで6月以来の持続的伝播チェーンが確認されており、WPRO基準に複数該当し政府（保健当局）の対応強化がみられるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ブラジルは麻疹非流行国（non-endemic）とされているが、6月以降サンパウロ州で持続的な伝播チェーンが継続しており、排除認定への影響が懸念される。重症例・死亡報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ sơ sinh trước 'cơn bão' mắc vi rút hợp bào hô hấp nguy hiểm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newborns face a dangerous Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) surge.
article.articleSummary: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) surge among newborns in Vietnam is alarming, with case volumes in National Children's Hospital (Nhi Trung ương) and Hanoi Medical University Hospital, and some infants requiring mechanical ventilation. RSV can progress rapidly in infants under 12 months, especially those under 3 months or overweight, as inflamed, edematous airways and thick mucus narrow the bronchioles, hindering airflow to the alveoli and risking hypoxia. While many infections are mild, RSV can deteriorate within hours; affected babies may need oxygen, respiratory support, or prolonged hospital stays (often 10–15 days or longer). Most recover, but some develop wheeze, recurrent pneumonia, or otitis, and later risk of bronchiolitis/asthma is higher. Emphasize infection control from pregnancy: mask-wearing, hand hygiene, limiting contact with sick newborns; breastfeeding provides immune factors. While maternal antibodies may occur, they do not fully protect newborns; prenatal prevention and counseling are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 新生児が危険なRSウイルス感染急増の『嵐』に直面
triage.triage_reason: 季節性RSVによる新生児感染増加を報じる内容で、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、重症化例や医療逼迫の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: RSVは既知の季節性ウイルスであり、ハノイの複数病院で新生児の重症例（人工呼吸器使用等）が報告されているが、新規病原体や異常事象ではない。国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、季節的な医療負荷の増加として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Phú Thọ tiêu hủy gần 150 tấn lợn sau khi phát hiện ổ dịch tả lợn Châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Phú Thọ culled nearly 150 tonnes of pigs after detecting an African swine fever outbreak.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever outbreak detected at a pig farm in Vĩnh An commune, Phú Thọ Province, Vietnam. On August 21, authorities from Phú Thọ's Economic Police identified signs of ASF at a farm owned by Trần Văn K. in Thôn Đình. Laboratory tests confirmed ASF virus in eight samples. To prevent spread, authorities implemented containment and culled 1,859 pigs, weighing about 150 tonnes. The farm owner was instructed to declare the incident and report disease status to local authorities and law enforcement. In addition to outbreak control, Economic Police intensified public outreach, urging farms and residents to observe prevention measures and monitor livestock for abnormal signs. Looking ahead, authorities will continue surveillance, inspect breeding facilities, deter concealment or movement of ill animals, and coordinate with local agencies to curb ASF spread in Phú Thọ.

triage.headline_ja: フート省で豚コレラ(アフリカ豚熱)発生後、約150トンの豚を殺処分
triage.triage_reason: 家畜のみに影響する動物疾病でヒトへの健康被害はないが、養豚業への経済的影響と地域拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱はヒトに感染しない動物疾病。ベトナムでは度々発生しており、地域限定の家畜衛生対応事案。公衆衛生上のリスクは低いが養豚業への経済影響と越境拡大の可能性から監視継続が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠、流感夾擊！疾管署示警開學面臨4大傳染病　預防方法一次看
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 and Influenza Strike! Taiwan CDC Warns That Back-to-School Season Faces Four Major Infectious Diseases — Prevention Measures at a Glance
article.articleSummary: Taiwan CDC warns that the back-to-school period faces four major infectious diseases: COVID-19, influenza, enterovirus, and dengue fever. As of late August 2026, COVID-19 remains at a high plateau; last week’s visits reached 24,995, down 6% from the prior week, with 59 local severe cases and 19 deaths—the highest toll since last year’s season, with activity likely through September. Influenza activity has intensified, with weekly visits over 90,000; the dominant strain is A/H1N1. Enterovirus activity is stable; last week 6,546 ED/OPD visits, with Coxsackie A6 most common, followed by EV-D68 and Coxsackie A16. Dengue fever includes a domestic cluster in Kaohsiung; Changhua reports four dengue cases among about 100 Philippine study-tour participants across 17 counties; imported dengue totals 139 this year. Schools should reinforce hand hygiene, masking in crowded or poorly ventilated spaces, monitor for warning signs, and keep ill children at home; seek hospital if severe symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナとインフルエンザが同時流行！台湾疾病管制署が新学期の4大感染症に警鐘　予防法まとめ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における季節性感染症（COVID-19、インフルエンザ、腸ウイルス、デング熱）に関する定例的な公衆衛生広報であり、対象国リストに該当する発生国が確認できないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾（Taiwan）における季節性感染症の流行状況を報告する内容。フィリピン人修学旅行生の間でデング熱が確認されたとの記述があるが、これは台湾彰化県で発生した事例であり、フィリピン国内での発生ではないため、Philippinesはverified_locationsに含めない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: 菲律賓遊學團染登革熱　彰縣4人確診
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Philippine study-tour group contracts dengue fever; four people in Changhua County diagnosed.
article.articleSummary: Four confirmed dengue fever cases in Changhua County, Taiwan, linked to a Philippine study-tour group that visited Cebu; the students recently returned and tested NS1-positive, with Taiwan CDC deeming them confirmed dengue cases and initiating close monitoring. The language school hosted about 100 students from 17 counties. Kaohsiung City Health Bureau reports nine related individuals: seven negative, two awaiting antibody testing. Taoyuan City Health Bureau notes 18 people under self-health monitoring; five sought care for cough or runny nose but rapid tests were negative; the remaining 13 are asymptomatic. As summer returns and the new school term begins, Changhua Health Bureau urges schools and parents to watch for fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia, joint pain, rash, nausea, or fatigue, and to seek care and disclose travel history. Guosheng Elementary School principal Li Zhengying, who led a July Malaysia exchange, says precautions were taken and no infections occurred among students.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン修学旅行団がデング熱に感染、彰化県で4人確診
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（対象国外）における輸入デング熱症例で、感染源とされるフィリピン・セブでの流行状況についての具体的言及はなく、既に台湾当局が監視・対応済みで拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 感染源とされるフィリピン・セブでの現地流行状況に関する具体的データが記事中になく、主題は台湾国内での輸入症例確認・健康監視対応であるため、Philippinesはverified_locationsに含めなかった。台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Cases rising, Odisha government moves to devise new strategy for malaria control
article.articleSummary: Odisha recorded the highest malaria burden in 2025 with 62,137 cases per NCVBDC, prompting a state plan to intensify control efforts. The government will form an expert technical team to review the malaria control programme and craft a dedicated Odisha strategy, prioritizing high-burden areas. A state-level team led by the additional director (vector-borne diseases) will visit Malkangiri district to conduct field reviews across all blocks in the tribal area. The technical task force, chaired by Health and Family Welfare secretary Aswathy S, approved assembling experts from RMRC Bhubaneswar, the World Health Organization regional office, and state specialists to reassess guidelines and programme implementation, producing an evidence-based plan with rapid-response measures for high-burden zones. Malkangiri receives special attention due to rising malaria, and a detailed report will be submitted to the health secretary.

triage.headline_ja: 感染者数増加を受け、オディシャ州政府がマラリア対策の新戦略策定に着手
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはインド・オディシャ州における既知の風土病であり、政府による通常の対策強化・戦略見直しの範疇。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 州政府がWHO地域事務所や研究機関と連携し既存プログラムを見直す通常の公衆衛生対応であり、緊急性の高いシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Seven test positive for scrub typhus in a week at Pallahara town
article.articleSummary: As of 30 August 2026, scrub typhus outbreak in Sanbagdhari village, Pallahara block, Angul district, Odisha, with seven people testing positive in the past week and one death suspected to be linked to the disease. The deceased, Sumanta Sethi (30), developed fever and body ache, was treated in Deogarh and at VIMSAR Burla; a blood test at a private hospital reportedly positive for scrub typhus, though Angul CDMO Madan Mohan Pradhan cautioned that death cannot be confirmed as caused by scrub typhus due to other health complications. Door-to-door surveillance identified seven confirmed cases who are undergoing treatment and are stable. Strict surveillance is maintained in the Pallahara area to ensure timely treatment. Scrub typhus is transmitted by bites of infected mites found in vegetation and forested areas; residents are advised to avoid entering jungle areas, especially during the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: パラハラ町で1週間に7人がツツガムシ病陽性
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域での限定的なツツガムシ病クラスターであり、国際的拡大の懸念は低いが、死亡疑い例があり地域サーベイランスの動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ツツガムシ病はダニ媒介性でヒト-ヒト感染はなく、局所的な媒介生物感染症。死亡例は他の合併症の可能性があり確定診断ではない。地域保健当局が戸別調査・監視を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Vishwavani Health: ಜೆನ್ ಝೀಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತಿದೆ ಎಚ್ಐವಿ ಸೋಂಕಿತರ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ; ಕಾರಣವೇನು?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vishwavani Health: HIV infections are increasing among Gen Z; what is the reason?
article.articleSummary: Published August 30, 2026: In an interview with Dr. Sutturu Malini, HIV is discussed as a virus of animal origin from Africa, believed to have crossed to humans from monkeys. HIV is an RNA retrovirus that attacks CD4 T cells, the key commander of the immune system. Once infected, the virus cannot be eradicated, but its progression to AIDS can be slowed with treatment; however, early infection may spread before symptoms appear. Transmission occurs mainly through sexual contact, blood, needles, and mother-to-child. The interview notes rising HIV infections among Gen Z in India, driven by sexual risk taking, influenced by social media, and increased sexual partnerships; historically low STI rates in India were linked to traditional family norms. Substance use, including cocaine, is cited as diminishing self-control and contributing to risk, along with lifestyle factors and diet. The emphasis is on awareness and risk reduction before intimate relationships.

triage.headline_ja: Vishwavani Health: Z世代でHIV感染者数が増加；その理由とは？
triage.triage_reason: インタビュー形式の一般啓発記事であり、急性の公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はHIVの一般的な啓発・教育的インタビューであり、具体的な感染急増データやアウトブレイク報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: लखनऊ में स्वाइन फ्लू-कोरोना के मरीज मिले, हापुड़ में एक की मौत; पूरे यूपी में अलर्ट पर अस्पताल
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu and coronavirus patients found in Lucknow; one death in Hapur; hospitals on alert across Uttar Pradesh.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) and COVID-19 infections have been confirmed across Uttar Pradesh, with Lucknow's PGI, Balrampur, and Lohia Institute reporting 19 cases in the past 30 days: 11 swine flu and 8 COVID-19. All cases exhibit mild symptoms; most patients are recovering, and currently no one is admitted. Lab confirmations were sent to the health department. In Hapur district, a 63-year-old farmer from Dhanoura died of swine flu; three additional swine flu cases were confirmed in Dhaulana, Keshwanagar, and Gadhamukteshwar. Health authorities have issued alerts as swine flu circulates in Karnataka, Delhi, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu. Agra's tourism and rail/road/air travel during Raksha Bandhan heighten import risk; however, no tourist screening is planned. Monitor for high fever or chills; dry cough and sore throat; nasal symptoms; extreme fatigue; seek medical advice, and avoid self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: ラクナウで豚インフルエンザ・コロナウイルス患者確認、ハープルで1人死亡；ウッタル・プラデーシュ州全域の病院で警戒
triage.triage_reason: 複数州でH1N1・COVID-19の季節的流行が報告され死亡例もあるが、大半は軽症で入院者もなく、既知病原体の季節性流行の域を出ない。拡大状況の続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: H1N1・COVID-19ともに既知の病原体で季節性流行と考えられる。インド複数州（ウッタル・プラデーシュ、カルナータカ、デリー、マハラシュトラ、ラージャスターン、グジャラート、ケーララ、タミル・ナードゥ）で確認されているが、大半は軽症で回復中。ハープル郡で農夫1名が死亡。ラクシャー・バンダン祭による人流増加で輸入リスクが指摘されているが、渡航者スクリーニングの予定はない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases climb to 21 in Ludhiana, malaria tally 50; health teams intensify testing
article.articleSummary: As of 30 August 2026, Ludhiana district reports 21 dengue and 50 malaria cases, up from 15 dengue and 44 malaria earlier this month. Health teams have collected 4,973 blood samples and are conducting field surveillance and testing in vulnerable areas. Anti-larval measures, source reduction, and fogging accompany inspections of potential breeding sites, with residents sensitis ed to prevent water accumulation. District epidemiologist Dr Supreet Kaur urged households to regularly check coolers, containers, rooftops, discarded tyres, and other water-holding items, noting that even small quantities can breed mosquitoes. Monsoon conditions, humidity, waterlogging and poor drainage create favorable breeding grounds. Officials stress sustained surveillance and community participation to prevent further increases. Residents are advised to seek medical attention promptly for persistent fever or other symptoms; testing continues with several weeks of monsoon still remaining.

triage.headline_ja: ルディアナでデング熱21例、マラリア50例に増加；保健当局が検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・マラリア症例の通常範囲内の増加であり、地域限定的な公衆衛生対応が進行中。国際的拡大リスクや異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節に伴う例年通りのベクター媒介性疾患の増加であり、地方自治体レベルで対応が行われている。国レベル・国際的な懸念事項は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Brucker leitet Ebola-Einsatz von "Ärzte ohne Grenzen" im Kongo | Kleine Zeitung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brucker leads MSF's Ebola mission in the Congo | Kleine Zeitung
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, especially Nord-Kivu, where MSF runs a treatment center. Since May, over 5,000 infections and about 2,500 deaths have occurred; roughly one death every 30 minutes. No vaccine exists for this Ebola virus strain. MSF project coordinator Christoph Friedl, an Austrian psychologist, oversees staffing, safety, and logistics, coordinating with medical teams and authorities. Contact tracing is challenging and community knowledge about Ebola is uneven; health systems are overwhelmed. The report cites emotional moments: a young man with severe symptoms dies, while the first recovered patient exits the center through a dedicated door amid celebrations. Friedl expects to stay about three more months and return to Austria in early November.

triage.headline_ja: ブルッカー出身の医師、コンゴでの国境なき医師団エボラ対応を指揮｜クライネ・ツァイトゥング
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で5000人以上の感染、2500人以上の死亡という大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、当該株にワクチンがなく医療体制も逼迫しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はオーストリア人MSF職員の活動を紹介する内容だが、主題となる感染症イベントはコンゴ民主共和国（北キブ州）で発生しているエボラ出血熱の流行である。オーストリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: TRIM22 blocks hepatitis B virus replication by tagging LDHA for destruction
article.articleSummary: TRIM22, an interferon-stimulated E3 ubiquitin ligase from Fujian Medical University, blocks hepatitis B virus (HBV) replication by tagging lactate dehydrogenase A (LDHA) with K48-linked ubiquitin and promoting its proteasomal destruction. This dual action suppresses glycolysis the virus relies on and relieves suppression of the RIG-I–MAVS innate sensing pathway, boosting antiviral signaling. In a study of 208 chronic hepatitis B patients, serum LDH levels correlated with HBV DNA levels and liver injury markers (ALT/AST), supporting a link between glycolytic activity and viral replication; LDHA was previously implicated in promoting HBV replication. In TRIM22-overexpressing cells, glycolytic gene expression and extracellular acidification rate (ECAR) declined, with metabolomics showing glycolysis slows, resulting in reduced HBV replication. The work highlights host-directed strategies amid limited cure options for chronic HBV, where cccDNA persists despite antivirals and interferon therapy in China.

triage.headline_ja: TRIM22はLDHAを分解タグ付けすることでB型肝炎ウイルスの複製を阻害する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究（分子メカニズム解明）に関する内容であり、公衆衛生上の緊急イベントや異常な発生を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: बकरियों में बढ़ता बीमारी का खतरा! PPR से निमोनिया तक रखें सावधानी, जानें लक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising disease risk in goats! From PPR to pneumonia, stay vigilant and learn the symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Goats face rising infectious disease risk in Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh, India, with Peste des petits ruminants (PPR) highlighted as a major threat. Veterinary doctors report that a vaccine is now available to prevent PPR, which can cause cold-like symptoms, mouth ulcers, and diarrhea in affected goats. Seasonal weather changes during the monsoon increase the risk of respiratory illness progressing to pneumonia, underscoring the need to shield goats from cold, rain, and moisture, and to separate sick animals for veterinary assessment. Local desi goat breeds are relatively hardier, while larger and exotic breeds—such as Jamunapari, Beetal, Black Bengal, Sirohi, and Osmanabadi—are more vulnerable. Dr. Ram Ottalwar of the Bilaspur District Veterinary Hospital advocates vaccination campaigns in urban and rural areas and urges farmers to vaccinate on schedule and seek prompt medical care if symptoms appear. Do not self-medicate or delay vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: ヤギの病気リスク増大！PPRから肺炎まで注意、症状を知る
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（PPR）に関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な流行は認められない。
triage.notes: PPRはヒトに感染しない家畜疾患であり、獣医療的な啓発記事であるため公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Một trang trại ở Phú Thọ tiêu hủy gần 1.900 con lợn vì dịch tả châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A farm in Phu Tho culls nearly 1,900 pigs due to African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreak confirmed at a pig farm in Vĩnh An commune, Phú Thọ Province, Vietnam. Eight samples tested positive for ASF virus. To prevent spread, authorities culled the entire herd of 1,859 pigs, weighing about 150 metric tons, at the Trần Văn Kiên farm in Dinh Hamlet. The culling and outbreak declaration occurred under regulatory procedures on August 30, 2026, led by Phú Thọ Police Department's Economic Police with local authorities, including containment and surveillance measures. Authorities intensified farm surveillance across communes and mobilized multiple agencies to participate in disease control as part of ongoing ASF containment efforts in the province.

triage.headline_ja: フート省の農場、アフリカ豚熱で約1,900頭の豚を殺処分
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（アフリカ豚熱）であり人への健康影響はなく、既存の防疫措置内で対応されているため公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては見送り。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱は人獣共通感染症ではなく豚のみに感染する動物疾病であり、公衆衛生上のリスクは基本的にない。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in swine flu cases in the city; doctors advise the public to take precautions.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) cases in Pune, India, have surged, rising from 35 in July to 225 in August, per Pune Municipal Corporation. The year's first quarter saw just two cases; January and March were zero. From May, infections increased. Early symptoms include fever, cough (dry or productive), cold, sore throat, severe headache, body pains, fatigue, and sometimes vomiting or diarrhea; progression can lead to pneumonia and hypoxia, especially in the elderly and those with comorbidities. Health experts advise avoiding crowded places, wearing masks, hand hygiene, and keeping distance from the sick. Nationally, swine flu is reported as mild, but high-risk groups should exercise caution. Dr. Avinash Bhondwe explains that a nasal spray vaccine has not been available since 2009–10, but when used correctly, vaccination can help prevent recurring outbreaks; seek medical care promptly if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: プネー市でスワインフル(豚インフルエンザ)患者が増加；市民に注意を呼びかける医師

triage.notes: 全国的には軽症例が多いとされるが、プネー市では8月の症例数が前月比約6倍に急増しており、地方自治体（PMC）が予防啓発を行っている。既知の季節性疾患だが局地的な増加傾向のため経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bác sĩ cảnh báo loại virus gây nguy hiểm cho trẻ khi vừa chào đời
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors warn of a virus that endangers newborns at birth
article.articleSummary: RSV can send seemingly healthy newborns to intensive care within hours. In Vietnam, RSV is a leading cause of bronchiolitis and pneumonia in children, responsible for roughly 24–48% of hospitalizations for lower respiratory infections and over 50% of bronchiolitis cases. Symptoms start like a cold but can rapidly progress as small airways become inflamed and filled with secretions, dangerous for neonates with tiny airways. A study of RSV-related ICU cases found 81% had no underlying condition. Prevention discussed at an international obstetrics conference emphasizes maternal immunization during pregnancy to protect newborns, plus postnatal measures: avoid kissing infants, no exposure to smoke or ill caregivers, hand hygiene, separate feeding utensils, and cleaning toys. RSV in tropical/subtropical regions shows seasonal peaks during rainy or cooler periods and when school returns, increasing household exposure as older siblings bring it home.

triage.headline_ja: 医師、新生児に危険なウイルスについて警告

triage.notes: RSVはベトナムで小児呼吸器感染症の主要原因として既知であり、本記事は予防啓発が主旨。アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Delhi Swine Flu: One more death due to swine flu in Delhi; an elderly man afflicted with H1N1 died and had also developed pneumonia.
article.articleSummary: Delhi's swine flu (H1N1) outbreak intensifies: a 70-year-old man with diabetes, chronic kidney disease and sleep apnea died in a private hospital in Dwarka after contracting H1N1 and developing pneumonia. Hospital confirms H1N1 infection; death attributed to sepsis with multiple organ dysfunction syndrome (MODS), with sepsis listed as immediate cause while H1N1 was part of the clinical condition. He had been admitted after presenting with shortness of breath on Aug 22 and remained hospitalized about eight days. Earlier, on Aug 5, a 3-year-old girl died at BLK Max Hospital, with confirmed H1N1 and acute necrotizing encephalopathy. Delhi is seeing rising cases: 166 new infections in the last 24 hours, pushing total H1N1 cases over 2,600. The Delhi government is reviewing hospital preparedness to cope with the surge.

triage.triage_reason: デリーでH1N1感染者数が急増（24時間で166人、累計2600人超）し、複数の死亡例（高齢者・小児）が報告されている。重症度と流行の継続性、当局の病院対応見直しなど社会的関心の高まりが確認されるため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: หมอยง"แนะติดโควิดกักตัวอย่างน้อย 10 วัน | NEW TV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Yong advises isolating for at least 10 days if you contract COVID-19 | NEW TV
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Thailand: Thai virologist Dr. Yong Poovorawan advises infected individuals to isolate for at least 10 days from symptom onset to prevent transmission. Citing studies in JAMA and the New England Journal of Medicine, viable virus declines after day 7 and is rarely detectable after day 10, with the same infectious period for symptomatic, mild, and asymptomatic cases; vaccination status does not alter the duration, only viral load and test positivity. A practical approach: at least 7 days at home, with up to 3 additional days of caution if going out, maintaining precautions for the full 10 days. Antigen tests (ATK) often stay positive and should not solely determine when isolation ends due to lower sensitivity and possible false positives/negatives; routine retesting is discouraged to conserve resources.

article.articleHeadline: Especialista do HU-UFSCar alerta sobre o risco de toxoplasmose na gravidez
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HU-UFSCar specialist warns about the risk of toxoplasmosis during pregnancy.
article.articleSummary: Toxoplasmosis during pregnancy is highlighted by a HU-UFSCar obstetrician in São Carlos, Brazil, after influencer Isabella Scherer disclosed a diagnosis at ten weeks. The infection, caused by Toxoplasma gondii, spreads mainly via cat feces, contaminated soil or water, and consumption of raw or undercooked meat or unwashed produce. It is relatively common in Brazil, but less frequent in the Southeast; maternal illness can be mild, while fetal risks include preterm birth, intracranial calcifications, vision or hearing problems, and developmental delay. Transmission depends on gestational age: earlier maternal infection lowers transmission but worsens fetal prognosis if transmission occurs; late infection increases transmission with milder fetal effects. Prenatal screening is routine; susceptible patients are re-tested. In São Carlos, treatment is available at CAIC, with HU-UFSCar handling notification, prescription, and follow-up. Prevention relies on hygiene: cook meat well, wash produce, wash hands, wear gloves for soil, and avoid cat feces exposure.

triage.headline_ja: HU-UFSCarの専門家、妊娠中のトキソプラズマ症のリスクについて警告

article.articleHeadline: ผลตรวจฝีดาษวานร 27 รายเป็นลบ แต่ลูกบิดประตู ผ้าปูเป็นบวก | NEW TV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox test results for 27 cases were negative, but the doorknob and bed sheet tested positive | NEW TV
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s Department of Medical Sciences reports that 27 high-risk individuals linked to a Nigerian monkeypox patient tested negative for the virus. Environmental samples—door handles and bed sheets—were positive, but it’s unclear whether such contamination can transmit infection; authorities stress that monkeypox requires close contact. Preventive measures include handwashing and alcohol-based sanitizers, consistent with COVID-19 precautions. Samples from the first Thai patient’s lesion were cultured to assess whether prior smallpox vaccination protects against monkeypox; initial growth was slow, with further testing underway. On transmission, officials say there is no evidence of airborne spread. Lab testing for monkeypox is currently allowed only in biosafety level 3 labs; the department proposes a ministerial order to permit BSL-2 labs (BSL-2+ with enhanced safety) to conduct mpox tests, awaiting sign-off.

triage.headline_ja: サル痘（mpox）検査27件陰性も、ドアノブとシーツから陽性反応｜NEW TV

triage.notes: 記事はタイ国内の既存mpox症例に関連する接触者調査・環境サンプル検査結果の続報。ナイジェリアは指標患者の由来として言及されるのみで、発生地域としては該当しない。ドアノブ・シーツからの陽性反応の感染性評価は継続中であり、今後の検査結果次第でリスク評価の見直しが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Thái Lan ghi nhận gần 100.000 ca Covid-19 trong 8 tháng, một biến thể chiếm ưu thế
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand records nearly 100,000 COVID-19 cases in eight months, one variant dominates.
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports 95,357 COVID-19 cases and 14 deaths from Jan 1 to Aug 28, amid rising respiratory illnesses including influenza and RSV. Data from the Thai Department of Disease Control (DDC) show 144.76 COVID-19 cases per 100,000 population, a mortality rate of 0.02 per 100,000, and a case fatality rate of 0.01%. Variant surveillance of 978 samples collected Jan 1, 2025–Jul 23, 2026 identifies NB.1.8.1 as dominant (490/978, 50.10%), followed by JN.1 (246, 25.15%), XEC (82, 8.38%), XFG (76, 7.77%), and BA.3.2 (8, 0.82%). From Jun 19–Jul 20, NB.1.8.1 remained prevalent (27/48, 56.25%), with JN.1 in 15 (31.25%), XFG and BA.3.2 in 2 each (4.17%), and 1 in other groups. Officials warn weather changes and the respiratory season could spur more cases and clusters in schools, workplaces, and communities.

triage.notes: 既存の変異株（NB.1.8.1、JN.1等）による定期的なサーベイランスデータ報告であり、新規性や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: La deforestación en la Amazonia de Brasil acelera la transmisión de enfermedades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon accelerates the transmission of diseases.
article.articleSummary: Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon accelerates transmission risk for leishmaniasis and Chagas disease. In Acre, northern Brazil, longer-deforested areas show greater abundance of flebótomos (sandflies) that transmit leishmaniasis, while landscapes with reduced forest cover increase the likelihood of triatomine bugs infected with Trypanosoma cruzi, the parasite behind Chagas. For leishmaniasis, vector abundance aligns more with the timing of deforestation and human occupation than with current forest cover. For Chagas, colonization of homes by triatomines is not required for elevated risk; deforestation alters the distance between palm trees and houses, and in highly deforested areas shorter distances correlate with more infected insects. Findings by Brazilian researchers led by Gabriel Laporta of the Federal University of ABC, and disclosed by FAPESP, were published in Parasites & Vectors and PLOS ONE, based on Acre field data.

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में H1N1 स्वाइन फ्लू का प्रकोप: एक दिन में 125 नए केस, कुल मामले 2729 पार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 swine flu outbreak in Delhi: 125 new cases in a single day, total cases cross 2729.
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports an ongoing H1N1 swine flu outbreak. As of August 27, 2026, the Delhi Health Department records 2,729 confirmed H1N1 cases in the capital, with 125 new infections on that day, raising total influenza A and B cases to 3,736 (about 75% H1N1). Officials say the situation is under control, with adequate isolation beds, medicines, and testing in government hospitals, and have directed facilities to monitor suspected and confirmed patients and provide prompt care for severe cases. Most patients exhibit mild symptoms—fever, cough, sore throat, and body aches—and recover after treatment; severe cases remain limited. ICMR surveillance reports no new dangerous mutation. Transmission is attributed to a seasonal H1N1 strain, with monsoon humidity and crowding contributing; a winter surge may occur, requiring continued vigilance. Preventive advice includes masks in crowded places, regular handwashing, and medical consultation for flu-like symptoms. No imported/exported case details are provided.

article.articleHeadline: वाराणसी में स्वाइन फ्लू का बढ़ा खतरा, स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Varanasi, swine flu risk has increased; health department on alert.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 August 2026, swine flu risk has risen in Varanasi district, Uttar Pradesh, prompting the Chief Medical Officer to place the health department on full alert. The CMO directed all community health centers to reserve beds and to ensure stocks of essential swine flu medicines for treatment. A high-level meeting with health officials emphasized bed capacity and medicine availability. Reported symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, nasal congestion, headaches, body and muscle pain, fatigue, and weakness. At-risk groups—elderly, young children, pregnant women, and those with prior serious illnesses—are urged to seek medical care promptly. Preventive measures include covering the mouth and nose while coughing or sneezing, regular handwashing or sanitizer use, avoiding crowded places when febrile or coughing, and avoiding unsupervised antibiotics. Deputy Chief Minister Brijesh Pathak led a video conference to review the situation and issue directives to authorities.

article.articleHeadline: Kehadiran Bio-TCV Diharapkan Mampu Cegah Penyakit Menular
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The introduction of Bio-TCV is expected to help prevent infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Typhoid fever vaccination is being advanced in Indonesia through Bio-TCV, a conjugate vaccine produced by Bio Farma. Typhoid fever, caused by Salmonella Typhi, remains a public health challenge in endemic settings and is linked to sanitation, access to clean water, food safety, hygiene, and appropriate medical management. Bio Farma aims to ensure a sustainable Bio-TCV supply by strengthening national production capacity, underpinning Indonesia's vaccine independence, and expanding access by reinforcing the national immunization program so more people are protected. The company also seeks affordability and collaboration with medical professional organizations, healthcare facilities, academia, and evidence-based education to improve understanding and trust in vaccination. The strategy centers on Availability, Accessibility, Affordability, and Acceptance, framing Bio-TCV as part of a comprehensive prevention ecosystem rather than a single intervention in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: Bio-TCVの登場、感染症予防への貢献に期待
triage.triage_reason: 腸チフスワクチン(Bio-TCV)の供給・普及に関する予防施策の紹介記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、シグナルとして扱う必要はない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン製造・普及に関する政策的な内容であり、具体的な感染拡大や症例報告はないため対象国発生事象としては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: नेपालः सड़ने- गलने लगे शव, प्रभावित क्षेत्रों में महामारी फैलने का खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nepal: Bodies began to rot and decay; risk of epidemic spreading in the affected areas.
article.articleSummary: Following catastrophic floods in Nepal, thousands of human and animal corpses have begun decaying in the Rasuwa and Nuwakot districts, raising the risk of epidemics in affected areas. Many people remain missing; livestock deaths are widespread, with no adequate carcass disposal. Infectious-disease specialists warn of potential outbreaks of cholera, diarrhea, scrub typhus, rotavirus, typhoid, hepatitis A and E, leptospirosis, dengue, malaria, and skin and respiratory infections in crowded displacement camps with limited potable water and sanitation. Authorities emphasize immediate measures: boil or chlorinate drinking water, regular handwashing, and effective waste and carcass disposal. Seek care for fever, diarrhea, vomiting, or skin infections. Rasuwa and Trishuli Hospital remain key facilities; other local centers are destroyed or unusable. The army, police, and health ministry are running camps; spraying and safe burial of dead animals began in Trishuli, Betrawati, and Vidur areas of Nuwakot over the weekend.

triage.headline_ja: ネパール:洪水後に遺体が腐敗し始め、被災地域で疫病拡大の危険
triage.triage_reason: ネパールの洪水後、遺体腐敗や衛生環境悪化によりコレラ・腸チフス・レプトスピラ症等の複数感染症のアウトブレイクリスクが指摘されているが、現時点では実際の症例報告ではなく予防的警告段階であり、また対象国リストに該当する国での発生は確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はネパール（Rasuwa・Nuwakot地区）における洪水後の遺体腐敗・衛生環境悪化に伴う感染症リスクであり、Nepalは対象国リストに含まれない。発生地域にIndia（Tamil Nadu等）が含まれるが、記事本文中にインドでの発生に関する具体的言及はないため、verified_locationsからは除外した。現時点では複数感染症の『発生リスク』に関する警告記事であり、実際の症例発生報告ではない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: नेपाल में बाढ़ के बाद मंडराया बड़ा खतरा, सड़ने-गलने लगे शव और मवेशी, फैल सकती है भयंकर महामारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A major threat looms after floods in Nepal as corpses and livestock rot, a devastating epidemic could spread.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 August 2026, floods in Nepal have left corpses of humans and livestock decaying, triggering environmental contamination and a heavy risk of outbreaks. Senior infectious disease expert Dr. Sheer Bahadur Pun warned that diseases such as cholera, diarrhea, scrub typhus, rotavirus, typhoid, hepatitis A and E, leptospirosis, dengue, malaria, and skin and respiratory infections could spread in affected districts. Displaced populations are sheltering in camps or outdoors with limited access to clean water and food, facilitating rapid person-to-person and vector-borne transmission amid stagnant water and filth. Health infrastructure is largely destroyed outside Rasuwa and Trishuli Hospitals; relief efforts by the army, police, and health ministry are underway but insufficient. Authorities are prioritizing pregnant women, young children, and newborns. Debris-clearing and removal of dead animals in Trishuli, Betrawati, and Vidur has begun, and insecticide spraying is being conducted to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ネパールで洪水後に大きな脅威が迫る、遺体や家畜が腐敗し始め、恐ろしい疫病が広がる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の死体・家畜の腐敗や医療インフラ崩壊により複数感染症のリスクが専門家から警告されているが、現時点では具体的な感染者数や確定症例の報告がなく、将来的なリスク予測の段階にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はネパールにおける洪水後の複数感染症（コレラ、腸チフス、A型・E型肝炎、レプトスピラ症、デング熱、マラリア等）発生リスクであり、対象国リストにネパールは含まれないためverified_locationsは空となる。発生地域にインド（Tamil Nadu等）が含まれるが、記事本文中にインドでの発生・言及は一切ないため除外した。実際の症例数や確定診断情報がなく、専門家による予防的警告の段階であるため続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 菲律宾卫生部警告洪水增加钩端螺旋体病感染风险
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Philippine Department of Health warns that flooding increases the risk of contracting leptospirosis.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis risk rises in the Philippines as heavy rains and floods from the Southwest Monsoon (Habagat) spread nationwide. The Department of Health warns people to avoid bathing, playing, or wading in floodwaters, which may be contaminated with the urine of infected animals, especially rats, and can lead to severe complications or death. Individuals with floodwater exposure should promptly seek assessment at healthcare facilities or YAKAP primary care clinics; medical staff may determine whether doxycycline prophylaxis is appropriate, and self-medication is discouraged without a doctor's prescription. As of Aug 28, the Philippines reported 5,486 leptospirosis cases nationwide from Jan 4 to Aug 26, down about 23% from 7,163 in the same period last year. DOH Deputy Secretary Gloria Balboa cautioned that cases could rise in the next two weeks due to ongoing heavy rain and floods.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン保健省、洪水によるレプトスピラ症感染リスク増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: 洪水に伴う季節性のレプトスピラ症流行であり、症例数は前年同期比で減少しているが、今後2週間の増加が懸念されており継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 毎年の雨季に見られる季節性のレプトスピラ症流行。前年同期比で症例数は減少しているが、今後の降雨状況により増加の可能性があり動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Bé 2 tuổi mắc tay chân miệng nguy hiểm , bác sĩ cảnh báo biến chứng cần lưu ý
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous hand, foot and mouth disease in a 2-year-old child; doctors warn of complications to watch for.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD) caused by Enterovirus 71 (EV71) surged in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. A 2-year-old was admitted to Children’s Hospital 2 with high fever, neurological signs and limb weakness; EV71 was confirmed. Despite IVIG, the child developed respiratory and circulatory complications, requiring PICU care, dialysis and mechanical ventilation, but recovered and was weaned off supports. Currently, about 20 HFMD patients, mostly aged 1–2, are hospitalized at Children’s Hospital 2. Dr. Vu Thi Tuy Dương notes two annual HFMD peaks (March–May and September–November), the latter aligning with school start and crowded settings. Delayed hospital presentation is common; families often treat fever at home before rash appears. At Children’s Hospital City, most admissions come from western provinces. Preventive advice emphasizes hand hygiene, food hygiene, environmental cleaning, isolation during illness, and prompt medical care for persistent fever, vomiting, irritability, or altered consciousness.

triage.headline_ja: 2歳児が重症の手足口病に罹患、医師が合併症への注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市でEV71による手足口病の重症例が報告され、周辺地域でも約20人が入院中だが、季節性の既知流行パターンであり国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: ベトナムでは毎年3-5月と9-11月にHFMDの流行ピークがあり、本記事はその季節性パターンの一環として報告されている。重症例（PICU・透析・人工呼吸器管理）は懸念材料だが、地域的な既知の流行状況であり国際的シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 cases rise, demand for flu vaccines jumps: Who should get the shot and what do doctors recommend?
article.articleSummary: India faces rising H1N1 and other influenza infections, with vaccine sales nearly tripling versus last year and more than doubling since July as demand for flu vaccines and at-home testing grows. Dr. Sourabh Pahuja of Amrita Hospital, Faridabad, notes vaccination targets depend on risk of severe influenza: priority groups are adults 65+, children under five, pregnant women, and healthcare workers; also those with asthma, COPD, diabetes, heart or kidney disease, cancer, extreme obesity or weakened immunity. H1N1 remains part of seasonal influenza and is included in current vaccines as A(H1N1)pdm09. Immunity from prior vaccination wanes over time; vaccination does not fully prevent infection but lowers the risk of serious illness and hospitalization. Data from eight Southern Hemisphere countries in 2025 showed about 42% effectiveness against H1N1-related hospitalization. Ideally vaccines are given before flu activity, but vaccination during ongoing season can still reduce severe disease.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1感染例が増加、インフルエンザワクチンの需要が急増：誰が接種すべきか、医師の推奨は？
triage.triage_reason: インドで季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1含む）の症例増加とワクチン需要増を伝える一般的な医療情報記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限等の懸念は見られない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1pdm09）に関するワクチン啓発・医療アドバイス記事であり、新規の感染症危機シグナルとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Một trang trại ở Phú Thọ tiêu hủy gần 1.900 con lợn vì dịch tả châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A farm in Phú Thọ culls nearly 1,900 pigs due to African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever outbreak detected in Phú Thọ Province, Vietnam, at a pig farm in Vĩnh An commune. On 30 August 2026, Phú Thọ Provincial Police Economic Police identified suspected ASF at the farm owned by Trần Văn Kiên (b. 1977) in Thôn Đình. Laboratory testing confirmed ASF in eight samples. To prevent spread, authorities quarantined the site and culled the entire herd: 1,859 pigs with a total weight of about 150 tonnes. Local authorities, in coordination with relevant agencies, implemented containment, directed the owner to report the outbreak, and advised other farms to strengthen surveillance and reporting. The report does not specify the infection source or any details on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: フート省の農場、アフリカ豚熱により約1,900頭の豚を殺処分
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（アフリカ豚熱）であり人への直接的な公衆衛生リスクは低いが、家畜産業・経済への影響と拡大可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本疾患はヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり、公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低い。畜産業・食料安全保障への影響として経過観察対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Emraan Hashmi diagnosed with swine flu
article.articleSummary: As of 30 August 2026, Bollywood actor Emraan Hashmi is hospitalized in Mumbai after testing positive for swine flu (H1N1). He fell ill after returning to Mumbai and missed a Bengaluru promotional event; doctors advised isolation and rest. The official medical report, released by his spokesperson, confirms the swine flu diagnosis. India has seen rapid spread of influenza and swine flu infections, with Delhi reporting more than 2,400 H1N1 cases, Karnataka 4,212, and Kerala nearly 7,500 infections. Hashmi is expected to recover with proper care and rest in hospital, and is anticipated to resume shooting and promotions after recovery. The film Awarapan 2 has crossed Rs 200 crore in worldwide box office earnings.

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Cases Surge In India: Delhi, Karnataka, Maharashtra Among States Seeing Rise In Swine Flu
article.articleSummary: Swine flu H1N1 cases rise across India during the monsoon, with Delhi reporting 2,729 cases; Karnataka 4,428 lab-confirmed H1N1/influenza cases as of Aug 24; Maharashtra 1,109 cases as of Aug 21 (Mumbai and Pune together ~65% of total). Rajasthan records 146 H1N1 cases from January–August 2026, including 55 in August—the highest monthly total this year; Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, reports two new RT-PCR–confirmed cases after the death of a woman infected with H1N1 at Balrampur Hospital. Gurugram, Haryana, has 12 cases; Chandigarh reports 14 H1N1 cases this year (7 in August). Kolkata shows a monsoon-associated surge with hospitalizations. ICMR says no new strain; the circulating virus remains Influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 since 2025. Officials urge precautions and prompt medical care, not panic.

article.articleHeadline: ദില്ലിയിൽ എച്ച്1എൻ1 കേസുകൾ വർദ്ധിക്കുന്നു: ഗർഭിണികൾക്ക് പന്നിപ്പനി ബാധിക്കാനുള്ള സാധ്യത കൂടുതലെന്ന് വിദ​ഗ്ധർ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Delhi, H1N1 cases are rising: experts say pregnant women are more likely to contract swine flu.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 August 2026, H1N1 (Influenza A), commonly called swine flu, is rising in Delhi with outbreaks reported across Indian states. Typical symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, and fatigue; early signs can be mild and resemble other viral infections. Pregnant women, the elderly, young children, and people with conditions such as asthma, chronic respiratory disease, heart disease, diabetes, or kidney disease are at higher risk of complications. While most fever cases do not require H1N1 testing or hospitalization, seek urgent care for persistent high fever, cough with breathlessness, or severe fatigue. Preventive measures—handwashing with soap, masks, hygiene, and avoiding crowded places—are advised. Authorities stress heightened vigilance among pregnant patients due to physiological changes in pregnancy that may complicate respiratory infections. No specific case counts are provided.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don’t ignore it thinking it’s just a cold; there could be signs of an H1N1 infection—learn the preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: As of the last week of August 2026, the city has recorded over 2,800 cases of Influenza A (H1N1) infection, linked to monsoon-season changes. Symptoms resemble a cold, with cough and fever, and healthy adults often recover without treatment. However, symptoms should not be ignored, particularly in children, older adults, and those with preexisting health conditions who require extra caution. The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) emphasizes that this is not a new dangerous strain, but a seasonal variation during the monsoon. There is no indication of a novel outbreak, and public health measures and vigilance remain appropriate rather than alarm.

triage.headline_ja: 風邪だと思って無視しないで――H1N1感染の兆候かもしれません。予防法を知りましょう

triage.notes: 記事は健康啓発・予防情報が主目的で、特定都市名やICMRの公式声明の詳細は不明。2800例という数字はある都市の累計とみられるが、期間や地域の詳細情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola salgınında hayatını kaybedenlerin sayısı 2 bin 786'ya yükseldi - Evrensel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from the Ebola outbreak in Congo has risen to 2,786 - Evrensel
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has risen to 2,786 deaths and 5,794 confirmed cases as of 26 August 2026. The World Health Organization reports the outbreak has spread across 60 health zones and affected six provinces. The figures indicate a significant increase in both case counts and geographic reach over the past three months. In its 18 August meeting, the WHO Emergency Committee recommended that the outbreak remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The report emphasizes verified case counts and international status, without detailing symptoms or transmission sources. The narrative underlines ongoing international health assessment and response, confirming the outbreak’s persistence within the DRC and its status as a matter of international health importance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行、死者数が2,786人に増加 - Evrensel
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がPHEICとして継続認定され、死者数・症例数・地理的拡大が著しく増加しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEICを継続認定しており、60保健地域・6州に拡大、症例数・死者数ともに顕著に増加。フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: हिमाचल में स्वाइन फ्लू से पहली मौत! 70 वर्षीय बुजुर्ग ने उपचार के दौरान तोड़ा दम; स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First swine flu death in Himachal Pradesh; 70-year-old man succumbs during treatment; Health Department on alert.
article.articleSummary: First swine flu (H1N1) death reported in Himachal Pradesh as of August 30, 2026, with eight total cases after two new infections in Mandi district. A 70-year-old man from Dadyal village, Sundernagar, previously treated for cancer, died during treatment after contracting H1N1; he had chemotherapy in Chandigarh on August 11, indicating severe immunosuppression. Funeral held in Dadyal on Friday; health authorities notified on Saturday. A rapid response team conducted household thermal screening and issued precautionary guidance to contacts. Common symptoms include high fever, cough with phlegm, body pains, extreme fatigue, chills, headache, chest heaviness, and breathlessness. High-risk groups—children under 5, pregnant women, the elderly, and individuals with diabetes, hypertension, or weakened immunity—should seek prompt medical care if flu-like symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: ヒマーチャル・プラデーシュ州で豚インフルエンザによる初の死亡例！70歳男性が治療中に死亡、保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)による散発的な死亡例で、基礎疾患（がん化学療法後の免疫抑制）を有する高リスク患者の事例。地域的な感染拡大や異常な病原性は確認されておらず、通常の季節性インフルエンザ対応の範囲内と考えられるが、症例数の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザの一種であり、既知の病原体。死亡者は免疫抑制状態（がん化学療法後）にあった高リスク患者。地域で8例の感染確認、保健当局が積極的疫学調査（サーモスクリーニング等）を実施中。新型・異常な病原性の兆候はなく、通常の季節性インフルエンザサーベイランスの範囲内と判断されるが、地元メディアで報道され地域の関心はある。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis A vaccination proves crucial for prevention and outbreak control,
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A vaccination is highly effective for both pre- and post-exposure prevention. A Czech-led systematic review (HAVETO) analyzed 21 studies (1985–2026) with laboratory-confirmed outcomes (IgM anti-HAV) and found pre-exposure effectiveness of 95.8% (20 infections among 925,238 vaccinated vs 1,029/1,708,753 unvaccinated) and post-exposure effectiveness of 96.9% (within 14 days of exposure; close-contact settings 95.3% and outbreak areas 98.4%). Vaccine platforms performed similarly: inactivated vaccines 97.2% in children; live attenuated vaccines in Chinese children 96.0%; randomized-child trials 97.5% (high certainty). An ecological analysis of 19 childhood vaccination programmes (1997–2024) estimated population impact at 83.9%, rising when pre-vaccination incidence exceeded 100/100,000. Coverage varied 40–95% but did not clearly explain impact; vaccinating young children appears to reduce transmission to adults, with Israel and Argentina cited as examples. Implications for outbreak control and shifting hepatitis A epidemiology.

triage.headline_ja: A型肝炎ワクチン接種は予防とアウトブレイク制御に極めて重要であることが判明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はA型肝炎ワクチンの有効性に関するシステマティックレビュー（研究論文）であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの発生を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン有効性に関するレビュー研究であり、特定国での現在進行中のアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。イスラエル・アルゼンチン・中国は過去の研究事例として言及されているのみで、現在のイベントとしての発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Jászberényi Sándor: Tombol az ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jászberényi Sándor: Ebola is raging.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Congo is spreading rapidly, with the new Congo Ebola outbreak infecting more than 3,000 people in ten weeks. The virus is advancing faster than any predecessor, while the author notes a system that could have halted it has been dismantled. The piece blends reportage with stark, on-the-ground imagery of villages without running water or electricity and crowded urban markets, underscoring the threat as the outbreak penetrates communities. It evokes Africa’s security strains, including references to Boko Haram territory, to convey the gravity of the crisis. Clinical details are sparse in the article: no symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or death toll are provided. The narrative highlights critical background: the loss of an effective containment framework and the urgent need for a public-health response to this ongoing outbreak in the Congo.

article.articleHeadline: Delhi-NCR में तेजी से फैल रहा H1N1 वायरस.... गंभीर बीमारी का कारण बन सकता है ये संक्रमण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 virus spreading rapidly in Delhi-NCR... this infection could cause severe illness.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-30, H1N1 Swine Flu is spreading rapidly in Delhi-NCR, with Delhi reporting over 2,700 cases this year, while outbreaks are noted in multiple Indian states. Symptoms include high fever, headache, cough/cold, and breathing difficulties. Individuals with weakened immunity or comorbidities face a higher risk of developing pneumonia and severe illness. Most patients recover in about a week, but warning signs such as rapid breathing, chest pain, shortness of breath, blue lips/skin, dizziness, or altered consciousness necessitate urgent medical care. Antiviral medications are used for influenza, with early initiation advised for severe or high-risk cases. Annual flu vaccination is recommended. Bollywood actor Imran Hashmi tested positive for H1N1 after recent travel during filming, illustrating an imported-case scenario. Emphasis on preventive measures and timely medical consultation remains key for reducing severe outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: デリーNCRでH1N1ウイルスが急速に拡大…この感染症は重症化を招く可能性がある

triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の既知パターンの流行であり、著名人の感染報道により社会的関心はあるが、IHR基準には該当せず。今後の症例数推移や重症例の増加を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes PPKB Pesisir Selatan Gencarkan Skrining Aktif Tuberkulosis di Nagari Kapuh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Pesisir Health Office PPKB Intensifies Active Tuberculosis Screening in Nagari Kapuh.
article.articleSummary: Active tuberculosis screening was intensified in Nagari Kapuh, Tarusan Sub-district, South Pesisir Regency, West Sumatra, Indonesia, on August 28, 2026, led by the South Pesisir Health Office for Population Control and Family Planning (Dinkes PPKB) in collaboration with Puskesmas Tarusan. Integrated into the Free Health Check program, the effort targeted individuals with household or close-contact exposure and others at high risk of tuberculosis. Of 100 participants, 87 were close contacts of TB patients and 13 were identified as at risk. In addition to TB screening, attendees received general health checks, including blood pressure, body measurements, and blood glucose monitoring. Dinkes PPKB head Agustina Rahmadani urged the public to seek TB screening without fear or stigma, noting TB is curable when detected early and treated with strict adherence. Secretary Donny Tayes provided education on symptoms, transmission, risk factors, prevention, screening procedures, and medication adherence.

article.articleHeadline: Haldwani News: लंपी संक्रमित पशुओं के लिए विभाग के नहीं आइसोलेशन वार्ड
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Haldwani News: The department has no isolation wards for animals infected with lumpy skin disease.
article.articleSummary: Haldwani, Uttarakhand, faces potential lumpy skin disease (LSD) in cattle, with the Department of Animal Husbandry under scrutiny for lacking isolation wards. There are currently no facilities to admit LSD-infected cattle for treatment and containment; confirmed cases must be kept separate from healthy animals. Two stray bovine animals in the Jail Road and Kamluvanga areas showed suspected LSD symptoms, prompting the department to write to the Haldwani Nagar Nigam seeking a dedicated isolation facility. The absence of goshalas in the district’s municipalities complicates containment. Chief Veterinary Officer Dr. Rajiv Singh said space for an isolation ward does not exist at present; a site will be identified with municipal cooperation before constructing the ward. Meanwhile, surveillance of both stray and resident cattle continues to monitor for LSD symptoms and prevent wider spread.

article.articleHeadline: 108 साल पहले ब्रिटिश नागरिक ने दिल्ली में फैलाया था इंफ्लुएंजा, पढ़ें फ्लू के पहले प्रकोप का काला इतिहास - 108 years ago british citizen spread influenza in delhi know dark history of the first flu outbreak in capital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 108 years ago, a British citizen spread influenza in Delhi; read the dark history of the first influenza outbreak in the capital.
article.articleSummary: Rising Delhi influenza history: While the current season shows growing H1N1 cases in Delhi, this piece recounts the capital’s first influenza outbreak. On 29 August 1918, a sick European man arriving from Shimla infected Delhi, and the illness quickly spread, with weekly cases exceeding 100 by the third week. Severe complications such as bronchitis, pneumonia, and pleurisy emerged among those infected. Official acknowledgment of influenza in Delhi came only in 1920, when the British administration described it as a deadly contagious disease. At that time, Delhi was governed under the Punjab Municipal Act, granting the city authorities special powers to implement measures. Across the Delhi province, influenza caused 23,175 deaths: 7,044 in urban areas and 16,131 in rural areas. The article highlights Delhi’s early encounter with influenza and the delayed government response.

triage.headline_ja: 108年前、英国人がデリーにインフルエンザを広めた―首都における最初のインフルエンザ流行の暗い歴史

triage.notes: 記事は主に1918年のデリーにおける歴史的インフルエンザ流行についての歴史記事であり、現在の公衆衛生イベントを報じるものではない。現行シーズンのH1N1増加への簡単な言及があるが、詳細情報がなく現行イベントとしての評価は困難。

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon rain triggers rat fever concerns: Doctor explains precautions, symptoms, medicines to take
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis (Weil’s disease/rat fever) alert issued in Kozhikode district, Kerala, after persistent rainfall and waterlogging. Transmission occurs via water or soil contaminated with infected urine; bacteria enter through skin cuts or abrasions. At-risk groups include sanitation workers, agricultural labourers, and anyone wading in floodwater. Precautions: avoid entering waterlogged areas if you have open wounds; use PPE (gloves, boots) for soil/water contact; improve waste management to reduce rodents. Preventive doxycycline is recommended for those with potential exposure after consulting a doctor; free distribution at government hospitals and primary health centres. Symptoms to watch: high fever, severe headache, fatigue, calf muscle pain; jaundice may occur in severe cases. Seek immediate medical attention if symptoms develop or exposure occurred. Advisory only, not a substitute for medical advice.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu risk rises in Jharkhand; government on alert; hospitals prepared—from beds to oxygen.
article.articleSummary: H1N1 (Swine Flu) risk rises in Jharkhand as the state government goes on alert and hospitals gear up—from beds to oxygen. Health Minister Dr. Irfan Ansari reviewed the situation on Aug 29, directing civil surgeons, medical college principals, and district surveillance officers to tighten vigilance, ensure timely identification, testing, treatment, and rapid referrals. Surveillance for Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) and Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) to be strengthened across districts, with immediate reporting of suspected and severe cases. Hospitals, including RIMS, Ranchi, and all medical colleges and district hospitals, to retain an extra 10 beds, ensure oxygen availability, stocks of medicines and testing facilities, and ICU/HDU readiness with trained staff. Airports, railways, bus stands and other public sites to undergo targeted screening; symptomatic individuals to receive clinical assessments and Influenza/H1N1 testing as needed. The minister emphasized that timely care prevents deaths and urged vigilance without panic.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Death toll rises to 2,786.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains severe. As of 26 August, the World Health Organization reports 5,794 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 2,786 deaths across 60 health zones in six provinces of the DRC. The figures indicate a substantial rise in both case burden and geographic spread over the past three months. Following the 18 August WHO Emergency Committee meeting, the outbreak continues to be a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The report underscores ongoing transmission within multiple districts and the international significance of the situation, signaling the need for sustained surveillance, outbreak response, and coordination among health authorities.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Those days of fear from COVID; the nurse who cared for India's first COVID patient retires.
article.articleSummary: Lucy M. Sagheer, a public health nurse at Mathilakam Primary Health Centre in Thrissur, Kerala, retires after 31 years of service. She is remembered as the nurse who first cared for India’s initial COVID-19 patient, a girl from Mathilakam who had recently returned from Wuhan, China. On January 24, 2020 the patient arrived home; Sagheer attended her that evening, and COVID-19 was suspected due to travel history and symptoms. At that time there was no formal COVID protocol; the response followed Nip prophylaxis with home quarantine and immediate reporting to authorities. On January 27 the patient developed mild symptoms and was taken to Thrissur Medical College; COVID-19 was confirmed on January 30. The episode led to home quarantine for Sagheer and her husband, with three other PHC staff also quarantined. The article frames this as part of India’s early pandemic fear and the broader outbreak that followed.

article.articleHeadline: শুধু প্লেটলেট কমে না, বিকল হতে পারে লিভারও, ডেঙ্গি নিয়ে সতর্ক থাকতে যা যা জানা জরুরি
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not only do platelets decrease, the liver can fail as well; what you need to know to stay vigilant about dengue.
article.articleSummary: More than 4,000 dengue cases and deaths have been reported in the state by mid-August, with rising hospital admissions due to monsoon rains. Aedes aegypti bites mainly in the morning (8–10) and in the afternoon (4–8); protect homes with nets after sunset and prevent water accumulation around the house. Transmission occurs when a mosquito feeds on a dengue patient and, after 8–10 days, infects another person; or when a mosquito that fed on a patient bites someone else 6–8 days later. Dengue can be more dangerous than fever and platelets alone: high viral load can impair liver function and cause abdominal fluid buildup; multi‑organ involvement is possible. Platelets may drop, but danger rises below 20,000 or 10,000. After fever subsides, 48–72 hours of monitoring is advised. Diagnostics include NS1, IgM, and NAAT tests. Children may have joint pains, seizures, swollen glands, and respiratory symptoms. Hydration and meals; eliminate water accumulation.

article.articleHeadline: Philippines logs 5,486 leptospirosis cases; DOH braces for post-flood surge
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in the Philippines reached 5,486 cases from Jan. 4 to Aug. 26, 2026, a 23% decline from 7,163 in the same period in 2025, as authorities brace for a post-flood surge. Highest cumulative counts are in the National Capital Region (Metro Manila), Cagayan Valley and Central Luzon. In Metro Manila, 521 cases were recorded as of Aug. 27, including 158 admissions at San Lazaro Hospital. To handle potential influxes, the DOH opened leptospirosis fast lanes in 33 government hospitals and strengthened referral networks; NKTI and PGH coordinate transfers to free intensive care and dialysis capacity for severe cases. Public guidance: floodwater exposure warrants medical evaluation within 24–48 hours; early treatment within two days of onset can prevent hospitalization and complications. Untreated leptospirosis may cause kidney failure, liver damage, meningitis or multi-organ failure. Doxycycline is stocked in government facilities but requires a prescription.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンでレプトスピラ症5,486例確認、保健省は洪水後の急増に備える
triage.triage_reason: 季節性・毎年発生する洪水関連疾患であり前年より23%減少しているが、洪水後の症例急増懸念と重症患者の入院が継続しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は洪水後に毎年発生する既知の風土病であり、症例数は前年同期比で減少傾向。DOHは33病院でファストレーン設置、ドキシサイクリン備蓄など既存の国内対応体制で管理可能と判断される。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Salgın kontrolden çıktı! 6 bin vaka 2 bin 786 can kaybı var
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak spiraling out of control! 6,000 cases, 2,786 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is escalating. WHO’s latest report states that as of 26 August, there are 5,794 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2,786 deaths, across six provinces and 60 health zones. The document emphasizes a significant rise in the outbreak over the past three months, with expanding geographic spread and mortality. On 18 August, WHO’s Emergency Committee affirmed that the outbreak remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), signaling ongoing international concern. The article does not provide further details on transmission sources or case export/import, but underscores the need for intensified international support and public health interventions to control transmission and reduce fatalities. Current date reference for time framing is 2026-08-30. Keywords: Ebola, DRC, outbreak, cases, deaths, PHEIC, WHO.

triage.headline_ja: アウトブレイクが制御不能に!6,000症例、2,786人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラアウトブレイクはWHOによりPHEICと認定されており、症例数・死亡者数が急増し複数州に拡大している。IHR基準を複数満たし、社会的・国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHOによりPHEICと宣言されており、致死率も高い（約48%）。6州60保健区に拡大中で、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Rokan Hilir Jadi Episentrum Malaria di Riau, Hingga Akhir Agustus Tembus 2.600 Kasus Lebih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rokan Hilir Becomes the Malaria Epicenter in Riau, Reaching More Than 2,600 Cases by the End of August.
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains concentrated in Riau, Indonesia, led by Rokan Hilir (Rohil), which recorded 2,613 cases as of 29 August 2026, about 88% of the province’s malaria burden. Across Riau, malaria cases reached 2,941 by 27 August 2026, nearly matching the 2025 total of 2,943. Rohil’s annual totals in recent years show persistent transmission: 2023 = 2,711; 2024 = 2,449; 2025 = 2,858; by late August 2026 Rohil accounted for roughly 91% of its 2025 figure. In Riau overall, 2023–2025 totals were 2,760, 2,716, and 2,943 respectively, with 2,941 by 27 August 2026. Malaria is transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes; control measures include indoor residual spraying (IRS), blood testing to detect infections (including asymptomatic cases), early treatment, and community education, as emphasized by provincial health official Zulkifli.

triage.headline_ja: ロカン・ヒリルがリアウ州のマラリア震源地に、8月末までに2,600件以上の症例
triage.triage_reason: リアウ州で例年発生している地方病的マラリアの継続報告であり、症例数は過去数年と同水準。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、蚊媒介感染症としての継続曝露・流行しやすさの観点から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局（Zulkifli氏）が対策（IRS、血液検査、早期治療、地域啓発）を実施していることから、地域レベルでの管理体制は存在する。症例数は過去数年とほぼ同水準であり、突発的な異常増加ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 女孩游泳20多天全身长20多个疣！医生提醒：泳池是传播高危区，千万别用手挤
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Girl develops more than 20 warts all over her body after swimming for more than 20 days! Doctors warn: The pool is a high-risk area for transmission; don’t squeeze them with your hands.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-30, a girl in Henan Province, China was diagnosed with Molluscum contagiosum (MCV) after swimming for over 20 days, developing more than 20 pearly, dome-shaped papules across her trunk and limbs. Lesions are skin-colored to pearly white with a central dimple, size ranging from pinhead to green bean. Transmission occurs mainly via direct skin contact, contact with virus-contaminated items (towels, swim gear), or autoinoculation. Public pools and bathhouses are high-risk, as MCV can survive for hours in moist environments on pool edges, slides, and props. Wet skin and minor abrasions after swimming facilitate infection, especially in hot and humid late summer. Doctors warn against squeezing lesions, which can cause persistence, bacterial infection, scarring, or spread. Prevention: swim in licensed facilities, bring personal towels and gear, avoid swimming with wounds, rinse after swimming, dry thoroughly, and seek dermatology care for suspicious lesions.

triage.headline_ja: 水泳20日余りで女児の全身に20個以上のイボが発生！医師の警告：プールは感染の高リスク地帯、絶対に手で潰さないで
triage.triage_reason: 伝染性軟属腫（水いぼ）は軽症で一般的な皮膚感染症であり、個別症例の啓発記事であって公衆衛生上の重大性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクはない。
triage.notes: 個人の症例に基づく健康啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや集団感染の報告ではない。

The replacement event is set for Sunburn Union Bengaluru on 12 September, with tickets valid for the new date. Hashmi had been promoting his film Awarapan 2, in which he stars as Shivam Pandit. The article notes H1N1 infection and provides a link to general symptoms and care but does not specify lab confirmation details or a source of infection. No death toll or broader outbreak context is provided in the report.
