article.articleHeadline: Ebola salgınında korkutan tablo: Vaka sayısı 5 bin 794'e yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A worrying picture of the Ebola outbreak: the number of cases has risen to 5,794.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is intensifying, with 5,794 confirmed cases and 2,786 deaths as of 26 August 2026. The World Health Organization reports the virus has reached 60 health zones across 6 provinces, indicating expanded geographic spread in recent months. The updated assessment notes a significant increase in both case numbers and areas affected. Following the 18 August Emergency Committee meeting, the outbreak remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), reflecting its international public health significance and the need for sustained global and national response efforts to control transmission. These figures reflect the WHO's latest assessment as of 26 August 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、憂慮すべき状況：症例数が5,794人に増加
triage.triage_reason: PHEIC継続中の大規模エボラ流行で、致死率が高く6州60保健地域に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOにより2026年8月18日にPHEICとして緊急委員会が開催され、継続認定されている。致死率は約48%と高い。

article.articleHeadline: 125 OFWs test positive for HIV in Q2 2026
article.articleSummary: 125 overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) tested positive for HIV in the second quarter of 2026 (April–June), per the Philippines Department of Health HIV and AIDS Surveillance report. In total, 124 of the new cases (99%) were acquired through sexual contact; one case lacked transmission data. By mode of sexual contact, 85 infections were among men who have sex with men; 15 involved both men and women; and 24 involved men and women. Since 1984, DOH records show 11,703 HIV cases among migrant workers. The report does not specify country of infection or export/import details. These figures indicate ongoing transmission linked to sexual contact among migrant workers, underscoring the need for targeted prevention, testing, and access to HIV services for OFWs in the Philippines.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年第2四半期、海外フィリピン人労働者125人がHIV陽性
triage.triage_reason: HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり、通常の定期サーベイランス報告であって、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・緊急対応の必要性は認められない。
triage.notes: 定期的なHIV/AIDSサーベイランス報告であり、新興感染症や急性アウトブレイクではないため、EBSシグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 衞生署稱季節性流感仍維持高水平　學校或爆發流感呼籲提高警惕
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Health says seasonal influenza remains at a high level; schools could experience influenza outbreaks, urging heightened vigilance.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza remains at a high level in Hong Kong as of late June, with 11 pediatric severe influenza cases: 8 recovered, 2 critical, 1 death. Community transmission is widespread and severe cases are rising, with schools at risk of outbreaks at the start of the 2026/27 school year. The Department of Health urges schools and parents to heighten vigilance and adopt preventive measures, and to participate in the 2026/27 Seasonal Influenza Vaccination School Outreach Programme. Parents should use the newly launched electronic consent form via the Medical and Health Connect system to complete consent early, enabling earlier vaccination planning; if schools do not participate, vaccinate at private clinics under the Vaccination Subsidy Scheme when the programme begins. COVID-19 activity has risen since June, peaked in early August, then declined; two pediatric severe COVID-19 cases, both unvaccinated. RSV activity has a slight uptick but remains below previous peaks.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生署、季節性インフルエンザは依然高水準と発表　学校での流行拡大の可能性、警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 香港における季節性インフルエンザの高水準continueと小児重症例（死亡1例含む）が報告されているが、例年の季節性流行の範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。学校再開に伴う流行拡大の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 香港は対象国リストにないためChina (1814991)に含めた。季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行パターンであり、公衆衛生当局による定例的な注意喚起・ワクチン接種推進の内容。COVID-19・RSVも言及されているが同様に季節性の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Perkuat Penanganan Malaria di Riau, Dokter dan Pengelola Program Dilatih Tata Laksana Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strengthen Malaria Management in Riau, Doctors and Program Managers Trained in Case Management.
article.articleSummary: Malaria management training was held in Rokan Hilir Regency, Riau Province, Indonesia, to strengthen case management among malaria program officers and doctors across Rohil. The event, hosted at the Rohil Health Office hall and opened by Rohil Health Office head Ners Afridah, S.Kep., M.Kes, aims to improve case finding, diagnosis, treatment, and patient monitoring, recognizing Rohil as the province’s malaria burden hotspot. Annual case counts in Rohil have run in the thousands: 2,711 in 2023; 2,449 in 2024; 2,858 in 2025; and over 2,600 by the end of August 2026. The trainer emphasizes that malaria prevention must extend beyond facilities, targeting home and community environments. Anopheles mosquitoes, active from dusk to pre-dawn, increase risk during night-time outdoor activities, so residents are advised to wear covered clothing and apply insect repellent to reduce exposure.

triage.headline_ja: リアウ州でマラリア対策を強化、医師とプログラム管理者に症例対応の研修実施
triage.triage_reason: 既知のマラリア流行地における通常の能力強化研修に関する記事であり、異常な増加や新規のアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: ロカンヒリル県は既知のマラリア流行ホットスポットであり、症例数も過去数年と同水準で推移。地域保健当局による定例的な能力強化活動と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू में बुखार उतरने के बाद भी खतरा क्यों बढ़ सकता है खतरा, किन लक्षणों को न करें नजरअंदाज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Why can the risk increase even after fever subsides, and which symptoms should not be ignored?
article.articleSummary: Dengue infections in India are rising in parts of the country during the rainy season. While fever typically lasts a few days, the illness can worsen after fever subsides: most concerning between day 3 and day 7, when capillary leakage can reduce blood pressure and trigger severe illness. For patients with a positive dengue test whose fever is falling, ongoing vigilance is essential. Warning signs requiring immediate hospital evaluation include severe abdominal pain, recurrent vomiting, bleeding from the nose or gums, blood in vomit or stool, marked weakness or restlessness, shortness of breath, or reduced urine output. Platelet counts should ideally stay above 40,000–50,000 per microliter, but dengue severity is not determined by platelets alone; blood pressure, urine output, and other laboratory parameters matter. If platelet levels dip below the recommended range, platelet transfusion may be needed. The piece originates from Yashoda Medical City Hospital and discusses prevention.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：解熱後もリスクが高まるのはなぜか、見逃してはいけない症状とは
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱に関する一般的な健康啓発・注意喚起記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事は病院発の健康啓発コンテンツであり、具体的な発生数や異常な流行状況の報告はないため、対象国リストへの該当は認めるがピックアップ対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: 衛生防護中心料開學初期流感持續活躍　提醒學校及家長採取適當措施 (16:00) - 20260830
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Centre for Health Protection expects influenza to remain active at the start of the school term; reminds schools and parents to take appropriate measures (16:00) - 20260830
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong faces a persistent influenza season as schools reopen, with the Center for Health Protection (CHP) reporting high activity. Since late June, 11 severe pediatric influenza cases have been recorded: 8 recovered, 2 in critical condition, 1 death. The CHP has written to all schools via the Education Bureau urging risk-reduction measures; if schools do not join outreach, parents should arrange their children’s vaccination under the 2026/27 seasonal influenza vaccination program at private clinics participating in the vaccine subsidy after the program starts. Vaccination is emphasized as the best protection against seasonal influenza, COVID-19, and complications, reducing hospitalizations and deaths. Those with respiratory symptoms should wear surgical masks, avoid crowded places, seek medical advice early, and maintain hand hygiene. As of 27 August, Hong Kong has 28 dengue cases and 2 imported chikungunya cases; hand-foot-and-mouth disease remains active but has declined, though school and care-home reopenings may trigger sporadic outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生防護中心、新学期初期のインフルエンザ活発化が継続すると予測　学校・保護者に適切な対策を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの活動が新学期に伴い持続しており、重症小児例・死亡例も報告されているが、香港では例年見られる季節的パターンであり、当局が既に通常のサーベイランス・対策を実施している段階のため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 香港の季節性インフルエンザに関する定例サーベイランス報告。重症小児例11件（回復8、重体2、死亡1）が報告されているが、季節性の予測範囲内の事象であり、当局は教育局を通じた通常の予防対策を実施済み。デング熱28例、チクングニア熱2例（輸入）、手足口病の活動も言及されているが、いずれも異常な増加や国際的拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: 新學年開學在即 衞生防護中心籲預防傳染病｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The new school year is about to begin; the Centre for Health Protection urges prevention of infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong’s Centre for Health Protection warns that the new school year begins as ongoing respiratory and mosquito-borne outbreaks persist. With the influenza season in full swing, CHP urges participation in the 2026/27 seasonal influenza vaccine school outreach and consent via the e-health form to speed up school vaccination plans. Since late June, 11 pediatric influenza severe cases have been reported: 8 recovered, 2 critical, and 1 death. COVID-19 activity rose from June to an early August peak, then declined, including two pediatric severe cases, both unvaccinated. RSV shows a modest uptick but remains below prior peaks. The CHP stresses vaccination as the best protection against influenza and COVID-19. Mosquito-borne disease: 28 dengue cases (as of 27 Aug) – 26 imported, 2 locally acquired; 2 imported chikungunya. HFMD activity peaked Jun-Jul; post-reopening risk persists; affected children should stay home until cured. Schools should report outbreaks and follow preventive guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: 新学年開始が間近に迫る中、衛生防護中心が感染症予防を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 香港衛生当局による新学年開始に伴う季節性感染症（インフルエンザ、COVID-19、RSV、デング熱等）予防の定例的な呼びかけであり、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 小児インフルエンザ重症例11件（うち死亡1件）およびCOVID-19小児重症例2件が報告されているが、季節性の通常範囲内とみられる。デング熱・チクングニアは大半が輸入症例であり、地域内での持続的伝播の兆候は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: 流感｜6月至今11宗兒童嚴重個案　衞生署料開學仍活躍　籲打疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza — 11 severe pediatric cases since June; Department of Health expects activity to continue as schools reopen; urges vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong’s Centre for Health Protection reports that influenza season, begun in late June, has yielded 11 severe pediatric influenza cases, with 8 recovered, 2 critical, and 1 death. As schools reopen, influenza activity is expected to stay high and potential in-school outbreaks may occur. Vaccination is urged via the annual seasonal influenza school outreach program, and the new electronic consent form should speed up consent; if schools do not participate, parents should arrange vaccination for their children at private clinics under the vaccine subsidy scheme. Since June, 2 severe pediatric COVID-19 cases have been recorded, both unvaccinated. RSV activity has slightly risen but remains below peak levels. Dengue fever has 28 cases in Hong Kong as of August 27, with 2 imported chikungunya cases. Schools are advised to strengthen mosquito control—eliminate standing water, weekly plant watering, cover water containers, keep drainage clear—and appoint staff for campus vector-control per FEHD guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ｜6月から現在までに小児重症例11件　衛生署は新学期以降も流行が続くと予測、ワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 香港における季節性インフルエンザの定例サーベイランス報告であり、活動増加は例年想定される範囲内で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの定例報告。小児重症例と死亡1例が含まれるが、香港の毎年の流行パターンの範囲内であり、COVID-19、RSV、デング熱、チクングニア熱についても通常の監視情報として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: बालाघाट के मछुरदा से कुंडेकसा तक बीमारियों का खौफ, अब तक 10 बच्चों की मौत, जांच रिपोर्ट का इंतजार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fear of diseases from Machurdha in Balaghat to Kundeksa; 10 children have died so far, awaiting the investigation report.
article.articleSummary: Balaghat district in Madhya Pradesh reports a deadly cluster affecting Baiga tribal communities, with 10 children dead and several others hospitalized. The hotspots include Machurdha, Adori, Bundari, Korka, and especially Kundeksa, where authorities have set up a temporary hospital inside a government school. Health workers report co-circulating diseases—fungal infection, malaria, typhoid, and cholera—as they conduct door-to-door health surveillance and collect samples for laboratory confirmation; results are pending. Opposition claims government undercounts fatalities; the official figure stands at 10 deaths. Chief Minister Dr. Mohan Yadav visited the area, announcing Rs 2 lakh aid per affected family and ordering enhanced health facilities and a high-level investigation. Tribal protests demand accountability and compensation; authorities are monitoring for further cases and coordinating the investigation.

triage.headline_ja: バラガート地区マチュルダからクンデクサまで疫病の恐怖、これまでに子供10人死亡、調査報告待ち
triage.triage_reason: インド・マディヤプラデーシュ州の部族地域で子供10人が死亡する原因不明の疾病クラスターが発生し、真菌感染症・マラリア・チフス・コレラが混在して報告されており、政府の緊急対応と社会的関心も高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 原因病原体が特定されておらず、複数疾患（真菌感染症、マラリア、チフス、コレラ）が同時報告されている点が異常。検査結果待ちのため続報の確認が必要。Chadの地域情報は記事の主題と無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: India News | Jharkhand on High Alert over Swine Flu; Health Minister Directs Hospitals to Reserve Beds, Ramp Up Surveillance
article.articleSummary: Jharkhand Health Department has placed the state on high alert for potential H1N1 (Swine Flu) cases. Health Minister Irfan Ansari directed district surveillance officers to intensify vigilance, testing, and prompt reporting, with senior officials including Additional Chief Secretary Ajay Kumar present. To strengthen preparedness, 10 additional beds must be reserved in all medical college hospitals (including Rajendra Institute of Medical Sciences, Ranchi) and in all Sadar Hospitals across districts. Hospitals must ensure adequate medical oxygen, essential medicines, diagnostics, and ICU/HDU readiness, supported by trained medical and paramedical staff. Intensified monitoring of Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) and Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) is mandated for early detection and intervention. Heightened transit-point surveillance at airports, railways, and bus stands will include clinical evaluations and testing where needed. Authorities urge calm and timely medical consultation to prevent swine flu deaths.

triage.headline_ja: インド:ジャールカンド州で豚インフルエンザに対し高度警戒、保健大臣が病院に病床確保と監視強化を指示
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1に対する行政の予防的対応であり、重症例数や死亡者数など深刻性を示す具体的情報が不足しているため、現時点ではフルRRAへの移行基準に達しない。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の疾患であり、州保健当局による予防的な監視・病床確保対応が主な内容。具体的な症例数・死亡数・クラスター発生などの記載がなく、深刻性の判断材料が不足している。続報で症例数増加や重症化情報が出れば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: As the world gets drier, cholera, West Nile, and dengue can thrive, study finds
article.articleSummary: Dry conditions can both reduce some waterborne diseases and increase others, a drought-disease paradox linking drought with rises in cholera, West Nile virus, and dengue. A review of nearly 100 studies in Trends in Ecology and Evolution notes that during drought, cholera, West Nile virus, and dengue may spread, while malaria and schistosomiasis may decline. Notable examples: Somalia's 2017 drought coinciding with about 80,000 cholera cases; California's 2000s drought with thousands of valley fever cases; the 2014 California drought tied to its second-highest West Nile virus tally; in Brazil, dengue risk can rise in months after drought. Mechanisms include animals changing movements and clustering at scarce water sources, shifting aquatic systems, and mosquito population changes. Policy implications: enhanced satellite monitoring and drought planning that integrates disease prevention and careful water management.

triage.headline_ja: 世界が乾燥するにつれ、コレラ、ウエストナイル熱、デング熱が蔓延する可能性があると研究が指摘
triage.triage_reason: 特定の急性発生イベントではなく、干ばつと感染症リスクの関連性に関する学術レビュー記事であり、対象国における現在進行中の具体的な発生事例を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究のレビュー記事であり、過去の事例（2017年ソマリア干ばつ時のコレラ、米国カリフォルニアのウエストナイル熱、ブラジルのデング熱リスク）を引用した一般的な知見の紹介。対象国リストの中ではブラジルが言及されているが、これも過去の傾向についての言及であり、現在進行中の発生シグナルではない。米国カリフォルニア州とソマリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Jharkhand on high alert over swine flu; beds reserved in hospitals
article.articleSummary: Jharkhand on high alert for H1N1 (swine flu) as of August 30, 2026, with Health Minister Irfan Ansari directing strengthened surveillance, testing and hospital preparedness. Ten additional beds will be reserved in all medical college hospitals, including Ranchi’s Rajendra Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS), and in Sadar Hospitals across districts, with assured oxygen, medicines and ICU/HDU readiness. Authorities will intensify monitoring of Influenza-Like Illness (ILI) and Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) and ensure prompt reporting. A high-level review chaired by Additional Chief Secretary Ajay Kumar underscored timely identification, testing, treatment and referrals. Transit-point surveillance at airports, railway stations and bus stands will screen individuals with fever, cough, sore throat or respiratory distress, enabling testing and immediate care. Officials urge citizens not to panic but to seek timely medical advice if symptoms appear, to prevent fatalities from swine flu.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州、豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）に対し厳戒態勢―病院にベッド確保
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1に対する予防的な監視強化・病床確保の発表であり、現時点で重症患者数や死亡者数など具体的な公衆衛生上の深刻性を示す情報がないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: H1N1は既知の季節性インフルエンザであり、記事は州保健当局による監視強化・病床確保などの予防的対応を報じているのみで、実際の患者数・重症度データは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: हिमाचल में स्वाइन फ्लू से बुजुर्ग की मौत के बाद स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट, परिवार आइसोलेट; पड़ोसी भी निगरानी में - himachal swine flu death mandi elder dies family isolated
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health department on alert after an elderly person dies of swine flu in Himachal Pradesh; family isolated; neighbors under surveillance
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (influenza A H1N1) death in Himachal Pradesh prompts health-alert. As of 30 August 2026, a 70-year-old cancer patient, Mahendra from Dadyal in Sundernagar tehsil, Mandi district, died in Chandigarh hospital after testing positive for swine flu. Chandigarh administration informed the Mandi health team, which reached his home, isolated the family, and barred outsiders. The cremation was conducted under health-department supervision, after which relatives were provided masks and cautions to prevent transmission. Nearby areas and wards are on alert; residents instructed to report sudden fever, headache, body ache, fatigue, coughing blood, vomiting, or diarrhea. District hospitals have been directed to test suspected cases promptly. Some family members reside in other states but were together in Chandigarh for treatment. Earlier reports indicated swine flu cases in Himachal with advisories in place.

triage.headline_ja: ヒマーチャル・プラデーシュ州で高齢者がスワインフルーで死亡、保健当局が警戒；家族を隔離、近隣住民も監視下に
triage.triage_reason: H1N1（スワインフル）による単発の死亡例で、地元保健当局が標準的な隔離・監視対応を実施している。季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であり国際的拡大の兆候はないが、地域内で継続的な症例報告があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 70歳のがん患者が基礎疾患を有していた状態でH1N1陽性となり死亡。地元保健当局による隔離・監視は標準的な対応であり、大規模な集団感染や重症化の急増を示す情報はない。過去にもヒマーチャル州でスワインフル症例の報告があるとされ、地域内での継続的な発生動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : les premières vaccinations démarrent à Kisangani
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: The First Vaccinations Begin in Kisangani.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues since mid-May, with Kisangani in Tshopo Province initiating a vaccination campaign. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is currently no vaccine or treatment. The Ervebo vaccine, proven safe and effective against the Zaïre strain—the more common lineage of Ebola—is being deployed in Kisangani, even though it does not correspond to the circulating strain. In one vaccination center, 122 people were vaccinated on Thursday, and 128 additional doses were received on Friday as vaccination operations continued. Officials emphasize that vaccination builds antibodies and protection. Since May 15, the DRC has reported more than 5,600 confirmed Ebola cases and over 2,700 deaths, underscoring the ongoing public health emergency and focus on Kisangani.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国、キサンガニでワクチン接種開始
triage.triage_reason: 5,600例以上の確定症例、2,700人以上の死亡者を伴う大規模かつ継続中のエボラ流行であり、稀なブンディブギョ株に対するワクチン・治療法が存在しない状況でザイール株用ワクチンを転用接種している点で異常性・深刻性が高い。
triage.notes: 流行株（ブンディブギョ株）に対する承認ワクチンが存在せず、ザイール株用のErvebo（rVSV-ZEBOV）を代替使用している点はリスク評価上重要な情報であり、続報でのワクチン有効性データ確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DRC launches Ebola vaccination campaign as outbreak continues to spread
article.articleSummary: Kisangani, DR Congo, launches an Ebola vaccination drive as the eastern outbreak intensifies. The Bundibugyo strain is driving the transmission, with no vaccines or treatments approved specifically for Bundibugyo, though the Ervebo vaccine, approved for other Ebola strains, is being used in hopes of partial protection. Frontline workers and healthcare staff are among the first recipients as residents line up for shots. Since mid-May, eastern DRC has recorded more than 5,600 confirmed Ebola cases and over 2,700 deaths. The government plans to distribute about 70,000 vaccine doses to bolster the response in what is described as the country’s worst-ever Ebola outbreak. The campaign aims to curb transmission and protect frontline responders as vaccination coverage scales up.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、感染拡大が続くエボラ出血熱に対しワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（5,600例以上、死者2,700人超）が継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による流行で承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないため、既存ワクチン（Ervebo）を部分的防御目的で使用している点がリスク評価上の重要ポイント。

article.articleHeadline: Swine Flu Alert In Purvanchal: 18 Active Cases Reported Across 8 Districts; Health Dept Steps Up Surveillance
article.articleSummary: Swine flu alert in Purvanchal, Uttar Pradesh: 18 active cases across eight districts (Varanasi 4; Ghazipur 1; Jaunpur 2; Mirzapur 2; Sonbhadra 2; Azamgarh 3; Mau 2; Ballia 1). Pt Deendayal Upadhyay Hospital has 24 reserved beds for swine flu patients (6 women, 12 children, 6 men); a separate 10-bed isolation ward is available at the divisional hospital. The CMO directed officials to strengthen surveillance, ensure timely identification, examination and treatment, and upload patient details to the district portal. Common symptoms include high fever, cough/sore throat, runny nose, headache, body and muscle aches, fatigue; vomiting or diarrhea in some cases. Precautions: frequent hand hygiene, masks, avoiding crowded places with symptoms, maintain distance, proper disposal of tissues, rest and fluids, and avoiding self-medication. Prof. Puneet Kumar, MS, Sir Sunderlal Hospital, BHU, said 2–3 admissions daily; 15 admitted, 5 discharged, 10 under treatment. As of 2026-08-30.

triage.headline_ja: プールヴァーンチャルで豚インフルエンザ警戒:8地区で18件の活動性症例、保健当局が監視強化
triage.triage_reason: インドUP州で季節性のH1N1（豚インフルエンザ）症例が複数地区で報告されているが、既知の疾患であり死亡報告もなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。ヒト-ヒト感染する季節性疾患のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の地域的流行と考えられ、既に地元保健当局が病床確保・サーベイランス強化などの対応を実施中。死亡例の報告はなく、重症度・異常性ともに低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: एमपी में तेजी से पैर पसार रहा खसरा और मलेरिया, बालाघाट में 26 बच्चों की मौत, 125 मामलों के साथ भिंड पहले स्थान पर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles and malaria spreading rapidly in Madhya Pradesh; 26 children dead in Balaghat, Bhind ranks first with 125 cases.
article.articleSummary: By August 2026, Madhya Pradesh faces a measles and malaria–linked outbreak, with Balaghat noting 26 child deaths, Bhind leading with 125 measles cases, and Shivpuri and Gwalior each around 90. Statewide, 1,450+ cases have been reported in 2026, following 2025’s 1,800; eight months in, the total already surpasses that figure, projected to reach about 2,500 by year-end. Measles outbreaks peak in summer, with a second wave anticipated from September. Symptoms include cold, high fever, and red rash; untreated cases carry up to a 30% mortality risk and can cause malnutrition and other complications, with malaria also spreading. Transmission can from one case infect up to 20 people. Effective control relies on rapid case identification, timely treatment, and vaccination campaigns informed by field surveys to verify immunization status; CMHO alerts are essential. Vaccination is the most effective prevention.

triage.headline_ja: MP州で麻疹とマラリアが急速に拡大、バラガートで子供26人死亡、ビハインドが125症例でトップ
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹による小児死亡26人と症例数の急増（前年を上回るペース）が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・マディヤプラデーシュ州（バラガート、ビハインド、シブプリ、グワリオル）における麻疹・マラリア流行に関するもの。国際的拡大や渡航制限の言及はなし。ワクチン接種状況の実地調査やCMHOによる警戒対応が進行中とされるが、外部支援要請の有無は不明。

article.articleHeadline: भोपाल में मानसून में बढ़ा डेंगू का खतरा, अगस्त में मरीज दोगुने से ज्यादा; जलभराव से मच्छरों ने बढ़ाई चिंता
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue risk rises in Bhopal during the monsoon; in August, cases more than double, waterlogging increases concerns due to mosquitoes.
article.articleSummary: Dengue risk rises in Bhopal during the monsoon, with August cases raising concern, though Jan 1–Aug 25 totals indicate some control. Dengue: 71 cases this year, up from 63 in the same period last year. Chikungunya: 22 cases this year, down from 58 by Aug 25 last year, suggesting no major outbreak and reflecting rainfall effects rather than spread. The surge is linked to heavy monsoon rains and stagnant water in vacant plots, pots, and rooftop containers, providing mosquito breeding habitats; enhanced sampling and surveillance by the health department also raises counts. The National Centre for Vector Borne Disease Control (NCVBDC) and local doctors warn residents to eliminate standing water around homes and on terraces. If fever or body pains occur, avoid self-medication; seek medical evaluation and blood testing, and wear long sleeves.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン期にボパールでデング熱リスク増加、8月の患者数は前年から倍増以上、水たまりが蚊の懸念を助長
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・チクングニヤの通常の増減報告であり、チクングニヤは前年より減少、デング熱も「大規模な流行ではない」と記事内で明言されており、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: モンスーン期の恒例的なベクター媒介感染症報道であり、地方紙による季節性注意喚起記事。チクングニヤは前年より大幅減少しており、デング熱も局地的・管理可能な範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: In a Drier World, Some Infectious Diseases Are Unexpectedly Thriving
article.articleSummary: Drought-disease paradox: a drier world can amplify certain infections while suppressing others. Reduced water concentrates hosts and pathogens at shrinking sources, altering movement and increasing transmission across humans, wildlife, and insects. Diseases such as cholera, West Nile virus, and dengue can rise after drought, while schistosomiasis and malaria may fall. Examples include California valley fever outbreaks tied to 2000s droughts and a 2014 West Nile spike; Somalia’s 2017 drought-linked cholera with about 80,000 cases and over 1,000 deaths; and Brazil’s dengue risk increasing post-drought. Mechanisms include crowding at drying watering holes boosting fecal-oral parasite spread, closer contact between birds and mosquitoes, and warmer, more hospitable water for mold, algae, and bacteria. The trend aligns with climate-driven droughts—river lows in Europe (Danube, Rhine) and water shortages in Puerto Rico and Italy—and a UN note that the world is significantly drier than three decades ago.

triage.headline_ja: より乾燥した世界で、一部の感染症が予想外に蔓延している
triage.triage_reason: 気候変動と感染症の関係を論じる一般的な解説記事であり、特定の対象国における新規または進行中のアウトブレイクの報告ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は米国・欧州・ソマリア・ブラジル・プエルトリコ等の過去事例（2000年代〜2017年）を用いた干ばつと感染症の関連性に関する総説記事。対象国リストに含まれる国（ブラジル）は言及されるが、過去のデング熱リスク増加の一例として触れられているのみで、現在進行中の具体的アウトブレイク情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: The death toll in the Ebola outbreak in Congo has risen to 2,786.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 5,794 confirmed cases and 2,786 deaths, according to WHO as of 2026-08-26. The outbreak’s geographic spread has accelerated, now affecting 60 health zones across 6 provinces, with case numbers rising and spread widening over the past three months. The WHO Emergency Committee met on August 18 and recommended continuing the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), a status that remains in effect. The situation highlights ongoing international public health concern and the need for sustained surveillance, reporting, and response measures under WHO guidance and coordination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行による死者数が2,786人に増加
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを継続と判断するほどの大規模流行で、症例数・死亡者数が増加し地理的拡大も加速しているため、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクの複数のIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: WHOによりPHEICが継続中であり、60保健地域・6州に拡大している大規模アウトブレイク。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda finally gets Ebola clearance from WHO
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Uganda linked to cross-border transmission from the Democratic Republic of Congo ended with WHO and Africa CDC declaring Uganda Ebola-free on Aug. 27, 2026 after a 42-day period without a new confirmed case. The May 15 outbreak comprised 20 confirmed cases (15 imported from DRC, 5 locally acquired among contacts and health workers); 18 recovered, 2 died. Over 800 contacts were identified and monitored. Uganda argued that a fully characterized importation, known infection source, reconstructed transmission chains, and advances in molecular diagnostics, genomic sequencing, digital surveillance, and real-time contact tracing justify considering epidemiological certainty alongside the 42-day rule, though WHO maintains the 42-day countdown as the international standard. The last imported patient was discharged July 16; the international end was declared Aug. 27.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、WHOからエボラ終息宣言を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はウガンダにおけるエボラ流行の終息（WHO・Africa CDCによる公式宣言）を報じるものであり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威ではなく既に収束済みの事案である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのアウトブレイク終息であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは感染源として言及されているが、DRC国内での発生状況自体は記事の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: InfoGripe: Roraima e mais dois estados têm incidência de SRAG com sinal de crescimento | Roraima em Foco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: InfoGripe: Roraima and two more states have SARS incidence with signs of growth | Roraima in Focus
article.articleSummary: Roraima, Alagoas, and Mato Grosso show increasing Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) in week 33 (Aug 16–22) per Fiocruz InfoGripe, with incidence at alert/risk/high-risk levels. Growth is focused on children: 2–4 years in Mato Grosso and Roraima; 2–14 years in Alagoas. Rhinovirus is the leading suspect; metapneumovirus detected at lower levels, but laboratory confirmation is limited. SARI in under-2s declines, linked to fewer RSV hospitalizations; declines in other age groups tied to fewer influenza hospitalizations. Eight states remain at alert/risk/high risk without clear long-term growth: Amazonas, Mato Grosso do Sul, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina, Sergipe. Capitals Aracaju, Belém, Boa Vista, and João Pessoa show ongoing SARI activity at alert/risk/high risk with long-term growth over six weeks. Nationally, 141,009 SARI cases in 2026, 54% lab-confirmed; 42% RSV, 30.4% rhinovirus, 17.9% influenza A, 5.4% influenza B, 3.9% SARS-CoV-2. COVID-19 incidence remains low; influenza A seasonality has ended.

triage.headline_ja: InfoGripe:ロライマ州など3州でSARG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）発生率が増加傾向
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の複数州で季節性呼吸器感染症（SARI）の増加が報告されているが、通常の季節性サーベイランスの範囲内であり、国際的拡大や重篤性の急増を示す明確な根拠はない。
triage.notes: 定例のFiocruz InfoGripeサーベイランス報告であり、ライノウイルス・RSV・インフルエンザ等複数病原体による季節性SARI増加。特定の新規病原体や異常なクラスターの兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: 계절이 사라졌다... 한여름에 감기 유행, 일본은 독감 '전국 유행' 선언
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The seasons have disappeared... A midsummer outbreak of the common cold; Japan declares the flu a nationwide outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Aug 30, 2026: Korea reports rising SARS-CoV-2 activity with 9.1% positivity across sentinel clinics (week 33) and four straight weeks of higher COVID-19 hospitalizations (23→56). Predominant circulating lineages include BA.3.2, NB.1.8.1, PQ16.1.1 and RF.5. China experiences a July surge (~522,000 new cases) and influenza-like illness outpatients testing positive for SARS-CoV-2 at 21.2% across 1,041 surveillance hospitals. In Japan, the Ministry of Health declares a nationwide influenza outbreak in August—earlier than the usual winter season—recording 4,094 cases across roughly 3,000 sentinel facilities (threshold: at least 1 case per facility). Early flu onset is linked to extreme heat, humidity shifts, and indoor crowding. Officials warn that symptoms overlap with COVID-19 and summer colds, advocating vigilant testing, flexible public-health responses, and personal precautions during travel around holidays.

triage.headline_ja: 季節感が消えた…真夏にかぜが流行、日本ではインフルエンザ『全国流行』を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 韓国・中国・日本の複数国で季節外れのCOVID-19・インフルエンザ流行が同時進行しており、異常性と既に国際的な拡大が確認されているためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 韓国・日本は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。中国は7月の症例急増と外来陽性率21.2%が記事の主題の一部として明記されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Rumah Sehat BAZNAS Sahabat Paru untuk Pasien TBC RO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BAZNAS Healthy Home: Lung Friends for Rifampicin-Resistant TB Patients
article.articleSummary: Tangerang, Indonesia — On 30 August 2026, the Tangerang City Health Department, in collaboration with BAZNAS Tangerang, opened Rumah Sehat BAZNAS Sahabat Paru (BAZNAS Healthy Home: Lung Friends) to support rifampicin-resistant tuberculosis (RR-TB) patients. The facility provides temporary housing for RR-TB patients in stable condition and aims to ease care during treatment. It has three rooms with a capacity of two patients each (six total). Each patient can stay for a two-week period and receive two weeks of anti-TB medication during the stay. The program illustrates a public health measure to ensure structured care and adherence for RR-TB patients in the Tangerang area.

triage.headline_ja: BAZNAS健康の家：リファンピシン耐性結核患者のための「肺の友」施設
triage.triage_reason: 既存の耐性結核対策としての支援施設開設を伝える内容であり、新規の異常発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の結核対策プログラムに関する通常業務報告であり、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Tailandia: Aumento dei casi di Covid-19 e malattie respiratorie nel paese
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand: Increase in COVID-19 cases and respiratory diseases in the country.
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports a rise in COVID-19 and other respiratory illnesses through Jan 1–Aug 28, 2026, with 95,357 SARS-CoV-2 infections and 14 deaths. The dominant NB.1.8.1 lineage is driving the COVID surge, alongside increases in influenza and RSV. Data come from the Department of Disease Control’s Digital Disease Surveillance System; the Department of Medical Sciences also compiles variant information. Officials attribute the uptick to climate change and seasonal transmission patterns that can spark local clusters across settings. The Bangkok Post cites the findings. Public-health guidance urges individuals with respiratory symptoms to limit contact and seek medical advice if symptoms worsen. Agencies involved include the Department of Disease Control and the Department of Medical Sciences.

triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19・インフルエンザ・RSV増加を報告する定例サーベイランス情報であり、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候は乏しいが、症例数増加のため経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: Swine flu alert in UP: Deputy CM reviews situation, flags hospital preparedness in four districts
article.articleSummary: Swine flu in Uttar Pradesh prompts heightened hospital readiness as of 30 August 2026. Deputy Chief Minister and Health Minister Brajesh Pathak chaired a video conference with CMOs and CMSs to assess the state's response, inspecting the HOPE control center in Lucknow. Officials flagged inadequate arrangements in Barabanki, Shravasti, Jhansi and Gorakhpur and were instructed to stock Oseltamivir (Tamiflu), oxygen, nebulisers, oxygen masks, and bronchodilators, and to ensure flu testing for seriously ill patients with breathing difficulties. Close contacts of influenza-like illness should be monitored and started on antiviral therapy as advised. In districts with more flu cases, hospitals should run separate OPDs for respiratory complaints; four to six isolation beds per district; separate fever/flu registration counters. Enhanced surveillance along Nepal borders with expedited care for patients arriving from Nepal and Uttar Pradesh.

article.articleHeadline: Bilaspur: 76 पशुओं ने जीती लंपी वायरस से जंग, 50 का इलाज जारी; 5 ने गंवाई जान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bilaspur: 76 animals beat Lumpy Skin Disease; treatment for 50 is ongoing; 5 have died.
article.articleSummary: 131 animals in Bilaspur district, Himachal Pradesh, have contracted Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD); 5 deaths reported. 76 animals have recovered after treatment; about 50 remain under care. To halt spread, the veterinary department has launched a vaccination drive targeting 17,079 susceptible animals; 7,371 have been vaccinated so far. LSD is a highly contagious viral disease affecting cattle and buffalo, spread mainly by biting insects such as flies, mosquitoes, and ticks. Symptoms include sudden high fever, nodular skin lesions around the head, neck, legs, udders and genitals, persistent eye and nasal discharge, reduced appetite, weakness, and a sharp drop in milk production. There is no specific antiviral treatment; care is supportive, with emphasis on isolation, ample water and nutrition, wound cleanliness, and fly control. Authorities continue surveillance and aim to complete vaccination of remaining susceptible animals.

triage.headline_ja: ビラスプル：ランピースキン病から76頭の家畜が回復、50頭が治療中、5頭が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 動物のみに影響する家畜疾患（ランピースキン病）であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響がなく、IHR・WPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 人獣共通感染症ではなく、ヒトへの感染例の報告なし。家畜のみの疾患であるため公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。地元獣医当局によりワクチン接種活動が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: La primera pandemia de la historia: la plaga que mató a 50 millones de personas y cambió las fronteras del mundo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first pandemic in history: the plague that killed 50 million people and changed the borders of the world.
article.articleSummary: Plague of Justinian, the first documented pandemic, was caused by Yersinia pestis and likely originated in the Tian Shan mountains on the Kyrgyzstan-Kazakhstan-China frontier. From there it spread along land and sea routes to the Mediterranean, with Pelusium in the Nile delta marking the first documented entry into the Roman world around 541. Transmission occurred as infected black rats aboard grain ships carried fleas to humans. Procopius of Cesarea described sudden fever, buboes, delirium; at the peak Constantinople reportedly suffered up to 10,000 deaths per day (historians estimate closer to 5,000). Overall, 20-40% of Constantinople's population died, and mass graves were used. Economic and military effects were profound: grain shortages, tax revenue collapse, the Byzantine army weakened, facilitating Lombard invasion of northern Italy in 568. The plague contributed to the shift from Antiquity to the Middle Ages, with Arabs seizing Egypt and Syria in the 7th century.

triage.headline_ja: 史上初のパンデミック：5000万人を死に至らしめ世界の国境を変えたペスト
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は6世紀のユスティニアヌスのペストに関する歴史的解説記事であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではないため、シグナルとして扱う必要はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は541年に発生したユスティニアヌスのペスト（史上初のパンデミック）についての歴史解説記事であり、現代の公衆衛生イベントではない。Bluedotが付与した発生地域（トルコ、エジプト、キルギス、中国等）はいずれも歴史的文脈上の地名であり、現在の感染症発生を示すものではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Jharkhand Sounds Swine Flu Alert After 8 H1N1 Cases; Hospitals Ramp Up Testing and Surveillance - The Logical Indian
article.articleSummary: Eight people tested positive for H1N1 influenza in August at Rajendra Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS), Ranchi, Jharkhand, prompting a August 29 Health Department alert to bolster surveillance, screening, testing and treatment. Of 11 samples tested at RIMS in August, eight were positive (72.7%). From January–August, RIMS tested 26 samples for H1N1 and H3N2; all eight positives occurred in August. Six patients have recovered; two remain under treatment; no influenza-related deaths reported yet. Earlier, six H1N1 cases were reported among four schoolchildren and two teachers at a residential school in Ranchi. In response, Health Minister Irfan Ansari directed at least 10 additional isolation beds across RIMS, medical colleges and Sadar hospitals, and testing capacity at RIMS and MGM Medical College in Jamshedpur; stocks of N95 and triple-layer masks, PPE, viral transport medium kits, oxygen and ventilators; expanded ILI/SARI screening and surveillance at airports, railway stations and other crowded places. As of 30 August 2026, officials urge calm and timely care.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州、H1N1感染8例を受け豚インフルエンザ警戒発令；病院が検査・監視体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザの局地的な集団発生で死亡例はなく回復も進んでいるが、学校・病院での集団感染がありヒト-ヒト感染や監視強化の動きがあるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であり、州レベルで対応が完結している。死亡例なし、8例中6例回復済み。学校・病院でのクラスター発生があり監視強化中だが、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: দক্ষিণবঙ্গে বাড়ছে ডেঙ্গি ও ম্যালেরিয়া আক্রান্তের সংখ্যা, রাজ্যে ১ মাসে নতুন করে আক্রান্ত ১ হাজার!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue and malaria cases rising in South Bengal, 1,000 new infections in a month in the state!
article.articleSummary: Dengue and malaria are rising in South Bengal amid the monsoon. In the last month, about 1,000 new dengue infections were reported; by July 31, total dengue cases in the state were around 1,946, with five districts driving the rise: Murshidabad (~600), North 24 Parganas (~350), Kolkata (~350), Howrah (~300), and South 24 Parganas (~300). Malaria totals near 5,502, including 1,062 Plasmodium falciparum cases. A 10-year-old boy, Joysnu Majumdar, died in Dum Dum after dengue was detected in blood tests; the death certificate cites dengue as the cause, noting dengue infection led to acute respiratory pneumonia with shock. The report highlights ongoing seasonal transmission linked to persistent rainfall and humidity across southern Bengal.

triage.headline_ja: 南ベンガルでデング熱とマラリアの感染者数が増加、州内で1ヶ月に新たに1,000人が感染！
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期の季節性デング・マラリア増加であり異常事態とは言えないが、死者1名の発生と症例数の顕著な増加があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 西ベンガル州（コルカタ、ムルシダバード、北24パルガナ、ハウラー、南24パルガナ）でのモンスーン期の季節的なデング熱・マラリア増加。国内対応可能な規模で国際支援の必要性は低いと見られるが、10歳男児の死亡例が報告されており重症度に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 24 people in Indore died drinking sewage-tainted water via municipal lines: Probe
article.articleSummary: 24 people died in Indore's Bhagirathpura between December 2025 and February 2026 after consuming water contaminated by sewage supplied through Indore Municipal Corporation pipelines. A one-member judicial commission led by Justice Sushil Kumar Gupta found the outbreak driven by a delayed tender process to replace damaged sewage and drinking-water lines with a new Narmada-water network, allowing sewage to mix with drinking water. The 150-page report was submitted to the Indore bench of the Madhya Pradesh High Court and has been barred from public release; locals say the toll could be 36. Postmortems linked deaths to gastrointestinal infection, diarrhoea and dehydration, with pathogens including E. coli, Salmonella and Vibrio cholerae detected. The commission blamed IMC engineers and another official for the delay, while giving a clean chit to former IMC commissioner Dileep Yadav and to Indore collector Shivam Verma. It recommended raising compensation from ₹2 lakh to ₹4 lakh, with an upper band up to ₹20 lakh in certain loss categories. The outbreak began on December 24, 2025.

triage.headline_ja: インドール市内で下水混入水を飲んだ24人が死亡：調査報告
triage.triage_reason: 下水混入水道水によりコレラ菌・大腸菌・サルモネラ等の複数病原体が検出され24人以上が死亡した重大な公衆衛生事案であり、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 発生自体は2025年12月〜2026年2月の過去事案で、司法委員会の調査報告書公表を機に報道された。上水道と下水道の配管損傷放置という構造的インフラ問題が原因であり、修復状況次第では再発リスクがあるため継続的な注視が必要。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、水系感染症の管理体制・インフラ改善状況を確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola en RDC : le bilan approche les 6 000 cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: the tally nears 6,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri epicenter) continues with 5,945 confirmed cases, 2,862 deaths and 1,327 recoveries as of 28 August, per the ministry. The response spans six provinces and 60 health zones; no new zones were affected in the last 24 hours. About 896 patients are isolated or hospitalized, with contact tracing at 84.4%. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, declared mid-May 2026 and expanding across eastern areas. Authorities emphasize surveillance, vaccination efforts, and strengthening care facilities. A free helpline is 151 for suspected cases. The outbreak is among the fastest and largest in history, despite challenges from insecurity and population movements and the absence of an approved vaccine or treatment for this strain. Congo has had sixteen Ebola outbreaks before 2026; the prior major outbreak (2018–2020) caused 2,299 deaths and 3,381 cases. Globally, West Africa 2014–2016 remains the deadliest with over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行：感染者数が6,000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で史上最大級・最速のエボラ流行が継続しており、死者数・感染者数ともに深刻な水準に達しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にアンゴラが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは言及がなく主題国はDRCのみであるため、Angolaはverified_locationsから除外した。承認されたワクチン・治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、人口移動と治安不安が拡大リスクを高めている点に留意。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UP on High Alert Over Swine Flu, 567 Suspected Cases Reported | Swine Flu Havoc in UP! In Lucknow Alone 151 Cases and in Gautam Buddh Nagar 189, as doctors are on leave.
article.articleSummary: UP on high alert for Swine Flu (influenza A/H1N1) and viral/seasonal fever with 567 suspected Swine Flu cases across Uttar Pradesh and the NCR region recording the highest numbers. Dengue cases are noted in Lucknow (151 reported) and across districts with Gautam Buddh Nagar leading at 189, followed by Lucknow (115), Meerut (54), and Ghaziabad (32). Authorities, including Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak and Health Minister, ordered hospitals to ensure testing, treatment, and resources; banned leaves for doctors and health workers to maintain capacity; and directed the creation of 10–20 bed isolation wards while ensuring essential drugs, oxygen, and other supplies. No patient should be turned away; surveillance will continue across UP to identify and manage cases promptly.

article.articleHeadline: Mädchen stirbt nach Bad an Krankheitserreger: Wie sicher sind Bayerns Seen?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Girl dies after bathing due to pathogens: How safe are Bavaria's lakes?
article.articleSummary: Naegleria fowleri, the brain-eating amoeba, caused a fatal infection in eight-year-old Lilian Smart after a swimming outing at Lake Claiborne, Louisiana. The child contracted the amoeba nasally, allowing it to invade the brain and cause primary amebic meningoencephalitis (PAM). Globally, about 250 PAM cases are known, with many underreported. In Germany, no cases have been recorded; Bavarian lakes reach 30 C only after prolonged heat, with typical water temperatures in the mid-20s. The Robert Koch Institute notes that N. fowleri thrives in warm freshwater. Early PAM symptoms include headache, fever, nausea and vomiting, followed by neck stiffness, seizures and confusion. Travelers are cautioned to avoid submerging the head in warm waters, particularly in the southern United States, parts of South America, and southern Asia (India, Thailand), where infections are more common, with temperatures around 30–45 C in subtropics and tropics.

article.articleHeadline: यूपी में डराने लगा है स्वाइन फ्लू, हापुड़ में पहली मौत, चार और नए आए केस
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu fears grip Uttar Pradesh; first death in Hapur, four more cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 August 2026, Western Uttar Pradesh faces a H1N1 swine flu outbreak, with the first death in Hapur. Nanak Chand Sharma, a Dhanaura village resident, died in a Noida hospital after testing positive for H1N1. Four additional cases have been confirmed via RTPCR, prompting a health alert and intensified surveillance. Contact tracing is underway for those exposed, and health teams are actively responding. Two health department officials have fallen ill, though their infection status is not yet confirmed. Meerut Medical College has prepared a 20-bed dedicated ward to rapidly manage potential cases. Authorities urge the public not to panic, seek medical advice for flu-like symptoms, and observe precautions to curb transmission.

article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1 influenza) alert issued across Uttar Pradesh as Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak reviews hospital readiness via the HOPE central command, focusing on four districts: Barabanki, Shravasti, Jhansi, and Gorakhpur. In Lucknow, he instructed stockpiling of oseltamivir (Tamiflu), oxygen supplies, nebulizers, oxygen masks, and bronchodilators; mandated testing for severe cases presenting with breathing difficulties. Hospitals should run separate OPDs for influenza-like illness to reduce crowding and improve triage. Each district/joint hospital should maintain 4–6 isolation beds for critical patients and establish dedicated fever/flu registration counters for prompt registration and testing. Enhanced border surveillance with Nepal and rapid medical aid for patients arriving from Nepal and Uttar Pradesh were also directed, with ongoing vigilance as of 2026-08-30.

article.articleHeadline: Outbreak of suspected diarrhoea: Collector orders closure of non-vegetarian market in Kankipadu
article.articleSummary: Suspected diarrhoea outbreak in Krishna District’s Kankipadu and Vuyyuru, with several patients (some presenting vomiting) admitted to local dispensaries. Affected areas include Ankatamma Talli Temple Street, Punadipadu, Bank Colony, among others. District Collector D.K. Balaji stated the situation is under control as of August 30, 2026, after actions such as advising boiled water, distributing chlorine tablets, cleaning tanks, and flushing pipelines. In-charge Collector M. Naveen directed the temporary closure of non-vegetarian markets and roadside eateries to curb spread of communicable diseases. No laboratory-confirmed details are provided; authorities emphasize ongoing containment and prevention measures to stop further transmission. The response highlights water treatment, market closures, and close monitoring in Kankipadu and Vuyyuru. Keywords: outbreak, public health measures, diarrhoea, Kankipadu, Vuyyuru, Krishna District.

triage.headline_ja: 疑わしい下痢の発生：コレクター(郡長)がカンキパドゥの非菜食（肉類）市場の閉鎖を命令
triage.triage_reason: インドのアーンドラ・プラデーシュ州で下痢の集団発生が報告されているが、当局により既に制御下にあるとされ、国際的拡大や重篤性を示す情報はない。継続的な経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Россиянин съездил в Египет и заразился неизвестной болезнью
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Russian man traveled to Egypt and contracted an unknown disease.
article.articleSummary: Russian IT professional, 30, contracted an unknown disease in Hurghada, Egypt, presenting anhidrosis (absence of sweating) as the first symptom, followed by a persistent heart rate up to 200 bpm, presyncope, dehydration, and later a gastrointestinal infection. Doctors in Cairo have not established a diagnosis; no laboratory confirmation reported. Family has been unable to return to Moscow for nearly a year, spending about $8,000 on examinations; the patient now relies on cooling routines (pouring water over himself) and avoids outdoor exposure, with work ability severely impaired. Visa expiry tensions and fines loom as the family plans to fly back to Russia to continue treatment there. The case remains unclassified, with source and transmission details undetermined. The report also notes a separate outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo where 14 people died within 19 days.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人男性がエジプト旅行後に原因不明の病気に感染
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例で疾患名・検査確定情報がなく、感染経路や国際的拡大の可能性も不明であるため、フルRRAには至らないが症状の異常性から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア人1名のエジプト（ハルガダ/カイロ）での原因不明疾患の個別症例が主題であり、対象国（エジプト・ロシア）はリスト対象外。記事末尾でDRCにおける19日間で14人死亡した別の疾患アウトブレイクに言及されているが、詳細不明かつ本記事の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCの件は別途情報収集が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 ALert: कानपुर में होगी स्वाइन फ्लू की आरटी-पीसीआर जांच, लागू होगा कोविड प्रोटोकाल - h1n1 alert swine flu rt pcr testing to begin in kanpur covid protocol to be implemented
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: H1N1 Alert: Swine Flu RT-PCR Testing to Begin in Kanpur, COVID Protocol to Be Implemented.
article.articleSummary: Swine influenza A(H1N1) prompts intensified measures in Kanpur. GSVM Medical College will begin RT-PCR testing for symptomatic patients, centralizing testing previously done in Lucknow. Hospital access requires masks, mirroring COVID protocols. Fever OPD and isolation wards are expanding; staff numbers increased, with isolation capacity targeted at 30 beds and six ventilator-equipped beds for severe cases. Severe respiratory patients at Chest Hospital or Fever OPD will be tested at GSVM. Deputy CM Brijesh Pathak directed preparedness and a public advisory was issued. Health workers' vaccination starts Monday, and chest-disease patients will be vaccinated. Public guidance stresses avoiding crowded places, covering coughs and sneezes, staying hydrated, and seeking care for fever and respiratory symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1警報：カンプールで豚インフルエンザのRT-PCR検査を開始、コロナ対策プロトコルを適用
triage.triage_reason: インド・カンプールで季節性H1N1(豚インフルエンザ)への対応強化が報じられているが、重症化率や死亡者数などの深刻性を示す具体的データがなく、国際的拡大や異常性を示す情報も不足しているため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 地方政府（副知事）が指示を出し、隔離病床・人工呼吸器の準備、ワクチン接種開始など医療体制強化が進んでいるが、季節性インフルエンザの通常対応の範囲内とみられる。重症患者数や死亡例など具体的な深刻度データが記事に含まれていないため判断は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: RDCongo.- El brote de ébola en RDC deja ya más de 2.860 muertos y...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo - The Ebola outbreak in DR Congo has already claimed more than 2,860 lives and...
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak as of Aug 28, 2026 has surpassed 2,862 deaths and 5,945 confirmed cases nationwide. Sixty health zones are emergency zones, with Biena and Manguredjipa added in North Kivu; the case fatality rate is 48.1%. The epicenter remains Ituri Province, where armed groups including the Allied Democratic Forces and ISIS provide a volatile backdrop that drives displacement and complicates tracking. Displacements extend into Kivu, amid fighting with the M23 militia that administers provincial capitals and leads its own response programs. Attacks on health workers are frequent—about 260 incidents, eight killed, and Ebola deaths continue. The DRC has received the first batch of Ervebo vaccine, for Bundibugyo strain, whose efficacy is uncertain; 70,000 doses are expected for trials. Side effects are reported as rare, with some expected protection against transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 - コンゴのエボラ流行、死者2,860人超、感染確認は6,000人に接近
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.1%、死者2,862人・症例5,945人という深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、武装勢力による治安悪化で対応が複雑化し国際支援が必要な状況であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 武装勢力（ADF、ISIS関連、M23）による治安悪化が感染対策や追跡調査を妨げており、医療従事者への攻撃も約260件発生。Ervebo（エボラ・ブンディブギョ株用）ワクチンの初回分が到着し7万回分の臨床試験が予定されているが有効性は不確実。

article.articleHeadline: ডেঙ্গির সঙ্গেই সোয়াইন ফ্লুয়ের চোখ রাঙানি, রোগপ্রতিরোধের দাওয়াই হেঁশেলেই, কী খাবেন, কী নয়
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The looming threat of swine flu alongside dengue; the remedy for disease prevention is right in your kitchen; what to eat and what not to eat.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 August 2026, dengue fever and swine flu (H1N1) are depicted as dual threats in India, with West Bengal health authorities warning of a possible dengue surge while swine flu outbreaks have been reported in several states. Rainy, waterlogged conditions are linked to higher viral activity; however, the article provides no case counts or laboratory confirmation. It promotes diet-based prevention, emphasizing hydration and easily digestible, nutrient-rich foods. Recommended items include papaya leaf juice and apple juice; moong dal soup with vegetables; a beet–carrot–coconut water smoothie; sabudana khichdi tempered with cumin, fenugreek, and ginger; a pomegranate with yogurt raita; and a pineapple–mint detox drink. Foods to avoid: fried or oily items, junk/packaged foods, excessive caffeine or soda, and raw salads or roadside drinks. Emphasis remains on maintaining fluids and energy to bolster immunity alongside public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱と豚インフルエンザの二重の脅威が迫る中、病気予防の秘訣は台所に。何を食べるべきか、何を避けるべきか
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・豚インフルエンザに関する一般的な健康・食事アドバイス記事であり、症例数や検査確認情報がなく、新規性・異常性も認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性感染症予防のための食事アドバイスが主題であり、具体的な症例数・検査確認・異常な流行状況の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള; ചരിത്രത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും വേഗത്തിലുള്ള വ്യാപനം, രണ്ടു പുതിയ മേഖലകളിലേക്കുകൂടി പടർന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the fastest spread in history, spreading to two new regions.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than any prior outbreak, with new transmission confirmed in Bién and Mangurézip areas of North Kivu, taking the total affected areas to about 60. As of now, 5,794 cases and 2,786 deaths have been reported, giving a case fatality rate above 48%. The outbreak remains uncontrolled, according to the World Health Organization. Vaccination has begun for health workers in Congo using the Ervebo vaccine, proven effective in previous outbreaks. Clinical trials are under way for a vaccine against Bundibugyo virus, for which no licensed vaccine or therapy exists. The current outbreak is driven largely by Bundibugyo virus, with Eastern Ituri bearing the majority of cases (around 90%), and five other provinces including Kisangani reporting cases. In two months, approximately 2,500 cases and over 1,000 deaths have been recorded, a pace about three times faster than 2014–2016. The earliest case was December 2013; recognition came by March 2014, and the outbreak was officially declared over in June 2016. Transmission occurs via blood and bodily fluids; animal reservoirs include monkeys, apes, and pigs. Preventive measures emphasize proper meat cooking, avoiding contact with fluids, rapid isolation, and supportive care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：史上最速のペースで拡大、新たに2地域へ感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）が過去最速ペースで拡大し、致死率48%超・約60地域に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案である。
triage.notes: WHOも制御不能な状況と評価。ワクチン接種開始済みだが、ブンディブギョウイルスに対する承認済みワクチン・治療法は存在せず、国際的な支援ニーズが高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Judicial Panel Links 24 Indore Water Deaths To Sewage Contamination
article.articleSummary: Six civic officials were held responsible in the Indore Bhagirathpura water tragedy, where 24 of 36 deaths (Dec 26, 2025–Feb 25, 2026) are linked to sewage-contaminated drinking water supplied via Indore Municipal Corporation pipelines. Pathogens detected in the water included E. coli, Salmonella and Vibrio cholerae, with postmortems citing gastrointestinal infection, diarrhea and dehydration as causes. The inquiry, led by retired judge Justice Sushil Kumar Gupta, attributed the contamination to administrative lapses and delays in replacing an ageing Narmada water pipeline, noting tender delays left sewer and water lines vulnerable. The report gave a clean chit to IMC commissioner Dileep Yadav and Indore collector Shivam Verma, while six other officials were held responsible; the court has not released findings publicly. The High Court asked for steps to ensure clean water; some areas reportedly still receive contaminated supply, with results of water testing due within 48 hours. Next hearing Sept 8.

triage.headline_ja: 司法委員会、インドールでの水関連24人の死亡を下水汚染に関連付け
triage.triage_reason: 2025年12月〜2026年2月に発生した過去の水系感染症死亡事例に関する司法調査結果の報道であり、新規アウトブレイクの探知ではないが、一部地域で汚染水供給が継続している可能性が示唆されており、今後の水質検査結果や次回審理（9月8日）の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は2025年12月〜2026年2月に発生した過去の水系感染症（下水汚染による飲料水汚染）事案に関する司法調査結果の報道。老朽化した水道管の更新遅延が原因とされ、一部地域では依然汚染水供給が続いている可能性があり、今後の水質検査結果と9月8日の次回審理を注視する必要がある。新規アウトブレイクではなく、既発生事案の行政・司法対応に関する続報。

article.articleHeadline: અમદાવાદમાં મચ્છરજન્ય રોગચાળાનો હાહાકાર: 15 દિવસમાં 30 ટકા દર્દીઓ વધ્યા, તંત્રમાં દોડધામ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahmedabad mosquito-borne outbreak wreaks havoc: 30% rise in patients in 15 days, health system in turmoil.
article.articleSummary: Ahmedabad is battling a dengue surge amid the monsoon, with vector-borne and waterborne diseases rising across the city. Dengue, malaria, and swine flu cases are concentrated in the western and northern zones, including Chandkheda, Gota, Ghatlodiya, Bopal, Naroda, and Jodhpur. Private hospitals affiliated with AHNA report roughly a 30% rise in these illnesses over the past 15 days, with more than 750 patients admitted in serious condition. Government data is worrying: Sola Civil Hospital has recorded 267 dengue cases up to August 23, of which 140 were newly reported in the last week. From late July to August 23, Ahmedabad Civil Hospital (Asarva) logged 45 dengue cases, while municipal hospitals reported 147. Authorities have intensified spraying and fogging; residents are urged to eliminate standing water to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: アーメダバードで蚊媒介感染症が猛威：15日間で患者30%増加、保健当局が対応に追われる
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期の季節性デング熱・マラリア増加であり、地域限定の公衆衛生対応事案。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、重症患者数の増加は注視が必要。
triage.notes: アーメダバード（グジャラート州）における季節性のデング熱・マラリア・スワインフルの増加。地元病院での入院患者増加が報告されているが、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。モンスーン期の毎年の傾向である可能性が高く、続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: बालाघाट: सेरेब्रल मलेरिया से 10 साल की काजल की मौत, झोलाछाप के इलाज से 2 वर्षीय मासूम ने तोड़ा दम
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Balaghat: 10-year-old Kajal dies of cerebral malaria, 2-year-old child dies after treatment by a quack.
article.articleSummary: Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh: A 10-year-old girl, Kajal, dies of cerebral malaria, and a 2-year-old boy, Himanshu, dies after home treatment by a quack. Kajal, from Mohanpur in Parsavada block, presented with high fever on August 22; malaria was confirmed and her condition worsened on August 26, dying during treatment after referral to Gondia. Himanshu, 2, from Gogatola Bhanderi in Bahehar block, had malaria, but due to lack of proper medical facilities, the family relied on a quack; he died from delayed proper treatment. With these two, deaths from seasonal illnesses in Baiga tribal areas rise to 29. The fatalities occurred on the day Chief Minister Dr. Mohan Yadav visited the district; Kajal's body was escorted to Mohanpur by a government vehicle and police."

triage.headline_ja: バラガット：脳マラリアで10歳のカージャルさん死亡、藪医者の治療で2歳の幼児が死亡
triage.triage_reason: インド・マディヤプラデシュ州の一地域における季節性マラリアによる個別死亡例であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、既知の風土病流行の一環と考えられる。
triage.notes: マディヤプラデシュ州バラガット地区の部族地域(Baiga)で季節性疾患による死者が29人に増加との記述あり。州首相の訪問と重なったため行政の注目は集めているが、これは政治的文脈であり公衆衛生上の国際的関心事項ではない。医療アクセス不足（quack治療）という構造的課題は継続監視の余地あり。

article.articleHeadline: हापुड़ में H1N1 से पहली मौत, 4 और संक्रमित; मेरठ मेडिकल कॉलेज में 20 बेड का वार्ड तैयार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First H1N1 death in Hapur, 4 more infected; 20-bed ward prepared at Meerut Medical College.
article.articleSummary: H1N1 (Swine Flu) death reported in Hapur, Uttar Pradesh, first in the district; Nanak Chand Sharma, a resident of Dhanoura village, died in a Noida hospital with H1N1 confirmed. Four additional local residents tested RTPCR-positive for H1N1, with health teams tracing contacts and identifying potential new cases. In response, Meerut Medical College has established a 20-bed dedicated H1N1 ward in the Emergency Department (10 beds for men, 10 for women), equipped with oxygen and ventilators, and an H1N1-focused OPD for evaluation and treatment. On Saturday, 48 patients with cough, cold, or fever visited the OPD from 10:00 am to 1:00 pm. Health officials urge anyone with flu-like symptoms to seek timely medical care; monitoring will continue and further measures may be taken. Two health department officers reportedly ill; confirmation of H1N1 status pending.

triage.headline_ja: ハープルでH1N1による初の死亡、さらに4人感染；メーラト医科大学に20床病棟を準備
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1による局地的な死亡・感染例が報告されているが、異常性・国際的拡大の兆候はなく、現時点では地域医療機関で対応可能な規模であるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)のUttar Pradesh州Hapur/Meerut地域での発生。死亡1例、感染確認4例、疑い患者多数。地元当局が病棟増設等で対応中。国際的懸念には至らないが、健康局職員の感染疑いなど続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC deja ya más de 2.860 muertos y los casos confirmados se aproximan a los 6.000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC has already left more than 2,860 dead, and the confirmed cases are approaching 6,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, declared mid-May, has reached 2,862 deaths and 5,945 confirmed cases as of August 28. Ituri province remains the epicenter, with displacement driving spread to North Kivu, where 60 health zones are now emergency areas after Biena and Manguredjipa were added. Violence, centered on the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), an Africa‑ISIS affiliate, has impeded surveillance. In North Kivu, the M23 militia controls provincial capitals and has launched its own outbreak response in coordination with international agencies but without government dialogue. Attacks on health workers total about 260, leaving eight medical staff dead and 43 other Ebola-related deaths. Congo received its first Ervebo vaccine doses; no vaccine exists for the Bundibugyo strain. About 70,000 doses are expected for trials, with early data suggesting rare severe adverse effects and some protection.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、死者2,860人超、確認症例は6,000人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、死者数・症例数が急増し、武装勢力による治安悪化がサーベイランスを妨げているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: Ituri州が震源地であり、避難民の移動により北キブ州へ拡大。ADFやM23など武装勢力による攻撃・治安悪化が対応を妨げており、ワクチン（Ervebo）配布とBundibugyo株に対する新規ワクチン試験が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: A propósito de México y Conmebol: cuando un defensa de Chivas 'amenazó' a Everton con la gripe porcina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Regarding Mexico and CONMEBOL: when a Chivas defender 'threatened' Everton with swine flu.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A (H1N1) swine flu backdrop frames a 2009 Libertadores incident in Chile, where Chivas defender Héctor Reynoso mimicked coughing and nose‑clearing toward Everton de Viña del Mar’s Sebastián Penco, triggering concern as the global flu outbreak surged. Penco alerted the referee; Reynoso was suspended. Chivas and San Luis later withdrew from the knockout phase, accusing Sao Paulo and Nacional of discrimination for not traveling to Mexico amid the swine flu. CONMEBOL awarded automatic Round of 16 berths to the dissidents the following year. In 2016, Mexico voluntarily left CONMEBOL over calendar issues. In 2026, CONMEBOL president Alejandro Domínguez signaled willingness to admit Mexican (and possibly U.S.) clubs, via CONCACAF. FMF has backed Infantino’s leadership; Liga MX President Francisco Iturbide notes talks to participate as guests in club tournaments while prioritizing national-team competition.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコとCONMEBOLについて：チバスの選手がエベルトンを豚インフルエンザで『脅した』時
triage.triage_reason: 2009年のサッカー国際大会にまつわる回顧的なスポーツ記事であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントの報告ではないため、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は2009年の豚インフルエンザ流行時のサッカーイベントを回顧するスポーツ記事であり、現在の感染症発生を報じるものではない。対象国（ブラジル等）は言及されているが、現行の感染症イベントとしての言及ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Balaghat Malaria Death: बारिश के मौसम में फैली खतरनाक बीमारी! इस जिले में अब तक 10 लोगों की मौत, ग्रामीणों में दहशत का माहौल
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Balaghat Malaria Death: A Dangerous Disease Spreading in the Monsoon Season! So Far, 10 People Have Died in This District, Creating an Atmosphere of Fear Among the Villagers.
article.articleSummary: Malaria deaths surge in Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh, during the monsoon season, with malaria, measles and fever reported in the South Baheer tribal belt. Two pediatric fatalities are reported: Kajal Saiyam, 10, from Mohanpur, who died in Gondia after malaria treatment; and Himanshu Miravi, 2.5 years old, from Parsatola Gram Panchayat Baiga Tola, who died after a high fever. Health officials state Himanshu’s malaria test was negative, while families allege no treatment followed the negative result. Government data cite 10 child deaths in the last two months in the area, though Congress claims 26 deaths, signaling a health-system crisis. The deaths have sparked fear and raised questions about disease prevention, healthcare access, and monitoring in affected villages amid ongoing outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: バラガート郡マラリア死亡：モンスーン期に危険な病気が拡大！この郡でこれまでに10人が死亡、村人たちの間に恐怖の雰囲気
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期にマラリア・麻疹・発熱による小児死亡が多発し（政府発表10人、野党主張26人）、村落での恐怖と政治的論争を招いており、社会的関心が高く保健システムの脆弱性が示唆されるためフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 発生地域はマディヤ・プラデーシュ州バラガート郡（一部隣接するマハーラーシュトラ州ゴンディア）が中心で、いずれもインド国内のためverified_locationsはIndiaのみとした。死者数について政府発表と野党主張に乖離があり、保健当局の対応や検査結果を巡る住民との認識差も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: COVID Rates Low But Are Increasing Across The United States
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 rates are low but rising across the United States as of 2026-08-30. Four weeks earlier, summer surges were reported in Mainland China, Taiwan, and Hong Kong. The CDC's wastewater surveillance shows increasing SARS-CoV-2 activity across the southern tier states and the west coast, with the national epidemic trend growing. Vaccination uptake remains a challenge, declining amid persistent anti-vaccine rhetoric online. The report provides no specific case or death counts, nor laboratory-confirmation details or infection sources. It highlights ongoing reliance on wastewater data to monitor spread and underscores a potential uptick in transmission as public health authorities watch for signs of a broader rebound.

triage.headline_ja: 米国全土でCOVID感染率は低いが増加傾向
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的な増加を報じる内容で、通常のサーベイランス範囲内であり、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに該当しない。米国は対象国リストにも含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事は主に米国のCOVID-19動向を扱っており、中国・台湾・香港の夏季感染拡大は4週間前の背景情報として言及されているのみ。対象国のうち中国のみ言及があるため参考として記載したが、記事の主題ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Swine flu and Pneumonia : स्वाइन फ्लू के मामले बढ़े, कुछ मरीजों में निमोनिया का खतरा, ऐसे करें बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine Flu and Pneumonia: Swine flu cases have risen; some patients are at risk of pneumonia; how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A (Swine Flu) cases are rising across several Indian states, with Gurugram’s Fortis Hospital reporting more outpatient visits and some hospitalizations. Doctors urge vigilance but not panic, as influenza can progress to pneumonia in certain patients, especially if treatment is delayed or there is pre-existing lung disease. Dr. Satish Kaul, Principal Director of Internal Medicine at Fortis Gurugram, notes that influenza viruses are not stable: antigenic drift occurs almost yearly or every one to two years, and antigenic shift can trigger larger outbreaks. Consequently, the flu vaccine is updated annually to match circulating strains. Vaccination is especially beneficial for high-risk individuals to reduce the risk of severe illness and complications. Public guidance emphasizes watching for fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, fatigue, and seeking timely care if breathing difficulty or persistent high fever develops.

triage.headline_ja: スワインフルと肺炎：スワインフルの症例が増加、一部の患者に肺炎のリスク、予防法は
triage.triage_reason: インド国内での季節性インフルエンザA(スワインフル)の症例増加に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常な発生パターンや重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は医師による季節性インフルエンザの一般的な注意喚起・予防啓発が主旨で、抗原ドリフト・シフトについての教育的説明を含む。異常発生や大規模アウトブレイクを示唆する具体的なデータ（症例数、致死率等）は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 開學在即衞署警告流感爆發風險｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Back to school is imminent; the Department of Health warns of the risk of influenza outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Influenza remains highly active in Hong Kong as of 2026-08-30, with the new school year approaching. As thousands of students return next week, the Centre for Health Protection reports 11 pediatric severe influenza cases since the flu season began in late June, including two in critical condition and one death. COVID-19 activity peaked in early August and has since declined; two pediatric severe COVID-19 cases have been recorded since June, both unvaccinated. Hand, foot and mouth disease activity peaked in mid-August and has fallen, but officials warn that close contact in schools can still drive limited outbreaks. The CHP director urged schools and parents to participate in the 2026/27 seasonal influenza vaccine outreach program, and for schools not participating to quickly arrange vaccination for their children.

triage.headline_ja: 開学を控え、香港衛生署がインフルエンザ流行のリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 香港では例年通りの季節性インフルエンザ流行期の注意喚起だが、小児重症例11件（うち死亡1例、重篤2例）が報告されており、開学に伴う感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 香港衛生署（CHP）による季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種呼びかけを伴う例年の開学前注意喚起。小児重症例・死亡例の報告はあるが、季節性の範囲内であり異常性は明確でない。開学後の感染拡大動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: HP witnessing seasonal surge in H1N1 cases during monsoon period: Expert
article.articleSummary: Seasonal surge of influenza A (H1N1) cases reported in Himachal Pradesh during the monsoon, with Hamirpur highlighted. Dr Naresh Purohit, Principal Investigator for the NIDSP, notes heightened vigilance but says there is no cause for panic. H1N1, commonly known as swine flu, is a viral respiratory infection; symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, body aches, headache, chills and fatigue. There is no new H1N1 strain; the rise reflects seasonal influenza. He warns against self-medication with antibiotics or antivirals, explaining antibiotics do not treat influenza and misuse drives antimicrobial resistance. They may be necessary only if a clinician confirms a secondary bacterial infection. Antibiotic use should be determined by a qualified doctor. The article does not report laboratory-confirmed cases, infection source, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ヒマーチャル・プラデーシュ州、モンスーン期に季節性H1N1症例が増加：専門家
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の通常の季節的増加であり、専門家も新型株ではなくパニックの必要はないと明言している。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザの通常のサーベイランス報告であり、専門家コメントも「パニックの必要なし」「新株ではない」と強調。検査確定症例数や重症度の詳細は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: US steps up Ebola support to Uganda with delivery of antibody treatment
article.articleSummary: Uganda received an experimental Ebola antibody treatment MBP134 from the United States on Aug. 27, delivered to the Ministry of Health in Kampala. Uganda, declared Ebola-free by the WHO on Aug. 27, faces cross-border risk from the Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in neighboring DRC, with movement along the border. MBP134 is designed to neutralize Ebola viruses without waiting for the body's immune response; not commercially sold and available for compassionate use while research continues. It has shown effectiveness against multiple Ebola species in pre-clinical studies, including Bundibugyo. The donation accompanies a U.S. assessment visit (July 11–15) of Uganda's Ebola response and border screening, including Entebbe Airport, Vurra border, UVRI in Arua, and operations centers. The U.S. supports Uganda's labs, surveillance, contact tracing, border health screening, emergency operations, and community engagement. Regional Ebola response totals exceed $370 million, with $350 million for humanitarian aid in DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がウガンダへのエボラ支援を強化、抗体治療薬を提供
triage.triage_reason: 隣国DRCでのブンディブギョウイルス病（エボラ属）アウトブレイクが継続しており、国境を越えた感染拡大リスクと国際的な人道支援（3億7000万ドル超）が明記されているため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダへの米国支援だが、ウガンダ自体はWHOによりエボラフリー宣言済み。実際のエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス病）発生地は隣国DRCであり、越境リスクが焦点となっている。ウガンダ（対象国リスト外）は除外し、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Más de 1.300 pacientes vecen al ébola en RD Congo en un brote que acumula ya 2.862 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,300 patients beat Ebola in the DR Congo in an outbreak that has already claimed 2,862 lives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has 5,945 confirmed cases, 2,862 deaths, and 1,327 recoveries, with 896 patients in isolation or hospitalised as of Aug 28, 2026. Case fatality is 48.1% and contact tracing 84.4%. Ituri remains the epicenter, with Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, North Kivu, and South Kivu affected. Vaccination began with Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus), with >50,000 doses delivered. No specific treatments exist for this Bundibugyo variant; two additional Bundibugyo vaccines are in Phase 1 trials and appear safe. The outbreak began May 15 in eastern DRC and has spread to Uganda, where the WHO declared the outbreak over after 20 cases (15 imported from DRC) and two deaths. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行で1,300人以上が回復、死者数はすでに2,862人に達する
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確定症例5,945例・死者2,862例（致死率48.1%）に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、WHOはウガンダでの流行終息を宣言済み。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主流行地はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州を中心に複数州）。

article.articleHeadline: Carangola realiza mutirão de vistorias para combater focos de dengue e escorpiões
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Carangola carries out an inspection drive to combat dengue hotspots and scorpions.
article.articleSummary: Carangola's Endemias Sector launches a citywide inspection drive to curb dengue hotspots, deter scorpions, and other animals and vectors that pose direct health risks. Teams survey multiple neighborhoods, identify risk focal points, assess vulnerabilities, and implement vector-control measures to interrupt mosquito breeding and remove shelters in urban spaces. The campaign emphasizes prevention and public education to reduce dengue-related illness and other vector-borne hazards, aiming for a safer daily environment. Success relies on sustained household measures; residents' participation is considered essential, alongside municipal efforts to maintain continuous vector control. The initiative underscores the need for coordinated actions to protect public health, with information channels such as Jornal Panorama and the city's administration providing updates. No case counts are reported.

triage.headline_ja: カランゴラ、デング熱とサソリの発生源対策のための一斉点検を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱に関する日常的な予防・点検活動の報道であり、症例数の報告や異常な流行状況は示されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は地方自治体による通常のベクター対策・予防啓発活動を報じたもので、症例数や異常な流行の言及はない。ブラジルのミナスジェライス州カランゴラ市が舞台だが、対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるものの、内容が定常的な予防活動であるため公衆衛生上の懸念は低いと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू से ये 2 लोग रहें ज्यादा सतर्क, ये लक्षण दिखे तो डॉक्टर के पास जाएं
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two people should be more vigilant about swine flu; if these symptoms appear, see a doctor.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A (H1N1) swine flu is rising in Noida, Gautam Buddh Nagar, with 192 cases reported to date. Pregnant women and children under five are identified as high-risk. Early symptoms include fever, body aches, nasal congestion, cough and cold; chest pain, breathing difficulty or dehydration require urgent care. In pregnancy, infection can cause maternal fever or severe illness with potential indirect effects on the fetus, including risk of preterm delivery. Monsoon and winter, along with temperature fluctuations and humidity, may drive higher transmission. Preventive measures include avoiding crowded places, distancing, masks when needed, and good hydration and nutrition. High-risk individuals should seek medical advice promptly; antibiotics or antivirals should not be taken without a doctor's guidance. Steam inhalation or saline gargles may be used only under medical advice.
