article.articleHeadline: हिमाचल में स्वाइन फ्लू से दूसरी मौत, IGMC शिमला में उपचाराधीन था मरीज; स्वास्थ्य विभाग की एडवाइजरी जारी - swine flu claims second life in himachal pradesh at igmc shimla
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second swine flu death in Himachal Pradesh; patient was undergoing treatment at IGMC Shimla; health department issues advisory.
article.articleSummary: Second swine flu death in Himachal Pradesh: 64-year-old Ramashish Ram, of Sai Doba Post Office, Bilaspur Sadar, died during treatment at IGMC Shimla. He was admitted August 13; swine flu test came back positive on August 29. He had preexisting interstitial lung disease and lower lobar pneumonia, with other health complications. Despite treatment, he died on August 30 at 6:46 am; hospital emphasizes that death cannot be attributed solely to swine flu, given underlying severe lung disease and treatment-related complications. The health department issued an advisory urging vigilance for swine flu and influenza-like illness symptoms, such as high fever, cough, sore throat, and breathing difficulty. Elderly individuals and those with chronic lung or other diseases should take extra precautions, avoid crowded places, cover mouth and nose while coughing or sneezing, and seek medical care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: ヒマーチャル・プラデーシュ州で豚インフルエンザによる2人目の死亡、IGMCシムラーで治療中だった患者；保健当局が注意喚起を発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）による死亡例で基礎疾患を有する高齢者であり、地域的な公衆衛生上の重大性や異常性は限定的だが、続報（患者数増加等）の可能性を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: H1N1（豚インフルエンザ）は季節性インフルエンザとしてインドで毎年発生している既知の疾患であり、本例は基礎疾患（間質性肺疾患、肺炎）を有する高齢患者の死亡。保健当局が注意喚起を発出しているが、地域的アウトブレイクの拡大を示す情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: हापुड़ में खतरे की दस्तक... स्वाइन फ्लू के तीन केस आए सामने; बुजुर्ग किसान की हुई मौत - swine flu outbreak in hapur one death three cases confirmed
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Threat looms in Hapur... Three swine flu cases reported; elderly farmer dies.
article.articleSummary: Three confirmed swine flu (H1N1 influenza) cases reported in Hapur district, Uttar Pradesh, with one elderly farmer dying in a Noida hospital. Two female patients in Hapur and the Gad Mukteshwar area tested positive; health officials initiated contact tracing across about 50 households. The third case is Nanak Sharma of Dhanoura village, who battled fever for six days, was treated in a Meerut private hospital, then moved to a Noida private hospital where he died despite care. Sharma had prior tuberculosis and diabetes. Family members are under surveillance, and Oseltamivir has been given to contacts. Symptoms include high fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, body aches, and weakness; respiratory distress warrants urgent medical attention. Four beds will be reserved in every CHC, and the district hospital will conduct swine flu testing to manage the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ハプルに脅威の足音...豚インフルエンザ3例確認、高齢農夫が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1（豚インフルエンザ）の地域限定的な発生で、死亡例は基礎疾患（結核・糖尿病）を有する患者。当局が接触者追跡や病床確保など通常の対応を行っており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州ハプル地区での季節性H1N1インフルエンザの局地的発生。地元保健当局が接触者追跡、オセルタミビル投与、病床確保などの対応を実施中。死亡した患者は結核・糖尿病の既往歴あり、重症化リスク因子を有していた。国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は現時点で低いと考えられるが、症例数の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll exceeds 2,800 in DR Congo as cases mount
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed more than 2,800 people, with confirmed cases reaching 5,945 across six provinces (Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo) since the outbreak began in mid-May. Affected 60 health zones to date. Recoveries stand at 1,327; 896 confirmed patients are in isolation or in hospital. Last week, the government launched a vaccination campaign targeting health and frontline workers. The World Health Organization says the Bundibugyo virus strain in Congo is evolving rapidly with sustained transmission, marking a substantial increase in the outbreak’s scale over the past three months. Containment now hinges on community involvement and adherence to prevention measures to enable traceability and rapid intervention, according to Dr. Richard Kitenge speaking in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数2,800人超え 症例数増加中
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模エボラ流行が継続・拡大しており、死者2,800人超、確定症例5,945人、6州60保健地域に及ぶ。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: WHOはBundibugyoウイルス株が急速に進化し持続的伝播を示していると指摘。3ヶ月間で流行規模が大幅拡大しており、既にWHO/国際社会が関与する大規模PHEIC相当事案。フルRRAへの即時移行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 西藏军区保障部医疗防疫分队紧急驰援吉隆灾区 _光明网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Tibet Military District Support Department's Medical and Epidemic Prevention Detachment Urgently Rushes to the Jilong Disaster Area
article.articleSummary: On the morning of August 30, 2026, the Medical and Epidemic Prevention Detachment of the Tibet Military District’s General Hospital and a brigade-level preventive medicine unit urgently dispatched to the Jilong disaster area to provide medical and epidemic- prevention support for frontline rescuers, disaster-affected civilians, and local rescuers. The response drew 22 core personnel in preventive medicine, testing, and emergency care. Seven specialized vehicles were deployed, including sanitary-epidemic vehicles, vaccine cold-chain trucks, and ambulances. They carried more than 40 sets of equipment, such as field medical rescue kits, multi-pathogen rapid detection systems, food and water quality testing kits, environmental disinfection testing kits, and military/ hygiene backpacks, along with more than 400 items—including tetanus vaccines and disinfection supplies. Names cited: Zhang Leifeng, Liu Yanming, Hu Qiang, Tang Wei, Gong Xiao, Zhang Ronghua. Location: Jilong disaster area, Tibet. Key themes: disaster relief, medical support, epidemic prevention, rapid diagnostics, vaccination, and field logistics.

triage.headline_ja: 西藏軍区保障部医療防疫分隊、吉隆の被災地に緊急救援
triage.triage_reason: 破傷風の感染事例報告ではなく、災害救援に伴う予防医療・ワクチン供給などの通常の防疫活動に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事は自然災害（吉隆地区）への軍医療部隊の派遣と防疫物資（破傷風ワクチン含む）の配布を報じたものであり、疾病アウトブレイクの発生を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil integra estudo internacional sobre hepatite B
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil joins an international study on Hepatitis B.
article.articleSummary: Brazil joins an international study on Hepatitis B, led by Johns Hopkins School of Medicine, with partners in India, Senegal, and Uganda. Brazilian centers Hucam-Ufes (Hospital Universitário Cassiano Antônio Moraes) and USP will recruit 600 participants (150 per country; 75 in Brazil) over about 4.5 years to study Hepatitis B virus behavior and immune responses, including HIV coinfection. Reuter (Hucam-Ufes) notes HBV has no cure yet; the project aims to identify signals of cure and potential immunostimulants/immunomodulators, hoping to reduce HBV-related cirrhosis and liver cancer and meet 2030 elimination goals. Recruits began July 2026; 40 enrolled; full enrollment expected by year-end 2026, within a mid-2027 deadline. WHO data cite ~240 million people with chronic HBV globally (2024); Brazil reports ~276,600 cases (2000–2022). Vaccination via SUS and preventive measures are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、B型肝炎に関する国際共同研究に参加
triage.triage_reason: これは国際共同研究プロジェクトの紹介記事であり、アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 研究対象国はブラジル・インド・セネガル・ウガンダだが、いずれも既存の慢性HBV研究の枠組みであり、対象国リストに含まれるブラジル・インドについても新規の感染症イベントではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Snapshots
article.articleSummary: Dengue activity across Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Malaysia, Afghanistan, Vietnam and Cambodia remains high. Sri Lanka has 95,035 dengue cases and 72 deaths this year; August alone accounts for 9,699 cases, after July’s 29,962. The Western Province contains the majority (50,287 cases; 52.9%), with Gampaha (20,248; 21.3%) and Colombo (18,842; 19.8%) the most affected districts. In Bangladesh, nearly 1,100 new dengue cases and three deaths in the last 24 hours bring totals to 34,683 cases and 93 deaths; 2,402 patients are in treatment. Malaysia reports 42,848 dengue cases year-to-date with 34 deaths, a 34.8% rise in cases and 78.9% rise in fatalities. Afghanistan records 473 suspected July cases (up 85.5% from June) with no dengue deaths since January. Vietnam, July 2026: 15,940 cases and one death; Jan–Jul total 73,828 cases and nine deaths (1.3× 2025). Cambodia, early August: 54,697 cases and 72 deaths (CFR 0.1%), up 81.1% from 2025.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱スナップショット
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムを含む複数国でデング熱の季節的増加が報告されているが、既知の風土病で季節性の定例報告であり、突発的異常事象とは言えないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はスリランカ、バングラデシュ、マレーシア、アフガニスタン、ベトナム、カンボジアの複数国デング熱動向をまとめたスナップショットだが、対象国リストに該当するのはベトナムのみ。ベトナムは前年比1.3倍の増加傾向だが死亡数は少なくCFRも低い。

article.articleHeadline: ਪੰਜਾਬ 'ਚ HIV ਦੀ ਰਫ਼ਤਾਰ ਚਿੰਤਾਜਨਕ, 9 ਸਾਲਾਂ 'ਚ 87 ਹਜ਼ਾਰ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਨਵੇਂ ਕੇਸ; ਲੁਧਿਆਣਾ ਤੇ ਬਠਿੰਡਾ ਅੱਵਲ - HIV rate in Punjab is alarming more than 87 thousand new cases in 9 years Ludhiana and Bathinda top
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming HIV rate in Punjab: more than 87,000 new cases in 9 years; Ludhiana and Bathinda lead.
article.articleSummary: Punjab reports 87,409 new HIV-positive cases from 2017-18 to 2025-26 (nine financial years), per Punjab State AIDS Control Society data obtained under RTI Act 2005 by activist Rajesh Kumar Thakral. Ludhiana leads with 1,171 new cases, followed by Bathinda 984, Amritsar 909, Ferozepur 691, Jalandhar 618, Patiala 568 and Moga 532. Annual tallies peak in 2023-24 with 13,130 cases, then 2024-25 with 11,364 and 2025-26 with 9,830; earlier year figures include 2017-18 (6,730), 2018-19 (8,133), 2019-20 (10,587), and 2022-23 (11,950). The data illustrate a substantial HIV burden across Punjab, with Ludhiana and Bathinda among the most affected districts.

triage.headline_ja: パンジャブ州のHIV感染率が憂慮すべき水準に、9年間で8万7千件超の新規感染例;ルディヤーナーとバティンダーが最多
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性感染症であるHIVの累積統計報告であり、急性の公衆衛生危機や異常な集団発生を示すものではないため、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: RTI開示に基づく行政統計報告であり、新規の突発的感染イベントではない。HIVは既知の疾病でありEBSの急性シグナル対象としては優先度が低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DR Congo surpasses 2,800 as outbreak spreads
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed more than 2,800 as infections spread to 60 health zones across Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele and Tshopo. As of 2026-08-30, the Health Ministry reports 5,945 confirmed cases since the outbreak began in May, with 1,327 recoveries and 896 confirmed patients currently hospitalized or in isolation. The Bundibugyo strain is evolving rapidly with sustained transmission, and the WHO warns of a substantial rise in scale over the past three months. A vaccination campaign targeting healthcare and frontline workers was launched last week to curb transmission. Health responders stress community participation as essential to control, calling for adherence to prevention measures and prompt reporting of suspected cases to enable contact tracing and swift intervention.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が2,800人を超え、感染拡大が続く
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ流行が拡大し、死者2,800人超・確認症例5,945人に達しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: 60保健区域に拡大し、WHOも過去3ヶ月で規模が大幅に増加したと警告。バンディブギョ株の持続的伝播が確認されており、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: 12 persons bitten by stray dogs at Kadayanallur
article.articleSummary: On 2026-08-30, Kadayanallur in Tenkasi district reported 12 people bitten by stray dogs on Sunday, amid a rising cluster of 'mysterious' fever cases locals label dengue. Victims include Sudharshana (13), Murugan (46), Pragadish (40), and Muthaiah (65); two stray dogs attacked a wedding-bound group and another group of farmworkers. Seven with bleeding injuries were rushed to Tenkasi Government Hospital after initial first aid; others were treated as outpatients. Kadayanallur Municipality Chairman Habibur Rahman visited the hospital; residents accuse insanitary conditions of fueling a dengue-like outbreak, with patients showing low platelet counts. Doctors reportedly refuse to call it dengue, describing it as mysterious fever. Public outcry notes more than 30 dog bite cases in the past two days; authorities have detained four stray dogs in the town, as three deaths have been reported in the Kadayanallur area.

triage.headline_ja: カダヤナルールで野良犬に12人が噛まれる
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は野良犬による咬傷だが、地域で血小板減少を伴う「謎の発熱」クラスターが発生し3人の死亡が報告されており、デング熱疑いだが医師は確定診断を避けている。診断未確定で情報不足のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は野良犬咬傷事件だが、付随情報として地域で原因不明の発熱クラスター（デング疑い、血小板減少、死亡3例）が報告されている。医師が診断を確定していないため、続報での病原体特定や症例数の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Gorakhpur News: बारिश में डेंगू का बढ़ा खतरा, हेल्थ डिपार्टमेंट ने किया अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gorakhpur News: Dengue risk has increased during the rains; Health Department has issued an alert.
article.articleSummary: Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh: Dengue risk has risen during the monsoon; the Health Department issued an alert. A program attended by Mission Director NHM PK Srivastav, Commissioner Inder Vikram Singh, and District Magistrate Deepak Meena, among senior officials, distributed awareness posters detailing dengue prevention. Officials outlined symptoms—high fever, headache, muscle and joint pains, retro-orbital pain, vomiting, and rash—and urged prompt medical consultation at nearby health facilities rather than self-medication. During the event, Managing Director Dr. Ujjwal Kumar, along with Dr. Shubhra Mishra, Dr. Ranjana Khare, Dr. Jayan Kumar, and Pawan Kumar Arun, provided dengue guidelines. The report highlights heightened dengue risk during rains and a public health alert in Gorakhpur as of 30 August 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ゴーラクプルニュース：雨季にデング熱のリスク増大、保健局が警戒発令
triage.triage_reason: 毎年恒例の季節性デング熱に対する予防啓発活動であり、異常な流行や重症例の急増を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: モンスーン期の季節性デング熱に対するルーティンの予防啓発・行政対応であり、具体的な感染者数や異常な増加を示すデータはない。

article.articleHeadline: Raj min Kirori Lal Meena discharged after H1N1 treatment | Jaipur News
article.articleSummary: Rajasthan's agriculture minister Kirori Lal Meena was discharged from Sawai Man Singh Hospital in Jaipur after improvement in H1N1 influenza, following ICU admission late Tuesday night for respiratory distress, fever, and flu-like symptoms. He tested positive for H1N1 and required intensive care due to breathing difficulties but was released after a medical board’s approval, with ongoing supervision since admission. The discharge comes amid a rising swine flu situation in Rajasthan, where more than 70 H1N1 cases were reported in August 2026. Health officials urged people with severe flu symptoms—breathing difficulty, persistent high fever, extreme weakness, or low oxygen levels—to seek prompt medical care. They warned against self-medicating with antibiotics or antivirals, and urged adherence to hygiene practices to help prevent infection and reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ラジャスタン州農業相キロリ・ラル・ミーナ氏、H1N1治療後に退院｜ジャイプールニュース
triage.triage_reason: 州閣僚がH1N1でICU入院・退院した事例に加え、ラジャスタン州で8月に70件超の症例が報告されており、感染拡大と重症例のリスクが確認されるため、続報監視を含むフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性H1N1のラジャスタン州における感染拡大（8月に70件超）と、州閣僚のICU入院という政治的注目度の高さから、地域的な流行状況の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Man dies after testing positive for H1N1 in Shimla - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: A 64-year-old Bilaspur man died at Indira Gandhi Medical College and Hospital (IGMC) in Shimla after testing positive for H1N1 (swine flu). Admitted August 13, he tested positive on August 29 and died around 7 am on August 30 during treatment. He had pre-existing interstitial lung disease and lower-lobe pneumonia, with additional health complications that contributed to his critical condition. IGMC officials said the death should not be attributed solely to H1N1. They noted the outcome reflects the impact of chronic lung disease on influenza outcomes. People with influenza-like symptoms—high fever, cough, sore throat or breathing difficulty—are urged to seek prompt medical care, and the elderly or those with pre-existing lung or serious illnesses should take extra precautions.

triage.headline_ja: シムラーでH1N1陽性判定を受けた男性が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）による単発の死亡例であり、基礎疾患（間質性肺疾患・肺炎）が主因とされている。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であり、地域的な単発死亡例。IGMC当局も基礎疾患の影響を強調しており、公衆衛生上の重大な脅威とは評価されない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 1 300 patients déclarés guéris
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more than 1,300 patients declared cured.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: an epidemiological report published August 28, 2026 covers six provinces and 60 health zones affected, with Ituri and North Kivu driving transmission. Provinces affected are Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu (Miti-Murhesa), Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uele, and Tshopo. Cumulative confirmed cases: 5,945; currently in isolation or hospitalized: 896; recovered: 1,327; deaths: 2,862 (case fatality 48.1%). Contact follow-up rate: 84.4%. No new health zone was affected in the last 24 hours; the response remains focused on active transmission areas, particularly Ituri which concentrates most cases and zones. Interventions continue at the community level—dialogues, radio broadcasts, health facility and school sensitization, rumor clarification, psychosocial support, and measures to prevent exploitation and sexual abuse. More than 1,300 people have recovered (1,327).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱（コンゴ民主共和国）：1,300人以上の患者が治癒と宣言
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で6州60保健地域にまたがる大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、累計確定症例5,945例、死亡2,862例（致死率48.1%）と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 既知の大規模継続中エボラ流行の経過報告。致死率48.1%と非常に高く、Ituri州を中心に感染継続。既存のRRA対象イベントの続報として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: Himachal: स्वाइन फ्लू पॉजिटिव बुजुर्ग की IGMC में मौत! स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने जारी की एडवाइजरी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Himachal: Swine flu-positive elderly dies at IGMC; Health Department issues advisory.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) death reported in Shimla, Himachal Pradesh: a 64-year-old Bilaspur district resident, Ramashish Ram, died at Indira Gandhi Medical College and Hospital (IGMC) after testing positive for H1N1 on August 29, amid pre-existing interstitial lung disease and lower lobar pneumonia. Admitted on August 13 with severe respiratory distress; despite continuous medical intervention, the patient succumbed. Health department notes the death cannot be attributed solely to H1N1, stressing chronic respiratory illnesses as major contributing factors. An advisory issued for the elderly and those with pre-existing conditions urges seeking prompt medical care for fever, persistent cough, sore throat, or breathing difficulties, to avoid crowded places, cover coughs, maintain hand hygiene, and follow medical guidance regarding medications.

triage.headline_ja: ヒマーチャル州：スワインフルー陽性の高齢者がIGMCで死亡、保健当局が注意喚起を発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1（豚インフルエンザ）による散発的な死亡例であり、基礎疾患（間質性肺疾患・肺炎）が主要因とされている。地域的流行や異常性は認められず、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとしてインドで毎年一定数発生しており、本例は基礎疾患を有する高齢者の単発死亡例。保健当局が通常の注意喚起（advisory）を発出したのみで、大規模流行やアウトブレイクの兆候は記事内に見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Haut-Uele : les chefs d'établissements d'enseignement formés à la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uele: school principals trained in outbreak response - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola preparedness training for 58 principals from Catholic-affiliated primary and secondary schools of the Diocese of Isiro-Niangara, Haut-Uele, Democratic Republic of the Congo, took place on 30 August 2026 in Isiro (EP Tely 1 hall). The one-day session, part of the Ebola outbreak response, was led by a priest-doctor, a health technician and member of the provincial response team, who provided the disease’s history, transmission, potential consequences, and practical preventive measures. The objective is to equip school leaders to implement preventive arrangements in their campuses ahead of the 2026-2027 academic year and to cascade knowledge to teachers and students. Participants were urged to comply with directives from national and provincial education authorities, and to adopt the announced prevention measures within their schools. Enrollment activity was high as parents register children, underscoring the need for a safe rentrée.

triage.headline_ja: オー・ウエレ州でのエボラ出血熱:学校長らが対応訓練を受講 - ACP通信
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国オー・ウエレ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関連した対応であり、エボラは致死性が高く国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクを伴う疾患であるため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 本記事自体は新規症例情報を含まず、学校における予防研修活動の報告であるが、既存のエボラアウトブレイク対応の一環であるため、進行中の公衆衛生上の懸念として引き続き監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : un réseau d'écoles privées renforce les mesures de prévention contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: a network of private schools strengthens Ebola prevention measures - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Beni, North Kivu, DRC — a network of private schools strengthened Ebola prevention ahead of the new school year. At a teacher training session, schools installed handwashing stations and reduced classroom occupancy to limit contacts. Desk arrangements vary by level: secondary schools—one pupil per desk; primary—two per desk; preschool—each child has an individual chair; in some secondary options, spaces are limited to maintain distancing. Parents were urged to support prevention at home by supplying hand sanitizer and individual water bottles to avoid sharing cups. Teachers trained in Ebola prevention will educate and protect the school community, with assurances that the outbreak is controllable if barrier gestures are observed.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ:私立学校ネットワークがエボラ予防対策を強化 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国ベニでの学校におけるエボラ予防措置の強化を報じているが、新規感染者数や死亡者数など具体的な流行状況のデータがなく、既存の発生に対する対応策に留まるため、フルRRAに進む決定的な情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ流行に対する学校での予防策強化に関する内容であり、新規症例数や死亡者数など疫学的詳細は記載されていない。ベニ地域での継続的な感染リスクが示唆されるため、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Haut-Uele : report de la rentrée scolaire au petit séminaire de Rungu - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uele: Delay of the start of the school year at the Rungu Minor Seminary - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Haut-Uele, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, leads to postponement of the 2026-2027 school year start at the Rungu Minor Seminary. Rector Emmanuel Langi announced in Isiro after a meeting with doctors of the Isiro-Niangara Diocese that the reopening is delayed to harmonize preventive measures amid ongoing transmission. The decision, intended to protect students and staff, awaits concrete guidance from the national or provincial Ministry of Education to align policies across the seminary. The effective start date will be announced later. The report does not provide case counts, but emphasizes that the Ebola outbreak remains active, underscoring heightened caution for educational facilities in Haut-Uele.

triage.headline_ja: オー＝ウエレ州でのエボラ出血熱：ルング小神学校の新学期開始延期 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCオー＝ウエレ州でエボラ出血熱の感染が継続しており、学校再開延期という社会的影響が生じている。IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）が2つ該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は症例数を報告していないが、エボラ流行が継続中であることを強調。教育機関への影響（学校再開延期）が社会的関心を示す一方、感染規模や国際的拡大リスクに関する具体的情報は不足しているため、フルリスク評価での詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : le gouverneur annonce des laboratoires contre Ebola et des mesures pour Mambasa - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: The Governor Announces Ebola Laboratories and Measures for Mambasa - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease resurgence in Ituri province, Mandima health zone, DRC, with 13 laboratory-confirmed cases and 10 deaths reported since the first confirmed case on June 15. Governor Kasongo Mulumba Batoka Gaby announced the urgent deployment of mobile Ebola laboratories and treatment centers in Mambasa territory to accelerate screening and care. The move follows civil-society briefings from Babila Babombi highlighting a triple crisis—health, security, and logistics—in the area; community engagement is urged to aid responses and protect medical teams. Insecurity persists, including August 26 incursions into the chiefdom capital and illicit roadblocks that hinder access and movement. The governor pledged to remove illegal barriers and conducted a planned field assessment to strengthen operations. Civil leaders will continue public awareness and alert systems in collaboration with authorities.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：知事がエボラ対策の検査室設置とマンバサ地域への対策を発表 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州マンディマ保健地区でエボラ出血熱の再燃が確認され、13例の検査確定例と10例の死亡が報告されている。治安不安も重なり国際支援が必要な深刻な公衆衛生事案であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く（10/13例）、治安悪化により対応が困難な状況。移動式検査室・治療センターの緊急展開が発表されている。国境を越えた拡大リスクは明示的記載はないが、エボラの特性上考慮が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kiểm soát vận chuyển, kinh doanh động vật để giám sát dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Regulate the movement and trade of animals to monitor diseases
article.articleSummary: On July 26, Ho Chi Minh City authorities, through the Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary, conducted surprise checks on animal transport at key corridors and entry points, uncovering three lots of pigs totaling 280 animals (35,350 kg) that tested positive for prohibited Beta-agonists (Salbutamol, Clenbuterol) and animal diseases. To proactively monitor animal health and ensure veterinary hygiene and food safety, the city's People's Committee directs the Department of Agriculture and Environment, in coordination with agencies, to strengthen disease prevention and strictly regulate movements of animals and animal products into, out of, and through the city. The agricultural sector will intensify checks on transport, collection, slaughter of animals and products. The Department of Industry and Trade should tighten oversight of animal product trade and coordinate for traceability and violation handling. Police and authorities will cooperate with veterinary and market authorities to investigate and address violations, including cases with criminal indicators.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病監視のための動物の輸送・取引の規制
triage.triage_reason: 動物の違法薬物使用及び流通規制に関する行政的な取り組みであり、ヒトへの感染症発生や公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 疾患名は'Unknown Illness'だが、記事内容は動物の禁止薬物残留（サルブタモール等）及び家畜取引規制に関する行政対応であり、感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kiểm soát vận chuyển, kinh doanh động vật để giám sát dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Controlling the movement and trade of animals to monitor disease outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City authorities tighten control of animal movement, trade, and slaughter to monitor disease outbreaks and ensure veterinary hygiene and food safety. Following Circular No. 2833/CNTY-KD&TYCĐ (July 31, 2026) from the Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary under the Ministry of Agriculture and Environment, the city directs intensified inspection and supervision of animal diseases, veterinary hygiene, food safety, and use of banned substances in farming. On July 26, 2026, the City veterinary department and authorities conducted surprise checks of animal transport at key transit points, uncovering three lots of pigs totaling 280 animals (≈35,350 kg) positive for banned Beta-agonists (Salbutamol, Clenbuterol) and for animal disease. To proactively control outbreaks, the Department of Agriculture and Environment is to coordinate with other agencies to tighten movement controls of live animals and animal products entering, exiting, or passing through the city, and to strengthen surveillance at transport corridors and suspected sites.

triage.headline_ja: 疫病監視のための動物輸送・取引の管理強化
triage.triage_reason: 動物の輸送・取引管理と禁止薬物（ベータ作動薬）検出に関する行政的措置の記事であり、具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は動物疾病予防のための行政的な取締り強化と禁止薬物検出についての報道であり、具体的な疾患名やヒトへの感染事例は記載されていない。'Unknown Illness'という疾患名分類はBluedotの自動分類によるもので、実際の疾病は特定されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Thói quen dùng chung dao cạo có thể lây HIV: Cảnh báo sức khỏe 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The habit of sharing razors can transmit HIV: Health Alert 2026
article.articleSummary: As of 30 August 2026, a Chinese health alert highlights HIV transmission risk from sharing personal grooming tools, illustrated by a Sichuan case where long-term shared razor use led to HIV infection. The risk arises when tools with blood contact create small skin abrasions during shaving, enabling bloodborne exposure. HIV is mainly spread via unsafe sexual contact, blood exposure, and mother-to-child transmission; routine activities like handshakes or shared meals do not spread HIV. Other high-risk scenarios include shared needles, tattooing, piercing, cosmetic tattooing, or invasive medical procedures in unsanitary settings with non-sterile instruments. Precautions include using personal items, selecting reputable facilities with proper infection control, and seeking prompt medical evaluation after potential exposure. Post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) should be started within 72 hours when indicated, underscoring the need for rapid action rather than stigma toward people living with HIV.

triage.headline_ja: 剃刀の共有習慣がHIV感染を引き起こす可能性：2026年健康警告
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例に基づく一般的な健康啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や集団発生を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は個人の感染事例を契機とした一般的なHIV予防啓発記事であり、集団感染やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: मॉनसून डाइट टिप्स: वायरल फीवर से बचाएगा सही खान-पान, एमजीएम की डाइटिशियन से जानिए क्या खाएं और किससे बचें - monsoon diet tips prevent viral fever with expert food guide
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monsoon Diet Tips: The Right Diet to Prevent Viral Fever - Learn from MGM's Dietitian What to Eat and What to Avoid
article.articleSummary: Monsoon season raises risks of viral fever, malaria, and digestive issues in Jamshedpur, prompting dietetic guidance from MGM Medical College & Hospital dietitian Annu Mishra. Emphasizes immunity-boosting foods: fresh seasonal vegetables, pulses, turmeric, ginger, and garlic; stay hydrated with warm water; avoid street foods, cut fruits, fried, and stale items. Diet advice is tailored by age: Children should consume light, easily digestible meals such as warm tomato or greens soups and khichdi, with ground almonds/walnuts in milk, while avoiding cold milk, ice cream, and junk foods. Women should focus on anemia- prevention with vitamin C–rich options (fresh papaya or pomegranate juice, apples, lemon water) and a herbal kadha; sprouts should be cooked or steamed. Elderly benefit from easy-to-digest options like golden milk (turmeric milk), oats or porridge, and increased ginger and garlic, while avoiding oily/spicy, stale, and raw vegetables. Emphasizes hot, homemade meals and boiled or lukewarm water due to humid conditions.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーンダイエットのコツ：正しい食事でウイルス性発熱を予防 - MGMの栄養士に聞く、何を食べるべきか、何を避けるべきか
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、季節性の一般的な健康・食事アドバイス記事であり、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリアやウイルス性発熱の予防に関する一般的な栄養士のアドバイスであり、具体的な発生・アウトブレイク情報を含まないため対象国リストへの計上は行わない。

article.articleHeadline: फलावदा में गोवंश पर मंडराया लंपी बीमारी का खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lumpy disease threat looms over cattle in Phalavda.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) suspected in cattle in the Phalavda area, raising concern among livestock owners. Reported symptoms include weakness, fever, lumps on the body, and reduced appetite in cows and other cattle. Official confirmation requires veterinary department testing. Local residents are urging a rapid response, calling for a dedicated field-surveillance campaign with veterinary teams to survey villages, diagnose sick animals, provide timely treatment, and educate farmers on signs, prevention, and care. They emphasize isolating sick stock, maintaining clean animal shelters, and following veterinary guidance on medicines. Additional measures against mosquitoes and other pests are sought to limit possible transmission. Given livestock’s central role in livelihoods, stakeholders stress awareness, preventive care, and prompt veterinary intervention.

triage.headline_ja: ファラーウダーで牛にランピースキン病の脅威が迫る
triage.triage_reason: 動物のみの感染症（人獣共通感染症ではないランピースキン病）であり、疑い例で公式確認もされておらず、公衆衛生への影響やヒトへの感染リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病は牛の感染症でヒトには感染しない。地域住民の懸念は高いが、獣医学的対応の範疇であり公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。

Health authorities have intensified monitoring and vigilance to curb the spread in the district, reflecting an ongoing outbreak that requires clinical surveillance and preparedness in local healthcare facilities.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of deaths from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has exceeded 2,800 people - MigNews - News of Israel and the World in Russian.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has total deaths exceeding 2,800 with 5,945 confirmed cases since its May start. At least 1,327 people have recovered, while 896 patients remain in isolation or hospital care. The outbreak has spread to 60 health zones across six provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, and Chopo. The World Health Organization notes that the Bundibugyo strain continues to evolve and maintain sustained transmission; in the past three months, cases and geographic spread have risen substantially, signaling a major escalation of the outbreak. Last week, Congolese authorities began vaccinating health workers and other frontline responders. Dr. Richard Kitenge emphasized that containment will largely depend on local engagement and cooperation with medical teams.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による死者数が2800人を超える - MigNews

article.articleHeadline: Anugola: 9 suspected scrub typhus cases test negative, 30 more samples sent for lab test
article.articleSummary: As of 30 August 2026, in Anugola district nine suspected scrub typhus cases tested negative by ELISA after rapid on-site testing, according to CDMO Madan Mohan Pradhan. Thirty additional samples, which tested positive in field tests today, are being sent for ELISA in phases with expectations of negative results. All suspected patients are receiving hospital treatment. Authorities urge the public to avoid forested areas where infected mites in vegetation are commonly found. The state Health Department reports close monitoring, with the district health team on-site and active surveillance and preventive measures initiated to safeguard public health. No confirmed scrub typhus cases have been reported at this time, and officials say there is no reason for public panic.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate change rattles city residents: surge in viral flu; breathing problems in children.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 August 2026, Bengaluru faces a climate-driven surge in H1N1 concerns due to monsoon rains, fluctuating temperatures, and air quality shifts. Fever, viral flu, and respiratory infections are rising among children and the elderly, with increasing hospital admissions. In the preceding week across Karnataka, 571 viral influenza cases were confirmed, 344 SARI (Severe Acute Respiratory Infection) cases detected, and 3,232 ADD (Acute Diarrheal Disease) cases recorded. Pediatric viral illnesses in major city hospitals have risen about 10–15%. Health authorities warn that weather variability is amplifying risk. Schoolchildren are spreading flu-like symptoms rapidly; parents should not send feverish or coughing children to school and should limit contact until recovery. Do not self-medicate; seek medical advice promptly. Keep children warm, avoid dusty or smoky environments, and emphasize hand hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動が市民を悩ませる：ウイルス性インフルエンザ増加、子供たちに呼吸器系の問題

Dengue shows 112 positives from 21,969 samples with 103 recoveries. Pediatric seasonal illnesses surge due to rain, with viral fever, cough/cold, diarrhea, eye infections; every third child presents with tonsillar swelling and conjunctivitis. A Flu OPD will start Monday at Government Doon Medical College Hospital, with basic triage and testing to reduce crowding; emphasis on hygiene and avoiding self-medication.

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis, H1N1 drive rise in disease deaths
article.articleSummary: Ernakulam district (Kochi) reported 35 deaths from communicable diseases in 59 days (July 1–Aug 28, 2026), up from 29 in 62 days last year. Leptospirosis caused 19 fatalities, followed by H1N1 influenza with seven, while deaths due to fever, West Nile virus infection, influenza A and B, hepatitis A, dengue, and SARI comprised the remainder. Officials attribute the rise to comorbidities such as diabetes and severe cardiac illness, delayed diagnosis, and delayed treatment; audits of each fatality are underway and containment measures have begun. Experts note many leptospirosis infections are mild or asymptomatic and go unreported, delaying diagnosis when patients present with fever or body ache after wet soil exposure. Early antibiotic treatment after exposure improves outcomes, while H1N1 spreads through the air and typically peaks during the monsoon.

article.articleHeadline: Angul Scrub Typhus Update: Rapid Tests Not Confirmed, 9 ELISA Results Negative
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus in Angul/Anugola region is under cautious monitoring after nine rapid-test positives were all negative on ELISA, the confirmatory test. Rapid kits are screening tools; they do not establish confirmed cases. Remaining samples are undergoing ELISA validation. Earlier local reports from Palalahada and Sanabagdar under Khamar CHC, plus a death under investigation at VIMSAR, Burla, prompted alerts, but officials stress scrub typhus is mite-borne and treatable when identified; it is often mistaken for malaria. No confirmed outbreak yet; district health teams are on the ground with active surveillance and public-health measures. Residents are advised not to panic, seek care early for fever, and follow fever guidance. Preventive actions include clearing overgrown grass and scrub and avoiding walking barefoot in monsoon fields; await official ELISA results and health-department updates rather than rumours.

article.articleHeadline: 'High risk warning' over virus with no vaccine that kills almost 50% of patients
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 5,794 confirmed cases and 2,786 deaths (48.1% CFR). The outbreak spans 60 health zones across six provinces, with epicentres in Ituri and North Kivu. No approved vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo; the ERVEBO vaccine for the Zaire strain is ineffective against Bundibugyo, though frontline workers may be offered it for partial protection. WHO has issued a 'very high risk' warning and advises against blanket travel or trade bans while monitoring cross-border implications. Uganda declared the end of its cross-border outbreak on August 26; there have been isolated medical evacuations to Germany and France. The PARTNERS trial began July 2 in three Ituri facilities, enrolling over 250 confirmed cases; TACG recommended Ervebo be prioritized for randomized trials in this outbreak context. Emphasis on rapid case recognition, testing, and optimized supportive care.

article.articleHeadline: No Need To Panic Over Scrub Typhus Reports In Anugola: Health Dept

In the first phase, nine individuals who tested positive on rapid tests were all negative by ELISA, with remaining samples under validation. The district health team has been deployed to the affected area to assess the situation and provide medical care as needed. Preventive measures including active surveillance and other public health interventions have been initiated to prevent spread. The department emphasizes continuous monitoring and urges the public not to panic, noting rapid-test positives do not confirm infection and that steps are being taken to safeguard public health. As of 30 August 2026, no confirmed cases have been reported.

article.articleHeadline: Health dept steps up scrub typhus surveillance in Angul | Bhubaneswar News
article.articleSummary: Angul district, Odisha: Health and Family Welfare department has intensified scrub typhus surveillance after suspected cases were reported from Sanbagdari village in Pallahara block. Seven villagers were initially positive by rapid diagnostic tests, prompting blood samples from nine people; subsequent Elisa tests returned negative. On Sunday, 12 more samples were sent for Elisa confirmation, with results due on Monday. The death of 30-year-old Sumanta Sethi from the same village prompted investigation; he was initially negative, later privately labeled scrub typhus positive, but officials say it remains an unconfirmed suspected death. Authorities stress no alarm but urged awareness campaigns and early medical care for symptoms after mite-infested exposure. Typical symptoms include fever, headache, body aches and rashes; incubation 5–14 days after a bite. Odisha logged 2,800+ cases and eight deaths in 2023, and 1,600+ cases with two deaths in 2024.

article.articleHeadline: ଗାଁରେ ବ୍ୟାପୁଛି ସ୍କ୍ରବ୍ ଟାଇଫସ୍ | Scrub Typhus Alert in Angul: 39 Test Positive in Sanabaghdari

The report frames this as a health alert in Odisha, centered on Sanabaghdari, highlighting ongoing public health risk in the Angul area. article.articleHeadline: Seasonal water changes drive disease risk in Brazil's semiarid region
article.articleSummary: Three rural communities in Brazil’s Semiarid region (Quixeramobim and Quixadá, Ceará) study links between seasonal water changes and diarrhea risk. In 2025, researchers tracked water use across sources for households lacking public water supply, sampling in February, April, and September to bracket wet and dry seasons. Water sources included rainwater cisterns, hand-dug wells, surface reservoirs, tanker SISAR water, with samples tested for physicochemical parameters (temperature, ORP, alkalinity, electrical conductivity) and microbiology (total coliforms, E. coli). Diarrhea episodes were logged and analyzed alongside hydroclimate data using Kruskal-Wallis, Fisher’s exact, Cochran’s Q, and chi-square tests. 2025 rainfall fell sharply: Quixeramobim −35.2%, Quixadá −27.9% vs 2024, draining cisterns and prompting sharing with neighbors. As cisterns dwindle, drinking water remains prioritized while hygiene relies on more exposed surface sources, lowering water quality and increasing infection risk. ORP emerged as a key seasonal and community discriminator of water safety.

triage.headline_ja: 季節的な水環境の変化がブラジル半乾燥地域における疾病リスクを高める
triage.triage_reason: これは特定の疾病アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、水質と下痢リスクの関連性を調べた学術研究の記事であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定のアウトブレイクではなく、ブラジル・セアラ州の農村部における季節的な水利用パターンと下痢症リスクの関連を調べた研究報告であるため、対象国の実発生イベントとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Scrub typhus cases detected in Odishas Angul; medical team sent
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus detected in Pallahara block, Angul district, Odisha, with 29 Sanbagadri villagers testing positive on rapid tests (not confirmatory). A state medical team conducted door-to-door surveys to identify suspected cases. In the first phase, all nine rapid-test positives were confirmed negative by ELISA, while remaining samples await confirmatory ELISA testing. Scrub typhus is an infectious bacterial disease transmitted by bites of infected larval mites. Health authorities report no panic and have begun active surveillance and other public health interventions in the area, with continuous monitoring to safeguard public health. The case cluster underscores the need for confirmatory testing and timely medical care for suspected cases, as officials continue assessment of infection sources and transmission dynamics in Angul. Published August 30, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州アングル県でツツガムシ病の症例を検出、医療チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: インド・オディシャ州で29名の迅速検査陽性者が確認されたが、確認検査(ELISA)では最初の9名全員が陰性となり、確定症例は未確認。地域限定的で人-人感染はないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、続報（確認検査結果）を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ツツガムシ病はダニ媒介性の風土病で、ヒト-ヒト感染はしない。確認検査で陽性者数が大幅に減少しており、実際の感染拡大規模は不明。地方当局が積極的サーベイランスを実施中であり、外部支援の必要性は低いと見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Dehradun News: दून में इन्फ्लूएंजा और कोरोना के 3-3 नए केस
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dehradun News: Three new influenza cases and three new coronavirus cases in Dehradun.
article.articleSummary: Dehradun, 30 August 2026 — H1N1 influenza and COVID-19 cases continue to rise in Dehradun district. Sunday testing yielded 3 positive H1N1 of 13 samples and 3 positive COVID-19 of 7 samples. Cumulatively, H1N1 totals 81 cases (55 in Dehradun, 26 from other districts/states), with 50 recoveries, 26 active hospitalizations, and 5 deaths. The infections include 49 men and 32 women, and the most affected age group is 1–10 years (20 cases). COVID-19 has 23 cases this year; 19 recovered, 4 currently hospitalized, and no fatalities. Dengue surveillance recorded 98 samples on Sunday with no new cases; 9 active dengue patients are under treatment. Across districts, 22,067 dengue tests have been conducted, revealing 112 infections (54 Dehradun, 58 elsewhere) and 103 recoveries. Health officials urge continued vigilance in hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: デヘラドゥン・ニュース：デヘラドゥンでインフルエンザとコロナの新規感染者各3人
triage.triage_reason: H1N1・COVID-19・デング熱ともに既知の季節性流行の範囲内であり、地域限定的かつ管理下にあるため、国際的拡大や渡航制限等のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 地方紙による地域保健当局の定例的なサーベイランス報告であり、季節性疾患の通常範囲内の数値。死亡例(H1N1で5名)はあるが継続的な公衆衛生上の重大リスクを示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: All 9 rapid-test scrub typhus cases in Angul test negative in ELISA: Odisha govt
article.articleSummary: On 30 August 2026, Odisha's Health Department reported scrub typhus concerns in Angul district's Pallahara block after rapid-test screening in Sanbagadri village identified 29 positives, though rapid tests are not confirmatory. In a first phase, all nine individuals who tested positive on the rapid kit have been confirmed negative by ELISA (enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay); remaining samples are undergoing confirmatory ELISA testing. A medical team has conducted door-to-door surveys in Sanbagadri and launched active surveillance and public health interventions to identify suspected cases and provide care. Scrub typhus, a bacterial disease transmitted by bites of infected larval mites, is the etiological context. Health officials stated there is no panic and that the situation is under continuous monitoring with on-site assessment and measures to safeguard public health.

triage.headline_ja: アングル県のツツガムシ病迅速検査陽性9件、ELISA検査で全て陰性と判明:オディシャ州政府
triage.triage_reason: 迅速検査陽性例はELISA確認検査で全て陰性となり、地方病であるツツガムシ病の限定的な事例であり、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威は認められない。
triage.notes: ツツガムシ病はインド農村部で地域流行が見られる媒介動物媒介性疾患。今回の事例は迅速検査陽性が確認検査で否定され、地元保健当局が監視・対応を実施中であり、パニックはないと発表されている。

article.articleHeadline: Gorakhpur News: वायरल का हर अटैक नहीं है स्वाइन फ्लू
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gorakhpur News: Not Every Viral Attack Is Swine Flu.
article.articleSummary: Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh: Not a new H1N1 mutant, the surge is a seasonal influenza peak driven by weather. Uttar Pradesh-wide surveillance has been intensified to identify suspected cases promptly. BRD Medical College and the district hospital report an action plan with adequate antiviral stock, PPE and N-95 masks, dedicated isolation wards and ventilators, and ready laboratory testing and sampling kits. Doctors warn against self-medication with antibiotics like azithromycin or amoxicillin, noting antibiotics do not treat viral fever and misuse risks superbugs and liver/kidney damage. H1N1 spreads through airborne droplets in crowded, poorly ventilated settings; elderly people, children, and those with diabetes, hypertension, or asthma are at higher risk. Preventive guidance includes masking, hand hygiene, hydration, and seeking medical care for fever, sore throat, or body aches. Authorities urge calm and adherence to public health guidance, with no shortage of medicines or masks.

triage.headline_ja: ゴーラクプル・ニュース：すべてのウイルス感染がスワインフルーとは限らない
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの流行であり、新型変異株ではないと明記されている。医療体制も整っており、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1含む）の通常の流行に対する誤情報の是正と公衆衛生対応の説明であり、異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Paludisme: pourquoi le réchauffement climatique pourrait réduire la transmission en Afrique de l'Ouest
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria: Why Global Warming Could Reduce Transmission in West Africa.
article.articleSummary: Malaria, caused by Plasmodium parasites and transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes, is reconfiguring across sub‑Saharan Africa as the climate warms. A July 2026 Nature study of 50,425 surveys from 1900–2016 links rising temperatures to differing malaria trends: transmission centered around 25°C, dropping below 16°C or above 34°C. In East and Southern Africa, warming likely increases malaria, while West Africa shows reductions, with about 5% fewer cases in Nigeria, Burkina Faso, and Mali and possible elimination in Niger, Gambia, Guinea‑Bissau, and Somalia. Conversely, cooler regions may see rises: ~5% in East African highlands (Ethiopia, Kenya, Burundi) and in Angola, Zambia, and northeast South Africa, with up to 20% in the Rift Valley and southern coast by 2100. The authors urge earlier anti‑malarial programs in warming regions and climate mitigation to keep warming below 2°C. In 2024, malaria caused about 610,000 deaths globally, ~580,000 in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア：地球温暖化が西アフリカでの感染拡大を抑制する可能性がある理由
triage.triage_reason: 気候変動とマラリア流行パターンに関する学術研究の紹介記事であり、急性の公衆衛生イベントや異常な発生報告ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は将来予測に関する科学研究の報道であり、対象国リストに含まれる国（Zambia等）は将来的なマラリア増加リスク地域として言及されているが、現時点での発生イベントではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: No need to panic over scrub typhus reports in Angul: Odisha govt
article.articleSummary: As of 30 August 2026, Odisha's Angul district reported nine scrub typhus cases that initially tested positive on rapid tests but were subsequently negative on confirmatory ELISA tests; ELISA testing for remaining samples is underway. A district health team has been deployed to the spot to assess medical care and ensure necessary treatment. The Health Department has initiated precautionary and preventive measures, including active surveillance and other public health interventions, and states the situation is being closely monitored. Authorities urge the public not to panic and emphasize continuous monitoring to safeguard public health.

triage.headline_ja: アングルでのツツガムシ病報告についてパニックの必要なし:オディシャ州政府
triage.triage_reason: インド・オディシャ州で発生したツツガムシ病の疑い例は、確認検査(ELISA)で陰性となり、地域の風土病であり深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大の懸念も低い。
triage.notes: ツツガムシ病はインド国内の風土病であり、今回の疑い例は確認検査で陰性、政府も『パニックの必要なし』と発表しており、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, il visus subdolo uccide e contagia ancora: difficili e rischiosi gli aiuti: c'è la guerra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the insidious virus kills and continues to infect: aid is difficult and risky: there is war.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province, northeast, near Kivu) has caused about 2,862 deaths and over 6,000 confirmed infections, amid ongoing war and displacement. Violence involving Hema and Lendu communities, militia Codeco, Zaïre-FPAC, and the M23 in the Ituri and neighboring regions hampers aid delivery and fuels mass movements of civilians toward Kivu. MSF records 60 emergency health zones; the case-fatality rate is about 48.1% based on data through late August 2026, with health workers targeted (roughly 260 attacks) and eight aid workers killed, plus 43 Ebola deaths among respondents. The DRC received the first batch of the Ervebo vaccine; however, efficacy against the Bundibugyo strain is uncertain and no fully proven vaccine exists. WHO notes about 70,000 more doses expected for trial-based use and stresses ongoing clinical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、狡猾なウイルスが今なお人命を奪い感染を広げる:支援は困難かつ危険、そこには戦争がある
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラ流行が2,862人の死亡・6,000人超の感染に達し、致死率約48.1%と極めて高く、紛争により対応が困難な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 紛争地域での大規模流行であり、ワクチン(Ervebo)の株特異的有効性不明、医療従事者への攻撃多数など、フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。キブ州への人口移動により地理的拡大のリスクも高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : la Croix-Rouge dotée de trois jeeps dont une ambulance médicalisée - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: the Red Cross equipped with three jeeps, one of which is a medicalized ambulance - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Three jeeps, including a medicalized ambulance, donated by the IFRC to the Red Cross of the Democratic Republic of Congo in Kisangani (Tshopo) bolster the Ebola response, addressing early mobility challenges. The donation was welcomed by Provincial Health Division head Bienvenue Ikomo and Health Minister Simon Bokongo, who underscored transport as critical for containment. UN OCHA humanitarian affairs official Gustave Ngandu reiterated ongoing support to mobilize resources to end Ebola, while Franck Gefeu Molanga, provincial Red Cross president, called the vehicles a bulwark against Ebola. A fourth jeep from the same batch will be sent to Bas-Uele province and deployed starting Monday.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニのエボラ対応:赤十字に医療搬送用救急車を含む3台のジープが提供される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 既知のDRCエボラアウトブレイクに対する物流支援(車両提供)についての続報記事であり、新規発生や急激な状況変化を示すものではないが、疾患の重大性から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はIFRC/赤十字による車両提供という既存のエボラ対応活動の一環を報じるもので、新規感染拡大や症例急増を示す情報は含まれていない。既存のRRA対象イベントの一部として扱うべきと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: ভয় ধরাচ্ছে 'ফ্যালসিফেরাম ম্যালেরিয়া', ক্ষতি হতে পারে মস্তিষ্ক, কিডনির, সতর্ক করছেন চিকিৎসক
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Falciparum malaria is alarming; it can damage the brain and kidneys, doctors warn.
article.articleSummary: Plasmodium falciparum malaria is rising in West Bengal, India, with Kolkata seeing severe cases during the monsoon. As of July 31, over 5,500 malaria cases statewide, including 1,062 cases of Plasmodium falciparum malaria—the most dangerous form, which can cause cerebral malaria and kidney damage. In Kolkata's Ward 58 (Tapsia), a grandmother and grandson were diagnosed with falciparum malaria. Symptoms include fever and chills; doctors warn of serious brain and kidney complications. Preventive measures include mosquito nets and blood tests if fever persists. Authorities are intensifying public awareness and vector-control measures to curb outbreaks, as health officials monitor dengue, malaria, and kala-azar across districts during the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: 『ファルシパルムマラリア』が脅威に――脳や腎臓への損傷の恐れ、医師が警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州で熱帯熱マラリア（重症化リスクの高い型）の症例増加が報告されているが、季節性の既知の感染症であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視するレベルと判断。
triage.notes: モンスーン季における例年の媒介蚊感染症（マラリア・デング・カラアザール）の増加報告。熱帯熱マラリアの重症例（脳症・腎障害）が地域で確認されているが、既知の季節的パターンであり地域当局が対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Over 27 H1N1 cases reported in Chikkamagaluru district during monsoon
article.articleSummary: Chikkamagaluru district reported 27 H1N1 influenza cases during the monsoon, a routine seasonal surge rather than a new variant. Koppa taluk accounted for eight cases, with NR Pura and Tarikere reporting six each. Authorities tested 128 suspected cases; 20 infected individuals recovered and were discharged. Symptoms include high fever, cough with yellow sputum, sore throat, itching, cold and runny nose, headache, body aches, fatigue, and sometimes vomiting, diarrhea, and breathing difficulty. Transmission is via droplets from coughing, sneezing or breathing. Laboratory confirmation is not required for all cases; only Category C cases (those with breathing difficulty along with the above symptoms) are tested. Preventive measures: regular handwashing, masking, cough-sneeze etiquette, avoiding crowded places when unwell, and maintaining hydration and nutrition. Pregnant women, small children, the elderly and those with other health issues should take extra precautions.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン期にチッカマガルール県でH1N1感染27例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 記事自体が季節性のインフルエンザ流行であり新変異株ではないと明記しており、症例数も限定的で公衆衛生上の重大な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行パターンとして報告されており、地域限定的かつ医療体制内で対応可能なレベル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Le virus progresse plus vite que les moyens déployés pour le combattre ! - La Presse de Tunisie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The virus is progressing faster than the means deployed to combat it! - The Tunisian Press.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak declared mid-May 2026 in Ituri, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, is advancing faster than response capacity. By Aug 26, 5,794 cases and 2,786 deaths; 1,293 recoveries and 843 in treatment; about 260 deaths per week. Six eastern provinces affected; Kinshasa, 1,800 km away, is at high risk. Uganda reported 20 cases and 2 deaths; its outbreak was declared over on Aug 27. No vaccine or specific treatment exists for the Bundibugyo strain, though the Ervebo vaccine (Zaïre strain) is used. WHO’s 'River Congo Without Ebola' screens river passenger traffic to curb spread along the Congo River. UN has mobilized over $80 million; a $2.13 billion humanitarian plan is only 48% funded, needing about $1.1 billion more. Burundi received $2 million CERF support; CERF funds total $24 million for border actions. This is the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak; incubation is 21 days with fever, headache, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, hemorrhages.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ウイルスの拡大速度が対策の展開速度を上回っている！ − チュニジア・プレス
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2026年5月から続くエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが拡大を続け、死者数・症例数が急増し国際的な資金・対応が追いついていない状況であり、ウガンダ・ブルンジへの越境拡大も確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ブルンジも影響を受けているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。キンシャサ（DRC）も高リスク地域として言及されているためDRCに含める。

article.articleHeadline: Woman tests H1N1 positive in Prayagraj, health dept steps up surveillance
article.articleSummary: One patient in Prayagraj tested positive for H1N1 (swine flu), prompting intensified district surveillance. The affected area, Sangam city Prayagraj, has the patient admitted to an isolation ward at SRN hospital; a 40-bed isolation ward is ready there, with a 10-bed unit at Tej Bahadur Sapru hospital. Health authorities reserved beds in district hospitals and instructed private hospitals and pathology centers to follow Central Government guidelines for H1N1 testing and treatment. H1N1 testing and medicines are available free of cost at district government facilities. Authorities urge residents with fever, cough, or cold to seek medical care rather than self-medicating. Transmission is mainly via droplets from coughing/sneezing and contact with contaminated surfaces. High-risk groups include children under 10, adults over 70, pregnant women, and individuals with diabetes, cancer, HIV/AIDS, or chronic illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: プラヤグラジで女性がH1N1陽性、保健当局が監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: 単発症例で季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の通常対応の範囲内と見られるが、地域の監視強化が行われているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: H1N1はインドで季節性流行があり、単発症例報告であるため通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と考えられる。続報での症例数増加の有無を注視。

article.articleHeadline: बालाघाट में खसरा, मलेरिया व कुपोषण का कहर, बैगा आदिवासियों के 26 बच्चों की मौत पर मचा हड़कंप, स्वास्थ्य अमले पर उठे सवाल
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles, malaria and malnutrition wreak havoc in Balaghat district; uproar over the deaths of 26 Baiga tribal children; questions raised about the health staff.
article.articleSummary: Balaghat district in Madhya Pradesh faces a deadly convergence of measles, malaria, and malnutrition, provoking protests over the deaths of 26 Baiga tribal children. This year, malaria has produced 1,080 cases nationwide, including 329 in Balaghat—of which 307 are falciparum malaria, considered highly dangerous. In 2025, Balaghat recorded about 1,200 malaria cases. Officials blame each other for the deaths, with some arguing measles does not kill, and others acknowledging only two malaria deaths. Most fatalities involve Baiga children from the Birsa and Bahr blocks. The health department reportedly avoided fieldwork due to fears of Maoist activity, complicating surveillance and response to the triple burden of measles, malaria, and malnutrition.

triage.headline_ja: バラガート県で麻疹・マラリア・栄養失調が猛威、バイガ族の子ども26人死亡に抗議殺到、保健当局に疑問の声
triage.triage_reason: インド・マディヤプラデーシュ州バラガート県の先住少数民族バイガの子ども26人が麻疹・マラリア・栄養失調の複合要因で死亡し、地域社会の抗議と当局への批判が発生している。IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にIran/Khuzestanが含まれるが、記事本文は完全にインド・マディヤプラデーシュ州バラガート県（バイガ族居住地区、Birsa・Bahrブロック）に関する内容であり、Iranとの関連は確認できない（地名の類似による誤検出と推定）。マオイスト活動への懸念から保健当局の現地活動が制限され、サーベイランス・対応が困難になっている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: पश्चिमी यूपी बना स्वाइन फ्लू का हॉटस्पॉट: तीन जिलों में 50 प्रतिशत केस, स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट पर - swine flu surge western up accounts for half of states h1n1 cases
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Western Uttar Pradesh Has Become a Swine Flu Hotspot: 50 Percent of Cases in Three Districts, Health Department on Alert — Swine Flu Surge: Western UP Accounts for Half of the State's H1N1 Cases.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A (H1N1) Swine Flu has become a hotspot in Uttar Pradesh, with 551 lab-confirmed cases in the state as of August 29, 2026. Western UP accounts for about half the cases (275): Gautam Buddh Nagar 189, Meerut 54, and Ghaziabad 32. Lucknow reports 113; Muzaffarnagar 11; Bulandshahr 10. Across 57 districts, cases are reported, with six districts in double digits; one case was recorded in Hapur during Aug 1–29, a period that saw 32 new detections. Health authorities are boosting testing, treatment, and reporting across public and private facilities. Hospitals must test all admitted SARIs for H1N1 and ensure RT-PCR kits, oseltamivir, bronchodilators, and essential oxygen resources. Public guidance emphasizes masks, hand hygiene, cough etiquette, avoiding crowds, and vaccination for high-risk individuals. Outreach uses 1300 ASHA workers and 400 ANMs for door-to-door awareness; RWAs and schools will assist. Bed capacity: district hospitals +10, CHCs +5; nodal surveillance officers named.

triage.headline_ja: 西部ウッタル・プラデーシュ州がスワイン・フルー（H1N1）のホットスポットに:3地区で州全体の50%の症例、保健当局が警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: 州全体で551例のH1N1確定例が報告され、感染は複数地区に拡大しヒト-ヒト感染が継続中。保健当局が病床増設・検査体制強化など積極的対応を取っており、行政的関心の高まりが確認できるためフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとしてインドで毎年発生しており、国際的な異常性は低い。ただし複数地区での急増と行政の警戒対応があるため、国内公衆衛生上の動向として注視・軽度のRRA実施が妥当。死亡数や重症度の詳細情報は記事内に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Drought can make disease outbreaks worse, and scientists now know why
article.articleSummary: Nearly two-thirds of the contiguous United States experienced drought in 2026, and UN counts say more than 77% of Earth's land has grown drier. Drought reshapes water availability, not just reducing it, and reorders interactions among people, wildlife, and disease vectors, amplifying outbreaks. In the Horn of Africa, drought followed by cholera outbreaks as displaced communities crowded around scarce water. In the western United States, a dry season coincided with a major avian botulism outbreak, killing more than 94,000 birds near Tule Lake. California’s 2013–2015 drought saw crowding around shrinking ponds and spikes in a waterborne frog parasite; later declines as habitats disappeared. Mosquito-borne viruses like West Nile and St. Louis encephalitis rose with drying. Valley fever increases with dust from dry conditions. In Indonesia, drought drove people to lower elevations, raising malaria deaths (554). Health agencies should monitor drought-driven changes around remaining water.

triage.headline_ja: 干ばつは感染症流行を悪化させる可能性がある、その理由を科学者が解明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は干ばつと感染症の関係について複数の過去事例を紹介する科学解説記事であり、特定の現在進行中のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は気候変動・干ばつと感染症リスクの関係についての一般的な科学ジャーナリズム記事で、複数国・複数時代（米国、アフリカの角、インドネシアなど）の過去事例をまとめたもの。インドネシアのマラリア死亡例（554人）も過去の事例として言及されているのみで、現在進行中の具体的なアウトブレイク情報ではないため、特定国のイベントとしてのトリアージ対象外と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: O inseto que conviveu com dinossauros há 66 milhões de anos e invadiu as casas para transmitir vermes perigosos para os pets
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The insect that coexisted with dinosaurs 66 million years ago and invaded homes to transmit worms dangerous to pets.
article.articleSummary: Fleas pose infection risks beyond itching. In dogs and cats, adult fleas are only about 5% of an infestation; eggs, larvae, and pupae develop off the host in bedding, carpets, gaps, and other pet-used spaces, sustaining cycles after adult fleas disappear. Transmission of Dipylidium caninum tapeworm occurs when a pet ingests an infected flea during grooming, with the parasite developing in the intestine. Females lay up to 50 eggs daily, and environmental stages persist weeks to months; the cycle runs about 21–28 days, depending on conditions. Fleas exhibit adaptations for parasitism: dorsally flattened bodies, ctenidia spines, specialized mouthparts, and hind legs enabling jumps up to 200× body length. Beyond tapeworms, flea feces can carry Bartonella henselae, linked to cat scratch disease in humans; thus control combines veterinarian-prescribed antiparasitics with thorough environmental cleaning, per Unesp Para Jovens and the US CDC.

triage.headline_ja: 6600万年前に恐竜と共存していた昆虫が家庭に侵入し、ペットに危険な寄生虫を媒介する
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、ノミが媒介する寄生虫症（瓜実条虫、バルトネラ症）に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の国・地域における感染症の発生事例を報じたものではなく、ノミの生態や家庭内でのペットへの寄生虫感染リスクに関する一般的な教育・啓発内容である。ブラジルのメディアが発信しているが、地理的な発生事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: campanha de vacinação entra na reta final; Brasil tem 27 casos | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: Vaccination Campaign Enters the Final Stretch; Brazil Has 27 Cases | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Brazil: 27 confirmed cases as of 2026-08-30, with the National Multivaccination Campaign ending on Sep 1, 2026. Of the 27, 24 are linked to a June active transmission in São Paulo: 21 in the city of São Paulo, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos. The remaining 3 cases (two in São Paulo, one in Rio de Janeiro) are unconnected and have been deemed closed after more than 12 months without new linked occurrences. Measles-mumps-rubella vaccine coverage reached 93% in 2025, following growth since 2023 and a notable annual rise in vaccinated young children. The dose-zero initiative expanded vaccination to children 6–11 months in affected municipalities, but does not replace routine vaccination (two doses for children: 12 months and 15 months). Adults 30–59 require one dose; those up to 29 years with no doses should receive two doses 30 days apart. Vaccines are provided for free by SUS.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹：ワクチン接種キャンペーンが最終局面に、ブラジルで27例
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで麻疹27例が報告されているが、多くは既存クラスターに関連し重症例や死亡の報告はなく、ワクチン接種キャンペーンで対応中であるため、フルRRAには至らないが動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 27例中24例はサンパウロ州の6月からの伝播クラスターに関連。残り3例は12ヶ月以上新規関連例がなく終息判定済み。ワクチン接種率は2025年に93%まで上昇し、全国的な予防接種キャンペーンが進行中。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 Cases Rise In UP: Three Western UP Districts Account For Half Of State's Cases
article.articleSummary: By August 29, Uttar Pradesh reported 551 laboratory-confirmed H1N1 (swine flu) cases, with 275 from three western districts. Gautam Buddh Nagar leads with 189 cases, followed by Lucknow 113; Meerut 54; Ghaziabad 32. H1N1 has been detected in 57 districts; six districts have double-digit counts. Health authorities require intensified testing, treatment, and reporting; hospitals should identify suspected and symptomatic H1N1 patients and provide separate treatment where needed. All hospitalized SARI patients must be tested for H1N1. Facilities are to maintain adequate stocks of RT-PCR kits, oseltamivir, and bronchodilators, and ensure oxygen plants, concentrators, and cylinders operate. Public awareness efforts urged for cough and fever patients, emphasizing masks, hand hygiene, covering coughs, and good ventilation to reduce transmission. The measures were discussed at a health department meeting chaired by the Deputy Chief Minister on August 29.

triage.headline_ja: UPでH1N1症例が増加：西部3地区が州内症例の半数を占める
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州で季節性H1N1（豚インフルエンザ）の症例数増加が報告されているが、重症度や死亡例の情報がなく、国際的拡大の兆候もないため、現時点ではフルRRAに進む根拠は不足している。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既に世界的に流行している株であり、本記事は州内の症例数増加と保健当局の対応強化（検査・治療体制、啓発活動）を報告する定例的なサーベイランス情報。死亡者数や重症度に関する具体的データはなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事象とは言えない。続報で死亡率や医療体制逼迫の情報が出れば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: В Бразилии дикие кабаны распространяют антибиотикорезистентные бактерии
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Brazil, wild boars spread antibiotic-resistant bacteria.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian researchers tested 100 externally healthy European wild boars from two commercial farms in Goiás state, Brazil. The study, published in Archives of Microbiology, found Salmonella in one sample, with a strain lacking the virulence and antibiotic-resistance genes examined. Escherichia coli was detected in 56 of the 100 animals. Of 55 E. coli isolates tested, 98.2% showed resistance to multiple antibiotic classes, indicating widespread multidrug resistance among gut bacteria in farmed boars. This co-resistance raises concern for infection management in animals and potential implications for zoonotic transfer to humans. The findings highlight antimicrobial resistance in livestock and the need for surveillance of gut bacteria in farmed wildlife across Brazil. Published 2026-08-30.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで野生イノシシが抗生物質耐性菌を拡散
triage.triage_reason: 抗菌薬耐性菌の研究報告であり、ヒトへの感染事例は確認されていないが、動物由来の薬剤耐性菌拡散という公衆衛生上の潜在的懸念があるため継続監視が望ましい。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究（養豚場の野生イノシシにおける大腸菌の多剤耐性）に関するもので、ヒト感染例やアウトブレイクの報告はない。動物衛生・AMRサーベイランスの観点から継続的な情報収集が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Scrub typhus cases in Odisha; Medical team sent
article.articleSummary: Odisha government has dispatched a medical team to Pallahara block in Angul district after scrub typhus was detected in Sanbagdhari village. In the last few days, rapid kit tests yielded 29 positives for scrub typhus, though these rapid tests are not confirmatory. A medical team from Angul conducted door-to-door surveys to identify additional suspected cases. Scrub typhus is an infectious bacterial disease transmitted by bites of infected larval mites. The report provides no laboratory-confirmed case counts or outcomes. The response focuses on surveillance and containment in Sanbagdhari and surrounding areas, with the affected locations listed as Odisha state, Angul district, Pallahara block, and Sanbagdhari village. Time reference: published 2026-08-30.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州でツツガムシ病の症例、医療チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: 地域的なツツガムシ病の集団発生で、迅速検査による陽性者が確認されたが確定診断なく重症度・拡大リスクの情報が不足しているため、続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 迅速検査での29例陽性のみで確定診断なし。ベクター媒介の地域的流行であり、州政府主導で対応中、国際的関心は低い。

article.articleHeadline: ​Sambhajinagar civic body intensifies measures to combat mosquito menace, viral illnesses
article.articleSummary: As of 30 August 2026, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar Municipal Corporation (CSMC) intensifies measures against mosquito-borne and viral illnesses amid fluctuating weather and a three-week dry spell. Guppy fish have been released at 512 locations across all 10 municipal zones as a biological mosquito-control measure. Health workers are conducting household anti-larval inspections and fogging; residents can register to receive guppy fish. Free malaria and dengue testing is available at all municipal health centres and dispensaries; symptomatic individuals (fever, cold, body ache) should seek prompt testing and follow doctors’ advice. An awareness campaign promotes a weekly 'Dry Day' and education on vector-borne and water-borne diseases, with emphasis on eliminating stagnant water in coolers, containers, pots, and other sites. Citizens are urged to cooperate to prevent mosquito breeding and curb disease spread.

triage.headline_ja: サンバジナガル市当局、蚊媒介性疾患・ウイルス性疾患対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 自治体による通常の予防的媒介動物対策・啓発活動の報道であり、異常な発生や重症例の急増を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は自治体の予防的対策（グッピー放流、無料検査、啓発活動）の紹介であり、具体的な感染者数や異常な流行の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू (H1N1): बदलता मौसम, बढ़ती गंभीरता और आयुर्वेद का सुरक्षा कवच : डॉ. सम्पूर्णानन्द मिश्र. - ISMA TIMES NEWS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine Flu (H1N1): Changing Weather, Increasing Severity, and Ayurveda's Protective Shield: Dr. Sampurnanand Mishra. - ISMA TIMES NEWS
article.articleSummary: Swine Flu (H1N1 influenza) outbreaks are highlighted in Bihar, India, as changing weather spikes respiratory infections; the virus spreads via droplets and can progress to pneumonia, posing high risk to the elderly, pregnant women, children, and those with asthma or diabetes. Early signs include fever above 102°F, dry cough, sore throat, body pains, extreme weakness, and breathlessness. Ayurveda is presented as a preventive shield, classifying Swine Flu under epidemics (Janapadodhvams) and a Vata-Kapha predominant fever; it emphasizes boosting internal immunity (ojas). Recommended measures include Giloy (Tinospora cordifolia) and Tulsi extracts, Anu Tail nasal oil, Sitopaladi churna with honey, gargling with Triphala powder and salt, and turmeric milk with chyawanprash daily. If severe breathing trouble or fever persisting beyond 48 hours, seek medical care and consider oseltamivir. Daily precautions: masks in crowded places, frequent handwashing, warm fluids, avoid cold items, and pranayama. Article by Dr. Sampurnanand Mishra, Ranchi, Jharkhand, August 30, 2026.

triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）に関する一般的な健康啓発・予防医学（アーユルヴェーダ）記事であり、具体的な症例数・死亡者数・アウトブレイク規模の報告がなく、新規性や異常性も認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）に対するアーユルヴェーダ的予防法を紹介する健康啓発記事であり、具体的な感染者数・死亡者数・アウトブレイクの規模等のデータは記載されていない。季節変化に伴う既知の疾患リスクの説明が主眼であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Lenktynės su mirtimi: Konge Ebola plinta greičiau, nei spėja atvykti pagalba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A race against death: Ebola is spreading in the Congo faster than help can arrive.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo strain is spreading faster than health systems can respond, with over 100 days since the outbreak and 2,500 deaths in the past three months, about half of them in the last 20 days. Provinces infected rose from 1 to 6; fear that transmission could reach Kinshasa. The virus, previously present in northeastern DRC, now affects communities with initial symptoms resembling malaria, delaying recognition and care. MSF coordinates six treatment centers from Bunia in Ituri, but gaps in local surveillance and information transfer hinder response; decentralization of resources urged. There is no vaccine for Bundibugyo yet; Ervebo (Zaire strain) vaccine doses exist, though effectiveness against Bundibugyo is unproven. Two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are in trials. Africa CDC notes international pledges nearing $1 billion, though funding and governance challenges persist.

triage.headline_ja: 死との競争：コンゴのエボラは支援が到着するより速く拡大している
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が100日超で死者2,500人、感染州が1から6に急増し首都キンシャサへの拡大懸念があるなど、IHR基準を複数満たす重大な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: マラリアと初期症状が類似しているため診断・対応が遅延し感染拡大が加速している点、ブンディブギョ株特異的ワクチンが未承認である点がリスクを高めている。国際的な資金拠出（約10億ドル）が進むも、資金・ガバナンス上の課題が残るとされる。
