article.articleHeadline: Varanasi reports 4 H1N1 cases, Health Dept steps up vigilance | Varanasi News
article.articleSummary: Varanasi reports four confirmed H1N1 cases, all stable, as India faces a rise in seasonal influenza A (H1N1). UP records 31,478 lab-confirmed influenza cases, including 551 from UP, in 57 districts, with Gautam Buddh Nagar, Lucknow, Meerut and Ghaziabad highest. Figures are from DGHS data through August 25, 2026. H1N1 spreads mainly by respiratory droplets; symptoms include fever, cough, cold, sore throat, headache, body aches and red eyes. Risk groups include seniors, pregnant women, young children, healthcare workers, and those with heart, lung, kidney or liver disease, diabetes, cancer, or weakened immunity. Management is categorized: A mild; B high fever or severe symptoms (five-day Oseltamivir as advised); C severe symptoms requiring hospitalization. Preventive meds for close contacts may be used. Preparedness includes SARI testing, respiratory OPDs, daily ILI/SARI reporting, and ensuring Oseltamivir and oxygen equipment. Citizens urged to cover coughs, wear masks, wash hands, avoid crowds, seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァラナシでH1N1感染4例確認、保健当局が警戒強化
triage.triage_reason: インドで季節性に発生しているH1N1インフルエンザの通常の増加であり、症例は全て安定、既存の管理体制（オセルタミビル投与、ILI/SARI報告等）で対応可能であるため特段の異常性は見られない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)の毎年の流行パターンであり、DGHSデータに基づく通常のサーベイランス報告。地方保健当局は既に予防・治療プロトコルを整備しており、国際的な懸念や渡航制限の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Broj umrlih od ebole u Kongu premašio 2.800, zaraženo gotovo 6.000 ljudi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,800, with nearly 6,000 people infected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 2,800 and infected nearly 6,000 as of 30 August 2026. The Ministry of Health reports 5,945 confirmed cases across six provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, and Tshopo. At least 1,327 have recovered; 896 are currently isolated or hospitalized. Since mid-May, the epidemic has affected 60 health zones. The World Health Organization notes the Bundibugyo strain is continuing to evolve with sustainable transmission, marking a significant rise in cases and geographic spread over the past three months. Last week, authorities launched a vaccination campaign targeting health and frontline workers. Dr. Richard Kitenge emphasized that containment hinges on community involvement, adherence to preventive measures, and cooperation to ensure case tracing and rapid response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が2,800人を超え、感染者は約6,000人に達した
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ流行（死者2,800人超、感染者約6,000人）が6州60保健区に拡大し、持続的なヒト-ヒト感染が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOはBundibugyo株が持続的伝播能力を有し進化していると指摘しており、地理的拡大と症例急増が過去3か月で顕著。ワクチン接種キャンペーンは医療従事者・最前線対応者を対象に開始されたばかりで、封じ込めには地域社会の協力が不可欠とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 5 945 cas confirmés et 2 862 décès au 28 août 2026 - La Presse de Tunisie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 5,945 confirmed cases and 2,862 deaths as of August 28, 2026 - La Presse de Tunisie.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) as of 28 August 2026: 5,945 confirmed cases, 2,862 deaths, 1,327 recoveries. The outbreak spans six provinces and 60 health zones, with no new zones in the past 24 hours, suggesting geographic stabilization. Approximately 896 patients are isolated or hospitalized, and contact tracing coverage reaches 84.4%. Ituri province accounts for most transmissions; authorities continue epidemiological surveillance, vaccination campaigns, and reinforcement of treatment centers. The outbreak, declared mid-May 2026, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, one of Ebola virus strains, and covers extensive territory in the eastern DRC. The World Health Organization and United Nations deem it the fastest-spreading outbreak to date and among the deadliest. Previously, the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak caused 2,299 deaths from 3,381 cases; the West Africa 2014–2016 event exceeded 11,000 deaths globally.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行、コンゴ民主共和国：2026年8月28日時点で確認症例5,945件、死者2,862人
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRC東部で大規模流行し、6州60保健区に拡大、WHO/国連が過去最速・最悪級の流行と評価しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO・国連が『史上最速拡大・最悪級』と評価する大規模エボラ流行。既にフルRRA相当の情報が蓄積されており、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus ebola já causou mais de 2,8 mil mortes no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus has already caused more than 2,800 deaths in Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak declared in mid-May in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has become the deadliest in its recent history, with 2,862 deaths and 5,945 confirmed cases as of August 30. Sixty health zones are in emergency after Biena and Manguredjipa were added in North Kivu. The case-fatality rate stands at 48.1% (data through August 28). The epicenter remains Ituri province, home to the Allied Democratic Forces, an ISIS faction, whose attacks have driven mass displacement and hindered surveillance. Displaced into Kivu amid fighting with the M23 militia, which coordinates its outbreak response without government dialogue. Health workers have faced about 260 attacks, killing at least eight professionals; Ebola has killed a further 43 people. The first batch of Ervebo vaccine (70,000 doses) arrived, though efficacy against Bundibugyo is uncertain and no vaccine exists for this strain; vaccines will be used in expanded testing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスによる死者が既に2,800人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ流行が進行中（死者2,862人、致死率48.1%）。武装勢力の攻撃による医療活動妨害、住民の大規模避難、未知株（Bundibugyo）に対するワクチン有効性不明など、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 紛争地域（Ituri、北キブ）での医療従事者への攻撃（260件、8人死亡）や武装勢力M23との協調なき対応により、サーベイランス・対応能力が著しく制限されている。Bundibugyo株に対するEbola用ワクチン（Ervebo）の有効性は未確立であり、今後の疫学的展開を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: चूहों से फैल रहा लेप्टोस्पायरोसिस रांची में दो महीने में 130 मरीज मिले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rat-borne leptospirosis: 130 patients in Ranchi in two months.
article.articleSummary: Ranchi, Jharkhand, India, reports a leptospirosis surge during the monsoon. A private hospital diagnosed more than 130 patients with leptospirosis between July and August 2026. All patients were treated and have recovered. Infected rats and other animals shed Leptospira bacteria in urine, which contaminates water and soil and enables human infection. Dr. Soni Sinha, director of Rani Hospital, notes that floodwaters mix rat urine with water and mud; contact with contaminated water—especially in flooded areas, walking barefoot, or prolonged immersion—significantly raises infection risk. Open wounds further increase susceptibility. The outbreak underscores the need for precautions during flooding and for avoiding exposure to potentially contaminated water.

triage.headline_ja: ネズミが媒介するレプトスピラ症、ランチーで2か月間に130人の患者
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のレプトスピラ症流行で全員回復しているが、モンスーン期の継続的な曝露リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: インド・ジャールカンド州ランチーの単一民間病院での報告であり、季節性（モンスーン期）の毎年発生する感染症と考えられる。全患者が回復しており重症度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Bareily News: बुखार के मरीजों की हुई मलेरिया जांच, त्वचा रोगी बढ़े
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bareilly News: Malaria tests were conducted on fever patients, the number of patients with skin diseases has increased.
article.articleSummary: Malaria tests were conducted on fever patients in Bareilly as seasonal weather changes drive up fever and skin diseases. On Sunday, the health department organized health fairs across 81 centers, registering more than 3,200 patients, with skin conditions the most reported. A shortage of doctors hindered treatment at several centers, with over 25 physicians on leave for the NEET-PG examination. Urban Ayushman Arogya Mandirs were redeployed to staff the fairs, per urban nodal officer Dr. Ajmer Singh. The report highlights rising dermatological cases and malaria testing amid strain on primary health services in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, India, underscoring challenges in urban and rural access to care during health outreach events.

triage.headline_ja: バレリー・ニュース：発熱患者にマラリア検査を実施、皮膚病患者が増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節的な気候変化に伴う発熱・皮膚疾患患者の増加と通常の健康フェアでの検査対応であり、異常な流行拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 医師不足（NEET-PG試験による休暇）が医療提供に影響しているとの記載はあるが、感染症の異常発生を示すものではなく、地域限定の季節性健康事象と判断される。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: देहरादून में स्वाइन फ्लू और कोरोना का डबल अटैक, H1N1 के 81 मामलों ने बढ़ाई चिंता, 5 की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Double attack of swine flu and COVID-19 in Dehradun, 81 H1N1 cases have raised concerns, five deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 31 August 2026, Dehradun district, Uttarakhand reports 81 H1N1 (swine flu) cases with 5 deaths and 26 active infections. Of the 81 cases, 49 are men and 32 are women. Active patients are treated at Shri Mahant Indresh Hospital (18), Himalayan Hospital (4), and one patient each at Kailash Hospital, AIIMS Rishikesh, Government Doon Medical College Hospital, and Graphic Era Hospital. COVID-19 adds 23 total cases (11 local residents and 12 from other states/districts), with 4 active infections—2 at AIIMS Rishikesh and 1 at Shri Mahant Indresh Hospital. Health authorities have issued an advisory urging swine flu testing for anyone with high fever for 3–4 days, chest pain, or breathing difficulties."

triage.headline_ja: デヘラードゥーンでインフルエンザとコロナの二重感染、H1N1感染81件で懸念拡大、5人死亡
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタラーカンド州デヘラードゥーン県で季節性H1N1（豚インフルエンザ）とCOVID-19の局地的な流行が報告されているが、地域限定的で国際的拡大の兆候はなく、当局が既に注意喚起を行い管理下にあるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)とCOVID-19の同時流行だが、いずれも既知の病原体で地域の医療機関が対応中。5人の死亡は懸念材料だが、感染規模（81例）や地理的範囲（1県）から国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いと判断。続報で感染拡大の有無を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 開學在即流感活躍 防護中心籲打針 - 20260831
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza Active as Schools Reopen; CDC Urges Vaccination - 20260831
article.articleSummary: Influenza remains active in Hong Kong as schools reopen, with the Centre for Health Protection reporting the seasonal flu season has been at a high level since late June. Since late June, 11 severe pediatric influenza cases have been recorded: 8 recovered, 2 in critical condition, 1 death. Vaccination is urged as the most effective protection against influenza, COVID-19, and related complications, reducing hospitalizations and deaths. A 2026/27 seasonal influenza vaccine school outreach program, plus a new Medical and Health Connect electronic consent form, aims to accelerate school-based vaccination. Parents should arrange vaccination for children at subsidized private clinics if schools do not participate. Hand, foot and mouth disease activity has declined to relatively low levels since mid-August, but outbreaks may occur with close contact in schools and care homes.

triage.headline_ja: 開学を控えインフルエンザ活発化、防護センターがワクチン接種を呼びかけ - 20260831
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行状況であり、重症小児例が一部報告されているが、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。定例的な公衆衛生広報の範囲内。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区の情報はChina(1814991)に統合。季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行パターンであり、学校再開時期の恒例的なワクチン接種呼びかけ記事。重症小児例11例（うち死亡1例）の報告はあるが、香港全体としては管理可能な範囲内とみられる。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: इन्फ्लूएंजा-ए एच1एन1 का बढ़ा खतरा, एमजीएम-सदर में आइसोलेशन वार्ड तैयार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increased risk of Influenza A (H1N1); isolation ward prepared at MGM Medical College and Hospital, Sadar.
article.articleSummary: Rising Influenza A (H1N1) cases across states prompt Jharkhand NHM to tighten vigilance in East Singhbhum. The Civil Surgeon is directed to monitor developments as NHM orders isolation wards and regular patient surveillance; masks are mandatory for doctors and paramedical staff. MGM Medical College and Hospital, Jamshedpur, and Sadar Hospital have designated 10-bed isolation wards for H1N1 testing and treatment. H1N1 and H3N2 are described as seasonal influenza viruses active January–March, with continued risk after the monsoon season. The District Surveillance Unit will coordinate with the district hospital and medical college. Suspected and confirmed cases should be lab-tested; screening at district hospitals, CHCs, and the medical college OPD should capture symptoms (cold, cough, fever, runny nose, sore throat, headache, vomiting, diarrhea, chills) and respiratory distress. H1N1 testing facilities exist at RIMS, Ranchi, and MGM, Jamshedpur. IDSP reporting is mandated.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型(H1N1)の感染リスク増加、MGM・サダール病院に隔離病棟を準備
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1/H3N2)の増加に伴う予防的対応であり、異常性や重篤性の明確な情報はないが、当局が監視体制を強化しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の増加に対する行政対応であり、重症度や異常性の情報は限定的。IDSP報告体制下での通常監視強化の一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي بوتيرة متسارعة.. 2500 وفاة جراء إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapidly escalating outbreak... 2,500 Ebola-related deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: More than 2,500 people have died from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to UN Ebola response coordinator Julian Harennes, speaking from Bunia. The outbreak, declared May 15 in the DRC, is spreading rapidly, now covering an area larger than France, with deaths rising daily and about half of fatalities in the past 20 days. In just three months, Ebola has produced sevenfold more cases and fivefold more deaths than the first three months of the 2018-2020 outbreak, which left 2,299 dead of 3,381 cases. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain for which there are no approved vaccines or therapies, though clinical trials are underway. 43 health workers have died; health facilities and ambulances have been targeted. MSF's Javid Abdulmonem called for intensified testing, safe isolation of patients and contacts, and broader access in eastern DRC to slow or halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 急速に拡大する流行……コンゴ民主共和国でエボラによる死者2,500人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、死者2,500人超・地域はフランスより広範囲に及び、ワクチン未承認の稀な株（ブンディブギョ株）であることから、IHR基準の複数該当かつ深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威と判断される。
triage.notes: 承認ワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株による流行で、医療従事者43名死亡、医療施設・救急車が攻撃対象となるなど対応能力に深刻な支障が生じている。2018-2020年流行を上回るペースで拡大しており、国際的な支援強化が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Butembo: the start of the new school term goes ahead on Tuesday, with strict adherence to Ebola prevention measures - ACP
article.articleSummary: Butembo, Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, proceeds with the 2026-2027 school year on Tuesday, September 1, 2026, under an Ebola-related public health emergency. To protect pupils, officials require strict prevention measures, including hand-washing stations with soap at entrances and in every classroom, and infrared thermometers to screen fever. Head teachers were briefed by James Vavughaghe, head of the provincial education sub-division, who urged parents to prepare school materials while ensuring home adherence to guidelines. Prevention kits will be installed at schools. Measures extend to communities and families. Despite assurances, Butembo city—an epicentre in Nord-Kivu—has seen modest market activity for school items as some parents express uncertainty about the start amid the resurgence risk.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボ:新学期が火曜日に開始、エボラ予防対策の厳格な遵守のもとで
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国ノースキブ州ブテンボにおいてエボラ出血熱に関する公衆衛生上の緊急事態が継続しており、学校再開時に厳格な予防策が取られている。エボラは重症度が高く再燃リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は公衆衛生上の緊急事態下での学校再開に関する内容であり、感染者数・死亡者数など疫学的詳細は記載されていない。ブテンボはこれまでのエボラ流行のエピセンターとされており、再燃リスクへの懸念が示されている。続報で感染状況の詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Calor e chuvas irregulares exigem atenção contra dengue, chikungunya e zika em Uberaba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Heat and irregular rains call for vigilance against dengue, Chikungunya and Zika in Uberaba.
article.articleSummary: Uberaba remains at risk from Aedes aegypti during drought and irregular rainfall, with water-holding containers inside and around homes continuing to fuel transmission of dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. In 2026, the city reported 6,991 dengue notifications and 196 laboratory-confirmed cases, with no dengue deaths to date; these figures follow 26,014 notifications and 5,372 confirmed cases in the previous year. Authorities urge year-round vigilance: eliminate standing water in plant pots, drains, unused toilets, and water-storage containers; ensure water tanks are sealed; regularly inspect properties and clean gutters; discard tires, bottles, and other potential breeding sites. Dengue vaccination is free via Brazil’s SUS for eligible groups as a complementary measure. Uberaba’s Center for Endemic Diseases and Zoonoses participated in a regional Arboviruses Surveillance and Control meeting (Cisalp) to strengthen strategies for the upcoming season.

triage.headline_ja: 暑さと不規則な降雨、ウベラーバでデング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱への警戒を要請
triage.triage_reason: 例年の季節性デング等アルボウイルス感染症に関する予防啓発記事であり、前年より症例数は大幅減少しており、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルでの季節的な予防啓発記事。死亡例なく、前年比で症例数は大幅減少（6,991件 vs 26,014件）。ルーチンのサーベイランス活動の一環。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis cases overwhelm hospitals amid widespread flooding
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis surge in the Philippines amid widespread flooding: over 4,000 cases and more than 200 deaths reported nationwide from January 4 to August 22, 2026, with cases 37% below last year’s tally but accelerating in recent weeks. In Manila, San Lazaro Hospital is overwhelmed, with the emergency room operating at about 300–500% capacity; a tent outside the ER screens and triages patients as admissions reach roughly 155 and three of four floors function as leptospirosis wards, including repurposed pediatric space for adults. About one-third of Metro Manila’s cases are treated there; assistance from Jose Reyes Memorial Medical Center and Jose Fabella Memorial Hospital is provided. Transmission tied to floodwaters and contaminated soil; severe disease involves kidneys, liver, and lungs; younger patients (mid-20s) are affected. Early antibiotics and supportive care are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水拡大の中、レプトスピラ症の症例が病院を圧迫
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで洪水に伴うレプトスピラ症患者が急増し、マニラの主要病院が定員300〜500%に達するなど医療体制が逼迫しており、重症度・医療キャパシティの観点からフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 症例数自体は前年比37%減だが、直近数週間で急増し医療機関が逼迫している点が懸念材料。洪水継続による曝露リスクも高い。ヒト-ヒト感染はないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、国内医療体制への負荷という観点で経過観察・フル評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 权威访谈丨"中国结核病防治成效显著、经验独特" -- -- 访世卫组织艾滋病、结核病、肝炎和性传播感染防治司司长特蕾莎·卡萨耶娃
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Authoritative Interview | "China's tuberculosis prevention and control has achieved remarkable results, with unique experience" — Interview with Teresa Kasayeva, Director of the World Health Organization's Department of HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis, Hepatitis and Sexually Transmitted Infections Prevention and Control
article.articleSummary: On 28 August 2026, the WHO Global Center for Tuberculosis Research and Innovation was inaugurated within the China CDC. WHO TB chief Teresa Kasayeva said the center acknowledges China’s TB achievements and will provide a global platform to share experiences. China has achieved substantial declines in TB incidence and mortality since 2010, progress that outpaced the global average due to sustained investment, political will, and multisectoral action. China’s prevention approach combines timely diagnosis and treatment with expanded screening, active case finding, preventive interventions, and strong community engagement, embodied in its 'TB-free communities' model of early detection, preventive therapy, and smart management—cited by WHO as a global exemplar. The center will tackle multidrug-resistant TB and latent tuberculosis infection, and strengthen South-South and regional cooperation, BRICS TB networks, and Belt and Road collaboration to accelerate elimination, notably in high-burden, low-income settings. WHO expects deeper collaboration and wider global uptake of China's innovations.

triage.headline_ja: 権威者インタビュー『中国の結核予防対策は顕著な成果を上げ、独自の経験を有する』―WHO エイズ・結核・肝炎・性感染症対策部長テレサ・カサエワ氏に聞く
triage.triage_reason: 新規の結核アウトブレイクや異常事態ではなく、WHOと中国CDCによる結核研究センター設立と成果に関する広報的インタビュー記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核対策の成果発表・国際協力に関する内容であり、新規感染症イベントではないため対象国のverified_locationsも空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 医疗保障法明年1月1日起施行；刚果（金）启动埃博拉疫苗接种
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Medical Security Law Takes Effect on January 1 Next Year; Democratic Republic of the Congo Launches Ebola Vaccination
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola vaccination program launched in Kisangani, the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, to combat an outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Vaccination with Ervebo began on Aug 27 in Kisangani, with frontline health workers among the first recipients. Ervebo is approved to prevent disease from Zaire ebolavirus; there is currently no vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Early laboratory and animal studies indicate Ervebo may offer some protection against Bundibugyo, but human efficacy remains unproven. Health Minister Kamba announced the rollout as part of the outbreak response, highlighting vaccination as a critical public health measure in the eastern country. As of Aug 31, 2026, the initiative reflects ongoing efforts to control transmission and protect frontline workers.

triage.headline_ja: 医療保障法、来年1月1日施行；コンゴ民主共和国がエボラワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）の流行に対しワクチン接種が開始されており、IHR基準複数該当・WPRO基準も多数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既存のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行への対応としてワクチン接種（Ervebo）が開始されたもの。Erveboはザイール型に対する承認であり、ブンディブギョ型への有効性はヒトでは未証明である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Tak Batuk atau Demam tapi Positif Kuman TB? Kenali Kondisi TB Laten : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No Cough or Fever but Positive for TB Bacteria? Get to Know Latent TB Infection: Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Latent TB infection (LTBI) vs active TB in Indonesia. TB specialist Prof. Erlina Burhan of FKUI explains that LTBI involves tuberculosis bacteria that are dormant, while active TB bacteria are active and multiply, causing tissue damage. LTBI individuals have no symptoms; chest X-ray is usually normal and sputum tests are negative. Prof. Burhan notes LTBI bacteria are sleeping and present in small numbers, so health is unaffected, with no cough, fever, night sweats, or weight loss. Active TB typically presents with symptoms and positive radiographic or microbiological findings. Her explanation, shared via Instagram, aims to clarify the public’s understanding of LTBI versus active TB and emphasizes that LTBI is not illness and may require testing for detection. The article is set in Jakarta, Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: 咳や発熱がないのにTB菌陽性？潜在性結核感染症（LTBI）を知る：Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: 潜在性結核感染症に関する一般啓発記事であり、具体的な発生・アウトブレイク情報ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 医療専門家によるTB教育目的の解説記事であり、実際の症例数増加やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito ovitrap index remains elevated
article.articleSummary: Macau’s mosquito ovitrap index rose to 63.9% in August, above the five-year average of 59.4%, signaling increased risk for dengue and chikungunya transmission. Ovitrap readings topped 70% in Coloane, Fai Chi Kei, and the Inner Harbour area. With the school year starting, the Health Bureau urged schools and social service facilities to remove standing water and intensify environmental cleaning. Residents were advised to use repellents, wear long sleeves, and seek prompt medical care for fever, joint pain, or rash. This year Macau has recorded 10 imported dengue/chikungunya cases among travelers returning from Guangdong province, the Philippines, and Vietnam. Public health measures emphasize vector control and personal protection to mitigate spillover into the community.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊の産卵トラップ指数、高水準で推移
triage.triage_reason: マカオで蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・チクングニア熱）のリスク指標が平年を上回っているが、現時点で重症例や地域内流行の明確な報告はなく、情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はマカオ（中国特別行政区）における蚊のオビトラップ指数上昇と、それに伴うデング熱・チクングニア熱の域内伝播リスクを主題としている。フィリピン・ベトナム・広東省は輸入症例の由来地として言及されているのみで、記事の主題である発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda marks end of Ebola disease outbreak - Uganda
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Uganda ends after 42 days with no new confirmed cases; 20 infected, 18 recovered and 2 deaths, officially ending on 27 August. MSF, in collaboration with the Ugandan Ministry of Health, supported the response. MSF rehabilitated a 32-bed Ebola Treatment Unit in Mulago, Kampala, and renovated a 19-bed isolation centre in Bwera near the DRC. Teams trained Ministry of Health emergency staff and helped with infection prevention and control, isolation procedures, and case management across eight health centres. MSF has worked in Uganda since 1980 and remains active in Kasese district, running an adolescent-focused clinic. Beyond outbreak work, MSF provides sexual and reproductive health, chronic conditions such as sickle cell disease for people aged 9 months to 19 years, and social and mental health support for victims and survivors of sexual violence.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 本件はウガンダにおけるエボラアウトブレイクの終息報告であり、対象国リストに含まれる国での発生ではない。新規感染もなく既に収束済みの事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にDRCが含まれているが、記事本文はウガンダ（ブンディブギョ）のアウトブレイク終息についてであり、DRCは近隣国としての言及（Bweraが国境近く）に過ぎず実際の発生国ではない。ウガンダ自体は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll exceeds 2,800 in DR Congo as cases mount
article.articleSummary: As of 31 August 2026, Dr Congo's Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) has a death toll surpassing 2,800 and 5,945 confirmed cases across six provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele and Tshopo. Recovery stands at 1,327, with 896 patients in isolation or hospital. The Health Ministry says 60 health zones have been affected since declaration in mid-May. WHO notes sustained transmission and rapid evolution of the Bundibugyo strain, marking a substantial increase in scale over the past three months. A vaccination campaign rolled out last week targets health and frontline workers to curb spread, highlighting the ongoing need for containment and continued vaccination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴでエボラ死者数が2,800人を超え、感染拡大が続く
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者2,800人超・感染者5,945人に達し、6州に拡大、持続的なヒト-ヒト感染と国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念があるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模アウトブレイクの継続報道。死者数・感染者数の増加、複数州への拡大、WHOによる持続的伝播の指摘があり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: کانگو میں موذی مرض ایبولا کی ہلاکت خیزی جاری، 2800 افراد جان سے گئے
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadly Ebola outbreak continues in Congo; 2,800 people have died.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 2,800 Ebola deaths with 5,945 confirmed cases across six provinces—Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, and Tshopo—alongside 1,327 recoveries and 896 patients under treatment or in quarantine. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is mutating as transmission continues across 60 health zones. In the past three months, cases have risen and spread to new areas, heightening outbreak concerns. A government vaccination campaign started last week, prioritizing healthcare workers and frontline staff. Dr. Richard Kaiteng notes that public cooperation is critical; adherence to preventive measures and timely case identification are essential to curb transmission. This summary covers disease name, affected locations, case/death counts, ongoing outbreak spread, vaccination efforts, and key statements from officials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで致死的なエボラ流行が続く、2,800人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で6州にまたがるエボラ流行が拡大し、死者2,800人・症例5,945件に達しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株が変異しつつあり、60保健地域にわたり伝播が継続中。政府によるワクチン接種キャンペーンが開始されているが、感染拡大の懸念が高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: Over 490K children in CV still unvaccinated against measles, rubella
article.articleSummary: As of August 29, Central Visayas’ Measles-Rubella Supplemental Immunization Activity reached only 21.7% coverage, vaccinating 137,042 of 630,214 eligible children aged 6–59 months, leaving 493,172 unreached. The campaign covers Cebu and Bohol provinces and the cities of Cebu, Lapu-Lapu, and Mandaue; Cebu City had 18.4% coverage (16,636/90,604; 73,968 unreached). Cebu Province vaccinated 70,461 of 336,406 target (20.9%; 265,945 unreached). Lapu-Lapu City: 27.4% (13,394/48,856). Bohol Province: 22.3% (27,569/123,512). Mandaue City: 29.1% (8,982/30,836). The DOH extended vaccination to September 4 before returning to routine immunization. WHO classifies measles and rubella as highly contagious airborne diseases; symptoms include fever, cough, red eyes, rash, with pneumonia or encephalitis possible; transmission via respiratory droplets underscores need for sustained vaccination to prevent year-round spread.

triage.headline_ja: 中央ビサヤ地方で49万人以上の子供が麻疹・風疹ワクチン未接種のまま
triage.triage_reason: 実際の症例発生報告ではなく、麻疹・風疹ワクチン接種キャンペーンの低カバレッジ（21.7%）に関する報道。感染力の強い疾患で未接種者が多く将来的な流行リスクがあるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の麻疹・風疹症例の発生ではなく、ワクチン接種キャンペーンの進捗（低カバレッジ）に関する報道。DOHが接種期間を9月4日まで延長。今後の症例発生動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Typhoid control needs more vaccine, less antibiotic
article.articleSummary: Typhoid cases are rising in India, but control relies on vaccination and diagnostics rather than antibiotics alone. Diagnosis is hindered by unreliable tests: Widal lacks specificity in endemic settings, and blood culture sensitivity is only ~55–60%, worsened by prior antibiotic exposure, fueling antimicrobial resistance and surveillance gaps. The WHO prioritizes typhoid-conjugate vaccines (TCV); India produced Typbar-TCV (WHO prequalified since 2017) and other Indian TCVs have prequalification, but vaccination scale remains inadequate within an integrated control strategy that also includes water, sanitation, and diagnostics. Key recommendations: strengthen surveillance with documentation of suspected and culture-confirmed cases and antimicrobial susceptibility; diagnostic stewardship—obtain blood cultures before antibiotics with adequate volume; invest in better rapid diagnostics; and revisit TCV’s role in public-health planning to achieve both vaccination and prevention.

triage.triage_reason: 腸チフスに関する政策論説記事であり、突発的な流行や急性の公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は腸チフスの診断・ワクチン戦略に関する専門家の意見記事であり、特定の急性アウトブレイクの報告ではない。継続的な公衆衛生課題としての性質が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Jumlah Kematian Akibat Ebola di Republik Demokratik Kongo Tembus 2.800 Jiwa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 2,800.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 2,800 people, with 5,945 laboratory-confirmed cases across six provinces (Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, and Tshopo) as of late August 2026. About 1,327 recoveries and 896 currently in isolation or hospital are reported. The outbreak began in mid-May and has affected 60 health zones. The World Health Organization warns that the Bundibugyo lineage is mutating rapidly and transmission remains ongoing, with a substantial rise in cases and wider geographic spread over the past three months. Last week, authorities launched an Ebola vaccination campaign targeting health workers and frontline staff. Dr. Richard Kitenge stresses community engagement as essential to tracing and rapid interventions, noting success hinges on public cooperation and adherence to preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱による死者数が2,800人を超える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが6州・60保健地域に拡大し、死者2,800人超・確定症例5,945件に達しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: WHOはBundibugyo系統の急速な変異と感染拡大継続を警告しており、国際的な監視・支援体制強化が必要とされる状況。
